jobs.title: CFD Engineer - AI Simulation Output Review (Remote)
jobs.description: CFD Engineer \- AI Simulation Output Review (Remote) is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for CFD Engineer \- AI Simulation Output Review (Remote) assignments. * Grade cfd engineer engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for CFD Engineer \- AI Simulation Output Review (Remote) work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * CFD Engineer engineering review **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - NY
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Scope Labs provides a full\-service startup ecosystem focused on design and development of digital platforms and experiences. We are a team of founders consisting of experienced product managers, designers, and developers. Our expertise lies in challenging fundamental assumptions, dissecting legacy behaviors, simplifying intricate processes, and delivering experiences that leave a lasting impact. We are a small, but driven team and are looking to expand! **Our Team** We're currently a small team passionate about developing the next generation of digital products. Our founding team has spent time building, designing, and scaling products at places like Google, Tesla, Palantir, Peloton, Scale AI, MIT, Yale, Columbia, Y Combinator, and more. We're currently hiring for an in person role working from warm and sunny New York City. **What We're Looking For** As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Scope Labs, you won't just be implementing solutions. You'll be embedded directly with our startup customers, owning the entire technical relationship from day one. We're looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering, product instinct, and customer partnership; someone who can walk into a startup's codebase on Monday and ship something meaningful by Friday. This role is for a builder who is equally comfortable digging into a customer's production environment and white boarding a new AI workflow with their engineering lead. You'll be deploying cutting\-edge AI tooling into real startup workflows at the frontier of what's possible, and you'll be the reason those deployments succeed. The specifics of what we're building are still under wraps, but if you're excited by the idea of being one of the first people to bring genuinely new technology into the hands of fast\-moving teams, this is that role. You will represent Scope Labs in the field. That means operating with autonomy, exercising strong judgment under ambiguity, and holding yourself accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. **Responsibilities** You'll own the full technical customer lifecycle. From initial deployment through activation and ongoing utilization, you are the person who makes sure our customers are actually getting value, not just access. You'll identify and champion high\-impact use cases. jobs.title: Industrial Controls Engineer, Networks & Data Integration
jobs.description: **Build the nervous system of modern manufacturing** ---------------------------------------------------- At Prysmian, we connect the world with advanced energy and telecom cable systems—spanning underground and submarine power transmission and distribution, as well as medium/low‑voltage solutions for construction and infrastructure. Our telecom capability covers optical fiber, copper, and connectivity for voice, video, and data. With 30,000 teammates across 50\+ countries, your work here shapes how the world is powered and communicates. **Make Your Mark at Prysmian \- Join Us** ### **Your mission** Own the reliability and evolution of our plant’s automation, control systems, and SCADA stack. You’ll translate machine behavior into insights that accelerate decisions, strengthen uptime, and pave the way for new equipment and smarter processes. ### **Impact in your first 90 days** * **Days 1–30:** Learn the lines, review PLC/HMI code bases, map Ethernet/IP topologies and historian data flows, and align on controls standards (UDTs, AOIs, modular patterns). * **Days 31–60:** Deliver an ISA‑101‑aligned HMI refresh for a priority cell, standardize tag naming, implement a PLC‑to‑SCADA OPC UA improvement, and document backup/change procedures. * **Days 61–90:** Lead a targeted automation upgrade, tune critical VFDs, close a root‑cause corrective action, and present a controls/SCADA roadmap with capital justifications. ### **How you’ll contribute** * Engineer and sustain PLC logic in Studio 5000 for Allen‑Bradley ControlLogix/CompactLogix; maintain clean, standard‑driven code. * Design HMIs using high‑performance (ISA‑101\) principles for clarity and speed. * Commission, integrate, and diagnose variable‑frequency drives (VFDs). * Lead SCADA architecture, dashboarding, historian integration, and reliable data acquisition. * Define data models and tag conventions; deliver dashboards, trends, and reports that guide operators, supervisors, and engineers. * Configure PLC‑SCADA communications, OPC UA, and historian structures. * Develop and maintain industrial networking: Ethernet/IP, managed switches, and segmentation tuned to plant needs. * Be the primary technical authority for SCADA/data; ensure changes are controlled and thoroughly documented. * Own automation upgrades, controls retrofits, and new installs; write control specs, review vendor designs, manage schedules/budgets/integration, and support ROI and cost‑benefit analyses. * Serve as escalation during downtime; build Maintenance troubleshooting capability; author standard work, playbooks, and training materials. * Advance continuous improvement across safety, quality, uptime, throughput, and scrap reduction. * Champion safety and compliance: electrical safety practices, arc‑flash documentation, safe work policies, and energy isolation. Contribute to cybersecurity and formal change management. ### **Qualifications** #### **Must‑haves** * BS in Electrical/Controls/Automation Engineering or related discipline. * 3\+ years of manufacturing controls experience. * Allen‑Bradley ControlLogix/CompactLogix and Studio 5000 proficiency; Ethernet/IP fluency. * HMI development/troubleshooting with FactoryTalk View, InTouch, Red Lion, Ignition, or similar. * Industrial networking fundamentals: IP addressing, managed switches, VLANs, and protocols. * VFD setup, tuning, and integration. * Ability to read/create/interpret electrical schematics, P\&IDs, and machine documentation. * Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and root‑cause skills. * Hands‑on presence on the plant floor; committed to safe work with control and power voltages/currents. #### **Nice‑to‑haves** * Historian experience: Wonderware, Ignition, OSI PI, or SQL‑backed systems. * SQL skills, data structures knowledge, and basic scripting (Python, VB, or similar). * Exposure to MES, OEE, downtime tracking, or broader manufacturing data systems. * Experience with ISA‑101 (HMI) and ISA‑18\.2 (alarm management) practices. * Leadership of automation projects and/or SCADA development in fast‑moving plants. ### **Work environment** * Frequent presence on the production floor among operating machinery. * Ability to move safely around manufacturing equipment. * Occasional extended hours or off‑shift response when necessary. ### **What’s in it for you** * Direct your plant’s SCADA and controls trajectory. * Visible, high‑impact outcomes on uptime and automation capability. * Backed by a supportive team and leadership modernizing automation and data systems. * A culture of continuous improvement and professional development.

jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer | Full Stack Developer | Financial Services / Venture Capital
jobs.description: **ABOUT BIP CAPITAL** BIP Capital is an integrated private market investment platform built to create and capture opportunities through BIP Ventures traditional venture anchor funds, an Evergreen equity BDC, and private credit offerings. With a distinctive multi\-stage, multi\-sector investment approach and a growing array of capital offerings, BIP Capital has generated consistent top quartile returns since 2009\. **OUR PHILOSOPHY** We are champions of our investors’ goals and stewards of founders’ dreams, but more than that, we are ethical, honest partners who serve, educate, and protect our founders and investors. We take on the challenges and complex conversations because we operate out of integrity and genuine care. **ABOUT THE ROLE** BIP Capital's technology team is hiring a Junior AI Engineer to help bring large language models into the day to day work of an investment platform. You'll work directly with a Senior AI Engineer to add AI capabilities to our existing full\-stack applications, and to design and ship retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, agentic workflows, and prompt\-engineered LLM pipelines that real investment and operations teams rely on. This is an apprenticeship\-style role built for someone early in their career who is a strong full\-stack engineer first and genuinely curious about applied AI. You will not be expected to own architecture on day one. You will be expected to execute well, learn quickly, and take real work off the Senior AI Engineer's plate within your first few months **Office Environment:** Hybrid / On\-site (In\-office Wednesdays). **What you'll do** * Add AI capabilities to our existing full\-stack applications: new LLM\-powered features, workflows, and interfaces built directly into the products our investment and operations teams already use. * Build and improve RAG systems with a Senior AI Engineer, from chunking and embedding strategies through retrieval quality and evaluation. * Manage context windows and model inputs: decide what information a model actually needs, how to structure it, and when a task calls for a different model or a multi\-modal approach across text, documents, and images. * Help design agentic workflows when the problem calls for it, including multi\-step LLM pipelines, tool use, and orchestration. * Prompt\-engineer and evaluate LLM workflows, treating prompts and retrieval as things you measure rather than guess at. * Write clean, testable services and data pipelines that move information reliably between systems. * Translate fuzzy workflow needs from investment and operations colleagues into concrete technical problems. **Requirements** **What we're looking for** We weigh engineering fundamentals and trajectory far more heavily than years of experience or a specific pedigree. This is a product engineering role: we want a full\-stack engineer who is genuinely excited about building with large language models, someone who thinks naturally in terms of retrieval, embeddings, context windows, and tool use, and who wants to ship features real people use day to day. * Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or a related field. * Solid software engineering fundamentals in Node.js and TypeScript: REST APIs, async and promise\-based concurrency, a testing framework such as Jest or Vitest, and everyday comfort in git. Our front end runs on AWS Amplify, so familiarity there is a plus. Python is a nice to have, especially for RAG and data\-heavy work, but it is not our primary stack. * Exposure to cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS, including AWS's AI and LLM services such as Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, and Knowledge Bases for Bedrock. * Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar): function calling and tool use, structured outputs, streaming responses, and managing token usage and context window limits. * Hands\-on experience building something real with LLMs, ideally something you can point to: a project, prototype, or shipped feature you can walk us through, including what broke and how you fixed it. * Comfort designing LLM\-in\-the\-loop evaluation and testing pipelines: building golden datasets, using LLM\-as\-judge scoring, and writing regression tests for prompts and retrieval, with tools such as promptfoo, Braintrust, or Ragas. * Comfort with AI native development practices: using tools like Claude Code or Cursor as part of your everyday workflow, not as a novelty. * An instinct to measure. When you change a prompt, a retrieval step, or a model, your first question is “how do I know this made it better,” whether the answer is an eval score, a latency number, or a cost\-per\-call tradeoff. * Coachability and initiative: you can take a loosely specified task and make visible progress without needing every detail spelled out. * Clear communication. Our users are non\-technical investment and operations professionals. * Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor employment visas for this position, including candidates who would require sponsorship following F\-1 OPT/CPT. **Bonus points** * Working familiarity with RAG mechanics: chunking and embedding strategies, vector stores such as pgvector, Pinecone, or Weaviate, embedding model choice, hybrid search, and reranking. * Familiarity with an agent or RAG framework (LangChain.js, LlamaIndex, AWS Strands, or a current agent SDK), though we care more that you can learn one quickly than that you know today's flavor. * Experience shipping AI features inside a production full\-stack application, not just a standalone prototype. * Awareness of data sensitivity: why investor, deal, and LP information cannot flow into arbitrary public models. * Exposure to the Model Context Protocol (MCP), whether that's building MCP servers and tools or connecting agents to them. **Success metrics** * By 90 days: you're taking sprint tasks directly, running on a weekly 1:1 cadence with your Senior AI Engineer, and have shipped a medium\-significance contribution to an active RAG or agentic workflow project. * By one year: you own an increasing share of the day\-to\-day work on at least one RAG or agentic workflow component, with your Senior AI Engineer retaining design and review oversight, and you're a regular, hands\-on contributor to the eval and testing pipeline for the workflows you support. **How we work** You'll sit on a small, embedded technology team and apprentice closely to one Senior AI Engineer. We value people who ask good questions, ship working software, and can explain a complex idea simply. What you build gets used inside the firm, often within days **Benefits** **WHY JOIN US** * **Impact**: Build AI systems and autonomous workflows that directly influence investment decisions, portfolio growth, and firm efficiency. * **Innovation**: Be on the leading edge of applying AI/LLMs to venture capital workflows. * **Collaboration**: Work with a lean, entrepreneurial team of investors, technologists, and operators. * **Growth**: Opportunity to expand into broader AI/ML roles as the firm scales its technology platform. **WHY JOIN BIP CAPITAL** * **Top\-quartile Performance**: We are a leading venture capital firm in a vibrant tech ecosystem offering national prominence. * **Internal Growth**: We foster critical thinking and promote internal advancement from day one. * **Unique Value Proposition**: Our firm boasts a robust, defensible value proposition supported by a high\-net\-worth investor base. * **Merit\-based Environment**: We encourage you to bet on yourself, leveraging your merit to excel and thrive. * **Benefits**: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive salaries, health and wellness plans, retirement savings options, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and various employee well\-being programs. *BIP Capital is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics. BIP Capital is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status*.

jobs.title: Principal Reliability & Rotating Equipment Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary:** The Principal Reliability \& Rotating Equipment Engineer serves as the site's senior technical authority for rotating equipment and as the principal architect of the site reliability strategy determining how the refinery prioritizes its reliability investment, which equipment strategies are applied to which assets, and where the organization directs its improvement effort. The position is accountable for the reliability and mechanical availability of the refinery's rotating assets pumps, compressors, steam and gas turbines, blowers, fans, gearboxes, and their associated drivers, seals, couplings, and lubrication systems — and for the site\-wide reliability program surrounding them. The successful candidate will develop the reliability strategy and supporting tactics, own the asset condition management program, lead significant failure investigations, and build reliability competency across engineering, maintenance, and operations. This role is currently structured as a senior individual contributor position with substantial cross\-organizational influence and no direct reports. As the reliability program matures and the department is formalized, this position is the intended home for that leadership responsibility. **Key Responsibilities:** Reliability Strategy \& Program Development * Own \& lead the refinery in the Uptime Elements® Reliability Framework and Asset Management System Domains: Reliability Engineering for Maintenance, Asset Condition Management, Work Execution Management, Leadership for Reliability, Asset Management. * Develop, document, and maintain the site Reliability Strategy: a funded, measurable multi\-year plan addressing identified gaps in equipment availability, organizational capability, and technical competence. * Produce the annual Reliability Improvement Plan, including supporting tactics, resource requirements, cost, and expected return. * Define, maintain, and report the site reliability performance indicator set — availability, mean time between failure, mean time to repair, preventive maintenance compliance, schedule compliance, bad actor reduction, and asset condition management coverage and detection rate — through the monthly performance review. * Establish and maintain the criticality\-ranked asset register and the equipment criticality methodology that supports it, ensuring the site can demonstrate which assets carry the greatest consequence of failure and why. * Influence operating and capital expenditure allocation through the business planning cycle, including non\-routine maintenance, infrastructure renewal, and reliability\-driven capital projects. * Develop equipment strategies for critical and semi\-critical rotating assets, apply reliability\-centered maintenance principles, and adjust strategies based on demonstrated performance. Rotating Equipment Technical Authority * Serve as the site's senior technical resource for rotating machinery, including chronic failure resolution, repair\-versus\-replace evaluation, upgrade and re\-rate specification, and technical review of vendor and OEM recommendations. * Apply the governing industry standards — API 610, 611, 612, 613, 614, 617, 618, 670, and 682, together with applicable ASME, ANSI, and AGMA practices — and exercise sound engineering judgment where those standards do not fully address site conditions. * Lead machinery\-related Management of Change activity: develop scope, schedule, and budget, and deliver safe, reliable, fit\-for\-purpose rotating equipment designs. Mentor other performers through the MOC process and maintain technical quality standards for machinery sign\-off. * Establish and audit precision maintenance standards, including laser alignment, balancing, bolting, fits and clearances, seal and bearing installation, and contamination control, with verification performed in the shop and in the field. * Provide machinery engineering support to turnaround planning and execution, including scope development and challenge, critical\-path machinery work, quality plans, and start\-up support. Asset Condition Management * Own the condition monitoring program in full. * Manage route design and coverage, alarm and alert limits, technology selection, and analyst competency requirements, and ensure that condition findings translate reliably into planned and executed corrective work. * Manage the machinery lubrication program to a defined standard, addressing lubricant selection, contamination control, storage and handling practices, and condition\-based re\-lubrication intervals. * Advance operator driven reliability by incorporating basic care, inspection, and early\-fault detection into operator routes, and by ensuring findings from those routes are acted upon. Defect Elimination \& Causal Learning * Lead or sponsor structured causal investigations across all severity levels, from focused analysis of a repeat component failure through full multi\-discipline investigation of signific ne. * 12 years of progressive experience in refining, petrochemical, or comparable heavy process industry, with a substantial portion of that experience in rotating equipment and reliability engineering. * Demonstrated and verifiable reliability improvement results at the equipment, unit, or site level. * Comprehensive working knowledge of rotating machinery, including centrifugal and positive displacement pumps, centrifugal and reciprocating compressors, steam and gas turbines, mechanical seals and seal support systems, bearings, couplings, gearboxes, and lubrication systems. * Practical command of condition monitoring technologies, including the ability to interpret source data rather than rely exclusively on summarized reporting. * Direct experience facilitating root cause analysis and causal learning investigations. * Working knowledge of process safety management, Management of Change, and the process safety implications of machinery decisions. * Demonstrated CMMS proficiency (SAP PM, Maximo, or equivalent) and the analytical capability to develop independent analysis from maintenance history. * Strong written and verbal communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to develop and defend a plan before site leadership. * Legal authorization to work in the United States on a full\-time basis without employer sponsorship. Preferred * Certified Reliability Leader (CRL) through the Uptime Elements body of knowledge, or CMRP or CMRT certification. * Vibration Analysis Category II or higher (ISO 18436\-2\), Certified Lubrication Specialist, or Level II infrared thermography certification. * Experience establishing or rebuilding a reliability program rather than sustaining a mature one. * Turnaround machinery experience as a scope owner or field engineer. * Experience leading, mentoring, or supervising engineers and technicians, with demonstrated interest in progressing into formal leadership. * Professional Engineer license. * Familiarity with reliability modeling and analysis software and with API 580/581 risk\-based methods applied to fixed equipment. **Basic Requirements:** * Must be authorized to work in the United States permanently on a full\-time basis without requiring sponsorship. * Must possess and maintain a current valid license to operate a motor vehicle in the United States. * Must be able to read, speak, and write English fluently. * Hold or be able to qualify to receive a Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) card \- Information may be found at https://www.tsa.gov/for\-industry/twic. * Adhere to site alcohol and drug standards including random drug screenings * As part of the pre\-employment selection process, candidates are required to submit to and receive satisfactory results from all pre\-employment background checks including but not limited to drug screening (including a hair sample), medical evaluation, and reference checks. FLSA Status: Exempt Work Schedule: 9/80 work schedule Hiring Manager: Reliability, Maintenance \& Projects Manager Expected Start date: By end of 2026 **About Vertex Energy:** Vertex Energy is a leading energy transition company that specializes in producing high\-purity refined fuels and products. Our innovative solutions are designed to enhance the performance of our customers and partners while also prioritizing sustainability, safety, and operational excellence. With a commitment to providing superior products and services, Vertex Energy is dedicated to shaping the future of the energy industry. **About the Site:** The Vertex Refining Alabama Site is a 24/7 manufacturing plant in Saraland, Alabama that specializes in the production and distribution of refined products. It employs approximately 180 full\-time staff, including both hourly and salaried employees. The United Steelworkers Union (USW) represents the hourly workforce. **Posting Disclaimer:** We reserve the right to amend, provide exceptions to or withdraw this posting at any time.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description: \*\*Software Engineer \*\* \*\*Location: \*\*Grandview Heights, OH \*\*About the Position \*\* ForgeNest is looking for a Software Engineer to help build the backend systems and services that power our next\-generation manufacturing platform, with enough front\-end fluency to help ship the interfaces those systems drive. As we move further into commercialization, the reliability and scalability of our backend, the APIs, data pipelines, and services connecting machines to software, becomes increasingly important. This role will own and develop the services, APIs, and data infrastructure that connect ForgeNest’s Universal Operating System to machines, sensors, and the applications operators, engineers, and customers use to interact with them. You’ll work directly with software engineers, robotics and controls engineers, manufacturing teams, and company leadership to design backend architecture, build reliable services and APIs, and contribute to the front\-end applications those systems power. \*\*Responsibilities \*\* * Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs supporting ForgeNest’s manufacturing platform. * Architect and maintain data models, databases, and pipelines for machine data, production data, and operational data. * Integrate backend systems with ForgeNest’s Universal Operating System, machine controllers, sensors, and third\-party tools. * Build reliable, secure, and scalable APIs consumed by front\-end applications and other internal systems. * Develop the backend logic and data services behind dashboards and visualization tools that provide real\-time insight into equipment status, production performance, and manufacturing workflows. * Partner directly with manufacturing, robotics, controls, and engineering teams to understand data and system requirements on the floor. * Participate in product architecture and technical design decisions as the platform continues to evolve. * Establish backend architecture, service design patterns, and development standards that support long\-term scalability. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve system performance and reliability in both development and live manufacturing environments. * Rapidly prototype new backend functionality based on feedback from customers, operators, and internal engineering teams. * Contribute to front\-end applications and components as needed, using JavaScript/TypeScript and React or similar frameworks, to help ship complete features. * Take ownership of features end\-to\-end, from backend design and data architecture through any necessary front\-end integration. \*\*Who You Are \*\* * A backend\-minded software engineer who also enjoys working across the stack when a feature calls for it. * Excited about designing clean, reliable services and data systems while understanding the machines and manufacturing processes that data represents. * Comfortable owning a system end\-to\-end, from data model to API, with enough front\-end fluency to see a feature through to the interface. * Able to communicate and collaborate across software, manufacturing, robotics, controls, and company leadership. * Motivated by building resilient infrastructure and seeing it power real\-world systems. \*\*Experience Requirements \*\* * Professional experience developing backend services, APIs, or distributed systems. * Strong proficiency with a backend language such as Node.js, Python, Go, or Java. * Experience designing and maintaining databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) and data models. * Experience building and integrating RESTful or event\-driven APIs. * Working proficiency with front\-end technologies, JavaScript and/or TypeScript and a framework such as React, sufficient to build or modify UI components. * Strong understanding of application architecture, service design, and state and data management across a stack. * Experience with real\-time or data\-rich systems such as dashboards, telemetry, or operational applications. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills across the stack. * Experience working collaboratively within a software development team. \*\*What You Bring \*\* * Strong ownership mentality and willingness to take features from concept through production. * Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-moving startup environment. * Curiosity about manufacturing, robotics, industrial automation, and physical systems. * Strong systems\-design instincts and attention to reliability, scalability, and data integrity. * Ability to simplify technically complex information without sacrificing functionality. * Comfortable picking up front\-end work when needed, even when it isn’t your primary strength. * Experience with manufacturing software, industrial automation, robotics, machine interfaces, or real\-time systems is a plus. * Experience with message queues, streaming data, or time\-series databases is a plus. * Interest in AI\-enabled software and how intelligent systems can improve physical manufacturing is highly valued. \*\*What Success Looks Like \*\* * Quickly develop an understanding of ForgeNest’s technology and backend architecture, and how engineers and operators interact with the platform. * Take ownership of major backend systems and services, improving the reliability, scalability, and performance of the software experience. * Help establish backend architecture and development standards capable of scaling alongside ForgeNest’s technology and customer base. * Build APIs and services that make it straightforward for front\-end teams, or yourself, to build reliable interfaces on top. * Become a trusted technical contributor as the software platform and engineering organization continue to grow. \*\*Why Join ForgeNest \*\* ForgeNest is a venture\-backed startup building an AI\-driven, software\-forward forging platform designed to modernize one of the world’s most critical manufacturing industries. By combining commercially available hardware with proprietary software, AI\-driven toolpath generation, and a next\-generation Universal Operating System, ForgeNest is transforming how forged metal parts are designed and manufactured across defense, aerospace, energy, maritime, and industrial markets. This is an opportunity to join a small, highly technical, high\-impact team developing dual\-use technology with real\-world applications where your work will directly influence the future of advanced manufacturing, automation, and industrial technology.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: Government technology has failed citizens, public servants, and service members for decades. Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses for counter\-drone procurement to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI\-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks and months, not years. This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies. Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital. We built an internal tool called Bidbuddy. Before it existed, someone on our team spent eight hours a week scraping procurement sites, pulling RFPs by hand, and reading them to figure out which ones were worth chasing. Now one system does the scraping and the first pass of analysis. Those eight hours went back to the people doing the actual work of winning. That's one tool. We need many more, and most of them don't exist yet. Kaizen is about 40 people supporting software that reaches 40 million residents across 50\+ agencies in 17 states, and the only way that math holds is if the company runs on tools instead of hours. This role owns that. You'll go department by department, find where the time goes, and build the thing that takes it back. Sometimes that's an internal app. Sometimes it's an automation nobody notices. Sometimes it's teaching a team to use AI properly, which is often the highest leverage thing available. Then you roll it out and stay on it until people actually use it. We already have the list, and it's long. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own internal tools end to end, from the hallway conversation that surfaces the problem through architecture, build, rollout, and the week two fixes. * Build AI powered internal systems in the mold of Bidbuddy: document parsing and analysis, agentic workflows, automated research and routing, and tooling that turns hours of manual work into minutes. * Work directly with leads across Proposals, Customer Ops, Sales, Design, and Engineering to find where the time is going, and translate half\-formed asks into something worth building. * Drive AI enablement across the company. Every person at Kaizen should know how to get the most out of these tools. * Support the external analytics layer inside Kaizen's platform, so customers have clear, actionable data at their fingertips * Back up the deployment team during an implementation **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 2 to 5 years of engineering, data, or applied AI experience, or work that makes the years irrelevant. Slope matters more than seniority * Something you built end to end that a team still uses today: an internal application, an automation, a tool that changed how people work. Not a prototype, not a demo * Genuine fluency with AI tools. You've shipped with them, not just explored them, and you can name where they failed you and how you caught it * Strong SQL and enough data modeling to work in an existing warehouse and ship a model when the job calls for it * The ability to take a vague problem from a non\-technical stakeholder and come back with the right scope, not the requested one * Low ego, high output. You do the unglamorous rollout work because that's what makes the build matter **Strong Candidates May Also...** --------------------------------- * Have built internal tooling at a company where the hard part was getting hundreds of people to change how they work * Come out of forward deployed or solutions engineering at an AI or developer tools company, where the job was making software work inside someone else's mess * Know N8N, Zapier, or similar deeply enough to have a view on when not to reach for them * Have built in government, healthcare, or another environment where getting it wrong has consequences **What Kaizen Offers** ---------------------- **Health \& Insurance** * 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents. * $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA. * One Medical membership, on us — same\-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city. * Fertility and family\-building support through Carrot. * 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match. **Family \& Time Off** * 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non\-birthing parents. * Unlimited PTO, with a two\-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!) * Closed for all federal holidays. * Company\-wide winter break the week of Christmas. * Company offsites throughout the year. **Office \& Remote Setup** * Up to $750 one\-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC\-based employees. $500 for remote employees. * $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution). * Expensed lunch while in the office. * Company\-provided laptop of your choice. **Wellness** * Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us. For remote employees, $100/month dedicated to gym or physical fitness reimbursement. **Stipends** * $100/month utility stipend. * $500/year professional development. * $250/year recreation. * $300/quarter pet care stipend. Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Edge & Field Systems
jobs.description: **About the team:** Mind Robotics is building robots that learn from real\-world experience — and the quality of that experience starts with how we collect and process data. Our field data collection system puts capture rigs on the factory floor at manufacturing sites, generating the raw sensor data that trains everything downstream. Our teleoperations program turns human demonstrations into high\-quality data that grounds our AI models in physical reality. Both flow through annotation and quality control into our training platform. **About the role:** As an Software Engineer on Edge \& Field Systems, you'll be one of the founding engineers on the team that owns our application layer, reporting to our Integration Manager. The systems work today; your job is to help harden and productionize them for scale — from 10 capture stations at one site to hundreds across multiple OEM plants, and from a handful of teleop stations to a multi\-shift fleet. This is early, hands\-on, 0\-to\-1 engineering: you'll ship code that runs on real hardware in real factories, and see its effect on robot behavior. **You will:** * Build the field capture stack — edge software for our data collection rigs: device management, sensor orchestration, and real\-time data quality monitoring that holds up on a factory floor, with workflows optimized for I/O\-, compute\-, and network\-bound constraints * Ship the teleop stack — collection, evaluation, and operator tooling for our teleoperation stations, including metrics, task management, and the workflows our robot operators use every day * Build and contribute to integration and validation testing for field software, including hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test setups that catch failures before they reach a live site * Build monitoring and dashboards that give visibility into fleet health, capture quality, and station uptime across sites, accounting for intermittent connectivity and bounded bandwidth in the field * Make deployment repeatable — build tooling and configuration systems that make onboarding a new manufacturing site a config change, not a custom engineering project, including device provisioning workflows * Support the field — debug issues on live systems, instrument for observability, and work directly with site operations staff and robot operators who depend on your software **Requirements:** * 2\+ years of software engineering experience building production systems * Strong programming fundamentals and comfort working across the stack — edge devices, services, and local data pipelines * Experience with at least one of: edge computing, device or fleet management, real\-time systems, robotics or sensor systems * Bias for ownership: you've taken features or systems from prototype to production and supported them in the field * Clear communication and close collaboration with product, research, and operations partners * Hands\-on experience with sensor data (video, depth, IMU, force/torque) and the infrastructure to collect and monitor it in real time is a plus * Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop or simulation\-based testing (e.g., Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MuJoCo) is a plus * Background in robotics, autonomous vehicles, industrial IoT, or teleoperation systems is a plus * Exposure to manufacturing or other industrial environments is a plus

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT KRAKEN KINETICS** Kraken Kinetics designs and manufactures advanced kinetic solutions that enable modern warfighting capabilities for the United States Armed Forces and its allies. We specialize in mission\-tailored warheads and firing systems for unmanned and autonomous weapon platforms, delivering production\-ready solutions at speed to address urgent national security challenges. Our team brings decades of specialized Department of War experience across the full lifecycle of kinetic system development—from concept and design through testing, manufacturing, and operational deployment. Built on a foundation of work that helped lead the DoW into the era of kinetic drones, Kraken Kinetics combines commercial agility with deep technical expertise to deliver **DEFINITIVE LETHALITY**when it matters most. **Position Summary** Kraken Kinetics is seeking a Systems Engineer II/III to support the definition, decomposition, tracking, and verification of system\-level requirements for advanced defense products. This role will serve as a critical bridge between customer needs, internal product objectives, engineering execution, test planning, and production transition. The Systems Engineer II/III will help mature Kraken’s systems engineering practices by developing requirements structures, interface documentation, verification matrices, and technical baselines that allow cross\-functional teams to move quickly with clarity. This role is ideal for an engineer who can bring structure to ambiguous technical problems while remaining practical, collaborative, and execution\-focused. **Roles \& Responsibilities** * Capture, decompose, and manage system\-level requirements derived from customer needs, internal product goals, SOWs, standards, and engineering constraints. * Develop and maintain requirements traceability matrices, verification matrices, interface control documents, and related technical artifacts. * Work with mechanical, electrical, firmware, test, and production teams to ensure requirements are clear, testable, and actionable. * Support architecture definition, trade studies, technical risk assessment, and system\-level decision\-making. * Coordinate with test engineering to ensure verification methods are defined and results are traceable to requirements. * Participate in design reviews, test readiness reviews, production readiness reviews, and failure investigations. * Identify requirement gaps, conflicts, assumptions, and risks early and drive resolution with stakeholders. * Support development of compliance documentation, verification evidence, and customer\-facing technical packages. * Help establish systems engineering processes, templates, review practices, and documentation standards. * Mentor junior systems engineers and contribute to stronger cross\-functional engineering execution. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 3\+ years of experience in systems engineering, product development, requirements management, verification planning, or complex technical program execution. * Experience developing, decomposing, and managing technical requirements. * Familiarity with requirements traceability, interface control, verification planning, and design review processes. * Ability to work effectively across mechanical, electrical, firmware, test, production, and program teams. * Strong technical communication skills and ability to translate ambiguous needs into actionable engineering work. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. * Ability to operate in a fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities and incomplete information. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in defense, aerospace, robotics, electronics, weapons systems, autonomous systems, or other high\-reliability product environments. * Familiarity with MIL\-STDs, safety\-critical systems, environmental qualification, or compliance\-driven development. * Experience with requirements management tools, configuration\-controlled documentation systems, or structured verification workflows. * Experience developing interface control documents, verification plans, compliance matrices, or system architecture documentation. * Experience supporting test planning, failure analysis, production transition, or customer technical reviews. * Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading systems engineering workstreams. * Experience in a small or rapidly growing engineering organization. **Benefits included**: * Generous PTO policy * Comprehensive medical coverage (80% company\-paid for employee \+ dependents). * Vision \& dental (100% company\-paid) * Short and long\-term disability coverage (100% company\-paid) * Generous 401(k) retirement plan * Company\-paid life insurance * Great teammates and well stocked snacks **LIFE IN MOORE COUNTY, NC (PINEHURST AREA)** Kraken Kinetics is based in Moore County, North Carolina, home to Pinehurst, a nationally recognized destination offering an exceptional quality of life. Employees benefit from a low cost of living, minimal congestion, and a strong sense of community, with easy access to larger metropolitan areas, including Raleigh\-Durham. Whether you're looking to accelerate your career or put down long\-term roots, the Pinehurst area offers a compelling alternative to traditional tech and defense hubs. We are committed to supporting relocation for the right candidates. **Watch what it’s like to live here:** \[ Video Link] **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** Kraken Kinetics is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The job** ----------- You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work. From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved. You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer. You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers. **About you** ------------- * You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job. * You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role. * You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum. * You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description: We operate a multi\-tenant automotive SaaS platform serving thousands of dealer groups across the United States. Our backend — event\-driven serverless on AWS — orchestrates everything from dealer onboarding to inventory management to real\-time transaction processing. That platform works. Now we need to make it think — and keep it modern, secure, and safe to ship. We also run a monolith that needs upkeep while we build the next\-gen platform and redesign its components, a few at a time, into microfrontends. This is a hands\-on engineering role at its core. Day to day you build, ship, and operate agentic AI systems — autonomous, tool\-using agents (AgentCore, MCP servers) that observe platform state, reason over dealer context, and take action through production APIs. But you are also the engineer who keeps the whole platform current and trustworthy: you continuously hunt and fix security vulnerabilities, upgrade the frameworks and runtimes underneath us, drive adoption of an agentic development harness to speed up delivery, and lead modernization of our existing systems. You work across the org, not inside one team's walls. You own production monitoring and the SRE practices that keep us reliable, and you are the champion for safe releases — defining the checks and balances that gate production, setting the engineering standards, and making sure they are actually enforced. When something misbehaves in production, your instrumentation, your guardrails, and your release discipline are what make it fail safe instead of fail loud. Reports to: SVP, Engineering. What You'll Own * Hands\-on agentic development — designing, building, and operating agentic AI systems (AWS Bedrock AgentCore, MCP servers) every day: agent code, tool interfaces, evaluation harnesses, and production AI workflows. * Driving adoption of the agentic development harness — making agent\-assisted development a first\-class way the org ships, and measurably improving speed of delivery across teams. * Security vulnerability management — continuously monitoring for vulnerabilities (dependencies, CVEs, container images, IAM/config drift), remediating quickly, and keeping frameworks, libraries, and runtimes patched and upgraded. * Platform modernization — creating and driving initiatives to modernize existing platforms: retiring legacy patterns, adopting current frameworks, and staying close to the leading edge. * Production monitoring \& SRE — owning observability (OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch), SLOs and error budgets, on\-call and incident response. * Third\-party integration observability — a standardized way to organize all third\-party integration calls, report on them with precision, and run anomaly detection on call volumes with continuous monitoring, so a spike, drop, or failure surfaces before it becomes an outage or a cost problem. * On\-call cookbook — keeping applications well documented so an on\-call engineer can quickly query a cookbook, understand the likely problem areas, and know where to look. * Release governance — champion across releases: defining and enforcing the checks and balances (CI/CD quality gates, security and test gates, rollback criteria, progressive delivery) required to move change into production. * Setting and enforcing engineering standards — establishing the patterns, guardrails, and review bar the org follows, and holding the line so they are consistently applied. * Working across the org — partnering with every engineering team to raise the technical, security, and reliability bar broadly. Tech \& Tools * Cloud: Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, ECS Fargate, Aurora, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager. * AI \& Agentic: AWS Bedrock AgentCore, MCP servers, LangChain/LangGraph. * Languages: Python and Java (Spring Boot), TypeScript/React (Next.js), legacy PHP/Laravel. * Security: Dependabot/Snyk, SAST/DAST, container image scanning, secrets management, IAM hardening. * Reliability \& Observability: OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, SLO/error\-budget tooling, PagerDuty, Datadog. * CI/CD \& Release: CircleCI, CloudFormation, progressive delivery, quality/security gates, rollback automation. * Integration Surfaces: REST, SOAP/XML, EventBridge, SES, Playwright. How You'll Use AI This is not a "we are AI\-curious" company. This is the role that makes agent\-assisted development the norm for everyone else — building and operating production agents, triaging CVEs and generating patch/upgrade PRs, driving framework upgrades, reviewing PRs across the stack, standing up observability, and drafting ADRs and runbooks. Hands\-On Expectations Roughly 60–70% building and operating, 20–30% on design and standards, and \~10% on cross\-team enablement. First 12 Months * Months 1–3: Immerse in the codebase, ship your first meaningful changes, audit our security posture, dependency/framework currency, and release pipeline, and publish a baseline of engineering standards and release checks. * Months 4–6: Ship agentic automation into at least one production workflow, roll out the agentic development harness, stand up the SRE baseline (SLOs, on\-call, dashboards), and automate vulnerability scanning and patching. * Months 7–9: Drive a modernization initiative end to end; harden the release gates and enforce them across teams. * Months 10–12: Measurable delivery\-speed gains from agentic adoption, production reliability against SLOs, and engineering standards adopted org\-wide. **Requirements** Must Have * 6\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2\+ years at a Senior or Staff level building and operating production systems. * Hands\-on agentic / LLM development (AWS Bedrock, MCP, LangChain/LangGraph) — or a strong, demonstrated track record of getting up to speed fast on modern frameworks. * Strong hands\-on experience with AWS serverless (Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, Step Functions) and traditional service architectures (ECS, RDS, API Gateway). * Security\-minded engineering — dependency and vulnerability management, timely patching/upgrades, and secure\-by\-default practices. * SRE practices — observability, SLOs/error budgets, on\-call, and incident response. * CI/CD and release management — quality/security gates, rollback, and progressive delivery. * Comfortable in at least two of Python, Java (Spring Boot), and TypeScript/React — and able to read and safely modify PHP. * A track record of setting standards and getting them enforced, plus the writing to make a design or standard clear enough for a peer to implement. Strongly Preferred * Experience running security tooling (Snyk/Dependabot, SAST/DAST) and observability/on\-call tooling (Datadog, PagerDuty) in production. * Automotive, fintech, or multi\-tenant marketplace platform experience. * Experience with data pipelines (Glue/Athena) or ETL/data\-lake tooling. * Familiarity with Auth0, or with browser automation (Playwright) in production integration flows. Role Specifics * Location: Denver, CO (hybrid, 2 days/week in office) or Remote (US, outside the Denver market). * Employment type: Full\-time. * Reports to: SVP, Engineering. Scope \& Scale * 5,000\+ destination dealer tenants, each with isolated databases and per\-tenant configuration. * Billions in annual GMV flowing through platform transactions. * Tens of thousands of API requests per minute across REST, SOAP, and event\-driven integration surfaces. * Data pipelines spanning 6 integration domains with multi\-protocol vendor connectivity. **Benefits** At A2Z Sync, we replace the friction of disconnected systems with the velocity of a single platform. We pride ourselves on a fun, casual, and collaborative culture, and we're committed to our employees' well\-being. * Employer\-Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance, starting on day one. * Flexible work: Denver hybrid (2 days/week in office) or fully remote anywhere in the US. * 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match. * Generous Paid Time Off: Unlimited PTO and 10 paid holidays. * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Coverage, fully employer\-paid. * Life and AD\&D Insurance, employer\-paid. * Free Mental Health Support via BetterHelp. * Pet Insurance options. * Identity Theft Protection. * On\-site gym in Denver, great co\-workers, and a stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages.

jobs.title: AI Agents & Automations Engineer

The role also involves working directly with clients to understand business processes, identify valuable automation opportunities, and turn them into reliable technical solutions. #### **Responsibilities** **AI agents \& production engineering:** * Design, build and deploy AI agents into live client environments with real users and real business data; * Previous experience in an agency or consultancy environment, working across multiple client projects; * Direct Selling industry experience is a plus, but not required. #### **We offer excellent benefits, including but not limited to** * The chance to join a fast\-growing AI consultancy at the point it's defining a category, with real client exposure from day one; * A permanent, fully remote role with a basic salary and the potential to participate in the share option scheme; * A seat at the table on how we evolve our methodology, our tooling and the way we work with clients. jobs.title: EXE Factory Quality Engineer: Production Engineering
jobs.description: **About ASML** At ASML, we are helping shape the future of technology. Our lithography systems enable chipmakers to produce the advanced semiconductors that power everything from smartphones and data centers to electric vehicles and AI applications. As part of our manufacturing organization in Wilton, CT, you'll play a critical role in delivering the quality and reliability that our customers depend on while working in a collaborative, innovative environment. **Introduction to the Job** --------------------------- As a Factory Quality Engineer, you will help ensure the quality and reliability of the technology that powers ASML’s advanced lithography systems. Your work will directly support the manufacturing of products that enable the world’s most advanced microchips. In this role, you will drive quality improvements, solve complex manufacturing challenges, and work across teams to strengthen processes that support consistent operational excellence. **Role and Responsibilities** ----------------------------- As a Factory Quality Engineer, you will serve as a key quality partner within the manufacturing organization. You will lead investigations, identify improvement opportunities, and help create sustainable solutions that improve product and process quality. * Lead root cause investigations and drive corrective and preventive actions for quality issues. * Analyze process performance data and recommend improvements to increase stability and product quality. * Conduct measurement system evaluations and support improvements to measurement accuracy and reliability. * Lead quality reviews and facilitate discussions that drive resolution of complex manufacturing issues. * Maintain risk assessments and update quality documentation based on process changes and lessons learned. * Support quality audits, assessments, and compliance activities while ensuring timely closure of identified gaps. * Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, supplier quality, and other stakeholders to improve operational performance. **Education and Experience** ---------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, optical engineering, chemical engineering, industrial engineering, mechatronics, physics, or a related technical field. * 2\+ years of relevant experience with a bachelor’s degree, or relevant internship experience with a master’s degree. * Experience in manufacturing, quality engineering, process engineering, or a related technical environment. * Experience using statistical analysis methods, quality management systems, and structured problem\-solving techniques. * Knowledge of process control, failure analysis, risk assessment methodologies, and data analysis tools. * Six Sigma Green Belt certification is preferred or willingness to obtain certification. **Skills** ---------- Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems. To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills: * Apply analytical thinking to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. * Lead structured problem\-solving efforts and drive actions to completion. * Communicate technical information clearly to diverse audiences. * Build collaborative relationships across manufacturing, engineering, and quality functions. * Influence stakeholders and gain alignment without direct authority. * Use data to make informed decisions and recommendations. * Manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Demonstrate initiative and proactively address emerging challenges. **Other information** *This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). jobs.description: **We Are** Accenture is a leading solutions and services company that helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed across the enterprise, bringing together the talent of our approximately 800,000 people, our proprietary assets and platforms, and deep ecosystem relationships. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to be the most client\-focused, AI\-enabled, great place to work in the world. Through our Reinvention Services we bring together our capabilities across strategy, consulting, technology, operations, Song and Industry X with our deep industry expertise to create and deliver solutions and services for our clients. Our purpose is to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity, and we measure our success by the 360° value we create for all our stakeholders. Visit us at **www.accenture.com**. There is never a typical day at Accenture, but that’s why we love it here! This is an extraordinary chance to work in a digitally driven, innovation\-led environment where you can help clients in their own reinvention journey. As you build a rewarding career at Accenture, you’ll have the opportunity to work with leading\-edge technologies and take on some of the coolest projects you can **ABOUT ACCENTURE SECURITY** Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond to, and recover across all points of the security lifecycle. We arm our people with the industry's coolest tools, cutting\-edge technology, and a global network of elite talent to help clients build lasting cyber resilience. Our approach blends risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security, and managed service solutions to rethink what security looks like in an increasingly complex industrial world. Our OT Security practice works at the intersection of operational technology and cybersecurity—helping critical infrastructure owners across energy, utilities, oil \& gas, manufacturing, water, and life sciences defend what matters most. **The Work** As an OT Cybersecurity Consultant, you will lead and support hands\-on security engagements across industrial environments. You will assess, design, and help implement security solutions across OT/ICS ecosystems—working directly with client engineers, operators, and security teams to reduce risk without disrupting operations. You are equally comfortable in a substation, a control room, and a boardroom. Beyond client delivery, you will contribute as a subject matter expert on active pursuits—helping Accenture win new OT security work while maintaining excellence on your own engagements. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Conduct OT/ICS security assessments against frameworks including NERC CIP, IEC 62443/ISA\-99, NIST CSF, DOE C2M2, and client\-specific requirements * Evaluate client security posture across the Purdue Model layers—identifying gaps in network segmentation, remote access, asset inventory, and detection coverage * Deploy and configure OT\-native security tooling including network security monitoring platforms (e.g., Dragos, Claroty, Nozomi) and asset discovery tools (e.g., Dragos, RunZero, NetRise) * Perform OT\-specific threat hunting, indicator of compromise analysis, and incident response support in ICS/SCADA environments * Develop detailed security assessment reports, risk registers, and remediation roadmaps tailored to operational and business context * Support OT security program development including governance frameworks, policies, and procedures aligned to client maturity goals * Collaborate with client IT/OT teams, system integrators, and OEM vendors to drive practical security outcomes * Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on active OT security pursuits—contributing to RFP responses, solution reviews, and proposal content while balancing client delivery commitments * Contribute to Accenture's OT Security practice through reusable assets, methods, and delivery excellence across engagements Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements. **Here's what you need** * Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in OT/ICS environments (e.g., electric utilities, oil \& gas, manufacturing, water/wastewater, power generation, natural gas, life sciences, data center OT) * Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience with ICS technologies including SCADA, DCS, EMS/ADMS, RTUs, PLCs, HMIs, and industrial communications protocols * Minimum 3 years of cybersecurity experience including vulnerability management, identity and access management in OT contexts, and monitoring/incident response * Minimum 3 years of experience with common ICS/OT protocols (Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850, PROFINET, OPC, EtherNet/IP, etc.) * Minimum 3 years of experience producing and presenting security deliverables, assessment reports, and findings to technical and executive audiences *   vision, life, and long\-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off. jobs.title: Commissioning Agent
jobs.description: Join a Team Where Engineering Excellence Drives Opportunity At Affiliated Engineers, Inc. (AEI), we bring together expertise and innovation to solve the most complex challenges. Since 1978, we’ve supported mission\-driven organizations in designing systems and environments that advance society and improve lives. Today, with more than 1000 professionals across 23 offices, we help shape the future of healthcare, science and technology, energy, education, and other vital sectors. From elevating patient care in Mayo Clinic’s world\-class hospitals to enabling discovery in high\-containment laboratories for U.S. agencies and driving environmental progress with Microsoft’s renowned Thermal Energy Center, our work enriches the human experience, safeguards the environment, and pushes the boundaries of possibility. AEI consistently earns national recognition from leading industry publications, including Building Design\+Construction, Engineering News\-Record, and Consulting\-Specifying Engineer, with distinctions such as being named the \#1 Laboratory Engineering Firm in the nation and receiving multiple Best of the Best Project awards, underscoring the lasting legacy of our work. At AEI, you’ll join a collaborative community where your expertise fuels innovation, your ideas drive progress, and your work helps shape a brighter future. As a Commissioning Agent in our Phoenix office, you will help us empower our clients to achieve energy\-efficient building solutions, save global environments, and create a better, greener future for all. **Here’s why we need you:** In this role, you will be responsible for resolving commissioning challenges and completing tasks assigned, including developing and implementing commissioning process delivery plans from information set forth in Owner’s Project Requirements (OPR), Basis of Design (BOD), plans and specification construction documents, as well as information gathered from users, project partners, field surveys, and code research. **Expertise of our most successful Commissioning Agent:** * Technical or Associate Degree in HVAC, mechanical, plumbing, electrical, or architectural design, or construction engineering from an accredited technical institution or college; or commensurate design or construction experience. * General understanding of building systems across disciplines including fire protection, HVAC, electrical, and plumbing/piping. * Knowledge of and ability to interpret codes, guidelines and standards related to commissioning, design and construction. * Experience in computer operation and ability to learn engineering calculation programs, computer\-aided drafting/BIM software for the purpose accessing and interpreting design requirements. * Valid driver’s license and state required vehicle insurance. **Effective skills to help you flourish:** * Commissioning certification with a nationally recognized professional body. * Ability to combine personal judgment with a wide variety of data and information to implement commissioning criteria. * Ability to work well in a team environment, including carrying out appropriate follow\-through with others, giving and receiving constructive feedback. * Communicates well with clients, project partners and with individuals at all levels in the organization. * Ability to apply safety training to specific construction situations and avoid unsafe work environments. * Ability to understand and safely use test and measurement equipment and common tools. * Experience in diagnosing and solving construction and operational problems. * Strong spoken and written communications skills. * Excellent organization and time management skills. * Quick technical comprehension and motivation focused on client outcomes. * Ability to prioritize multiple tasks. * Effective working individually and within team environments. **When you work here, you can expect:** * A flexible, collaborative environment where your well\-being matters—because your best work happens when you’re supported. * Real opportunities to grow—through mentorship, professional development programs, and exposure to high\-impact projects across disciplines. * To collaborate with inspiring teammates who challenge the status quo, foster innovation, and pave the way for future leaders. * A benefits
