ability to remain calm under high pressure. * Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy, MBS/Elements). * Effective verbal and written communication skills, especially in shift handovers and incident documentation. * Willingness to work the third shift and weekends/holidays as needed. * Willingness to be part of a rotating on\-call. * Must have demonstrated competency in all lower levels of job responsibility. * Troubleshoot network (Data \& Voice) incidents in a timely fashion. * Prioritize network issues by severity and escalating to the appropriate level, as necessary. * Resolve customer incidents via multiple communication outlets. * Must have good customer service and organizational skills. * Maintain status updates to internal and external customers until incidents are resolved. * Perform various steps to verify levels and coordinate with Field Operations. * Ability to learn and retain information in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to multitask efficiently and work independently and as a team while maintaining quality service. * Respond to customer requests and provide timely communication as defined by our department’s policies. * Experience using MS Office Suite and SharePoint. * Knowledge of Telnet, SSH, RDP, and WebHTTPS is required to access devices and utilize web and CLI interfaces. * Must maintain and/or exceed company QA scores. * Possess the ability to take on new, demanding challenges. * Demonstrate the ability to assume new levels of responsibility and deal with them effectively. * Ability to accurately identify circuit types and the solution of how they are delivered. (ie, internet, transport, managed, and voice services) * Conduct RFC and performance testing, adhere to SLA and MTTR policies and standards. * Knowledge and experience with the ability to identify and troubleshoot faults on network\-related devices such as xDSL modems, network interface devices, Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, firewalls, routers, microwave radios, voice (VoIP, SIP, PRI, hosted voice, and analog voice services) daily. * Solid background using VISIO, Network Monitoring Software, and incident management systems. * Basic knowledge of dynamic routing protocols and technologies. * Basic knowledge of layer 2 switching technologies such as Q\-in\-Q, s\-tag, c\-tag, and STP. * Ability to assist field personnel with hardware replacement. * Ability to confirm and/or perform firmware upgrades to network devices. * Knowledge of network switching functions: LNP, CNAM, CALEA, STIR/SHAKEN, etc. * Ability to analyze, summarize, test, and solve issues with VoIP and TDM services, SIP, SS7, and ISDN messaging. * Ability to manage assigned tasks with minimal supervision. * Ability to monitor and analyze alarms via the NMS system and create tickets in the incident management system accordingly in a 24/7 environment. * Assist the NOC Change Management team, as required, in determining customers impacted and the effects during network maintenance and grooming. * Perform any other duties assigned by the NOC supervisor or manager. * Assist in training as needed.

Our consulting practice covers utilization reviews, upgrades and implementations, integrations, and support and training. Our software supports shop floor and warehouse optimization, data collection, time and labor, labeling, and analytics, with an installed base of hundreds of customer sites. The systems we work in are Infor LN, Baan, Infor LX, BPCS, Infor M3, and Infor XA. Our clients are discrete and process manufacturers, small and mid\-size, domestic and international. We are a small, well\-established firm headquartered in Oak Brook, Illinois **Benefits for Senior Consultant Roles** ---------------------------------------- * Competitive salary * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Life and accident insurance * 401k with profit sharing * Paid time off ### **Programmer Analyst, Infor LN and Baan** This is a build role. You will design and develop solutions in Baan IV, Baan V, and Infor LN, using standard components where they fit and writing custom where they do not. You will also support our existing customer base and work alongside our product manager on pre\-sales and development. #### **What you will do** * Analyze client requirements and design solutions from standard or custom components * Develop in Baan IV, Baan V, and Infor LN * Lead and project manage implementation work * Support the product manager on pre\-sales, development, and implementation * Build intranet and extranet integration applications * Support existing customers * Perform unit and system testing * Provide onsite consulting as needed #### **What you bring** * BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience * 3\+ years as a Baan or Infor LN programmer analyst or business analyst * 2\+ years with SQL * Very strong customer service skills and experience * Strong analytical skills and a track record of solving hard problems independently * Self\-motivated, and able to move between independent work and team work * Demonstrated project management ability #### **Helpful, but not required** * Web services development * C\# .NET development Location Chicago Suburbs, Illinois (Corporate HQ) — Remote and Hybrid options available Experience 3\+ years Reports To Consulting Manager

jobs.title: Data & AI Program Manager
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a Data \& AI Program Manager to support a Fortune 100 technology company. This role sits at the intersection of data strategy and applied machine learning, owning the end\-to\-end data lifecycle that fuels natural language processing (NLP) applications and large language model (LLM) development. You'll define what "good data" looks like for a range of NLP use cases, build the guidelines and pipelines to get there, and partner closely with data engineering, data science, and ML teams to turn high\-quality annotated data into measurable model performance gains. This is a full\-time position (W2 or 1099 is fine). You would be employed by Cyborg Mobile but placed with our client working full\-time there and reporting to a manager there. We're looking for someone who is a self\-starter, self\-sufficient, and able to execute with little direction. This is a remote position (Washington candidates preferred). **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Conduct market and user research to understand data needs and expectations across various NLP applications and domains * Define data specifications, scope, and sourcing strategy for each use case and domain * Design judgment guidelines and instructions for data annotation, validation, and quality control * Deliver datasets, schemas, guidelines, and annotations that meet approved specifications, scope, and sourcing requirements * Manage the end\-to\-end data annotation process * Analyze data quality metrics (accuracy, consistency, coverage, and diversity) and turn findings into actionable recommendations * Implement approved data quality improvement actions * Collaborate with client data engineers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers to integrate annotated data into production pipelines, support LLM fine\-tuning, and evaluate model performance and impact * Identify data gaps and opportunities; propose new data sources, methods, and features to improve data quality and model outcomes * Communicate data vision, strategy, and results to internal and external stakeholders, including product owners, engineers, researchers, customers, and partners * Prepare and deliver data reports, presentations, and demos using client\-approved formats and channels **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Experience in NLP data strategy, annotation program management, or a related data quality/linguistics role * Strong understanding of data annotation workflows, guideline design, and inter\-annotator quality control * Familiarity with LLM training/fine\-tuning pipelines and how annotated data feeds model evaluation * Analytical mindset with the ability to translate quality metrics into concrete improvement plans * Excellent stakeholder communication skills — comfortable presenting to both technical and non\-technical audiences * Experience working in large, matrixed corporate environments **Must Haves** -------------- * Customer centric * Good with follow through * Has skills to build Agents, PowerBI dashboards, Sharepoint list management, coding agents like Codex, Claude Code, Github copilot

jobs.title: People & Culture Advisor (HRBP)
jobs.description: **DCI Engineers** Join DCI Engineers as a **People \& Culture Advisor (HRBP)**, partnering with office leaders to support a consistent, high\-quality employee experience across our regional offices. In this role, you’ll contribute to key People \& Culture initiatives while helping ensure our people programs scale effectively as we grow. **What You’ll Do:** In this role, you’ll work closely with office leaders and the People \& Culture team to support day\-to\-day operations, enhance employee programs, and improve processes that impact how we attract, onboard, and support our employees: * **Support recruiting efforts** by managing job postings, screening candidates, and helping ensure a consistent and positive candidate experience * **Partner with offices to coordinate interviews** and maintain a seamless, organized hiring process * **Support onboarding efforts** to ensure a smooth and welcoming new hire experience, including offer preparation, onboarding logistics, and new hire communications * **Contribute to employee engagement initiatives**, including wellness, recognition, and other programs that enhance the employee experience * **Lead exit interview coordination and support offboarding processes**, helping capture insights to inform improvements to the employee experience * **Help identify and implement improvements to People Ops processes** to support consistency, efficiency, and scalability across offices * **Partner with and advise office leaders** on performance management and employee relations matters, helping navigate challenges and support effective, people\-centered decisions * **Support benefits administration**, including new hire orientations and the annual open enrollment process * **Coordinate recruiting and outreach activities**, including career fairs and university engagement * **Track and manage key People Ops programs**, such as referral bonuses, volunteer time off, and donation matching **What You Bring:** To succeed as a **People \& Culture Advisor**, you bring a combination of strong execution, sound judgment, and a people\-centered mindset: * 2\-4 years of HR Generalist experience. * Ability to build relationships and effectively partner with team members and leaders. * Strong judgment and ability to navigate sensitive situations with discretion. * Interest in improving processes and contributing ideas. * Ability to anticipate, identify, and resolve problems in a timely manner. * Excellent writing and communication skills. * Proficient in the use of Outlook, MS Suite, and Adobe. * Experience with HRIS and ATS software, and hiring platforms, such as LinkedIn and Indeed. * Ability to maintain composure in a fast\-paced environment; juggle competing tasks and demands in the midst of frequent change, delays, or unexpected events. **Why DCI Engineers** At DCI Engineers, how we work together is just as important as the work we produce. Since our founding nearly 40 years ago, we’ve believed that strong relationships, shared knowledge, and a commitment to excellence are what set us apart. Our culture is grounded in a set of core values that shape how we show up every day: * **Entrepreneurial** – We take initiative, think beyond the status quo, and embrace a “we can figure it out” mindset. * **Collaborative** – We create a connected experience across teams and offices, where people feel supported and can learn from one another. * **Resilient** – We adapt, learn, and grow stronger through challenges, continuously investing in our people and capabilities. * **Creative** – We encourage new ways of thinking—not just in our engineering work, but in how we support our employees and build our programs. * **Community\-Oriented** – We foster a sense of belonging by building strong internal relationships and supporting the communities where we live and work. * **Trust\-Driven** – We earn trust through accountability, strong performance, and doing what we say we will do. Through our People Operations team, we’re focused on creating a consistent, thoughtful employee experience—from onboarding through career growth—while partnering closely with offices to support their unique needs. If you’re excited about shaping employee experiences, supporting teams, and contributing to a collaborative and people\-centered culture, you’ll find a strong fit at DCI. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Competitive salary \+ overtime earning opportunities * Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance * Tax\-advantaged savings account options * Company\-paid Life, AD\&D, and Long\-Term Disability * Voluntary Short\-Term Disability, Life, AD\&D, and supplemental coverage * 401(k) with annual company contribution * 8 paid holidays (including 1 floating holiday) * Paid vacation and sick leave * Paid parental leave * Commuter benefits (where available) * Health \& Fitness Program * Cell phone benefits * Seminar and licensing reimbursements

jobs.title: Pipeline Operations Engineer II
jobs.description: At DT Midstream (DTM), we’ve got the energy to achieve great things! DTM owns and operates a diverse, integrated portfolio of midstream pipeline, storage and gathering assets, allowing us to provide a comprehensive set of midstream services to our customers across the Southern, Northeastern and Midwestern United States and into Canada. DTM is an energy industry leader with more than 20 years of proven success, and our focus is to be safe, caring, dependable and efficient in all we do. **Job Summary** The Pipeline Operations Engineer is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of pipeline systems and related facilities. This role provides technical expertise for pipeline operations, system optimization, integrity management, maintenance planning, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives. The engineer collaborates with cross\-functional teams to ensure operational excellence while maintaining the highest standards of safety, environmental stewardship, and asset performance. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Monitor and optimize pipeline system performance to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient transportation of products. * Support daily operations by providing engineering guidance, project management, scheduling support on maintenance activities, and troubleshooting technical issues. * Update and maintain regulatory pipeline records for ongoing operations. * Manage the maintenance pigging program. Activities encompass scheduling, validating, inspecting condition and inventory management of pigs and replacement parts. * Support pipeline integrity management programs, including inspections, risk assessments, corrosion mitigation, corrosion monitoring and remediation planning. * Assist in reliability centered maintenance and asset lifecycle planning activities. * Provide operational input to project engineering on pipeline projects, well connects, and pipeline expansions. * Investigate equipment failures, incidents, and operational anomalies to determine root causes and corrective actions. * Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to pipeline reliability and integrity. * Work with the system planning group to evaluate pipeline capacity, hydraulic performance, and operating conditions. * Participate in hazard analyses, incident investigations, and regulatory audits. * Promote a strong culture of safety and environmental responsibility. * Identify and implement process improvements that enhance compliance and operational safety. * Review engineering designs, specifications, and construction plans. * Conduct hydraulic modeling, pressure analysis, and operational studies. * Support commissioning, startup, and operational readiness activities. * Develop technical reports, engineering calculations, and recommendations. * Develop dashboards, reports, and metrics to support decision\-making. * Lead or participate in process improvement initiatives focused on reliability, efficiency, and cost reduction. ### **Required Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or Petroleum Engineering * 5\+ years of engineering experience in pipeline operations, midstream operations, energy, or related industries. * Knowledge of pipeline operations, maintenance, and integrity management principles. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Heavy field\-level or direct operations experience preferred. * Knowledge of SCADA systems, control systems, and operational technology. * Familiarity with pipeline regulations and industry standards. **Other Requirements** ---------------------- * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Knowledge of pipeline systems, pumps, compressors, valves, and related equipment. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical data. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and engineering software tools. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration abilities. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced operational environment. * Strong commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence. **Working Conditions** ---------------------- * Combination of office and field\-based work. * Regular travel to pipeline facilities, terminals, compressor stations, or operating sites.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About EarnIn** As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks. We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey. **POSITION SUMMARY** We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our AI/ML platform team. You'll train, deploy, and evaluate models that power user\-facing financial products — from predictive models over transaction and behavioral data to agentic applications built on large language models. Your work will support EarnIn's mission to provide fair and intelligent financial tools to millions of users. The base salary range for this full\-time position is $187,000–$229,000, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This is a hybrid position in Mountain View (Headquarters) and will require in\-office work 2 days a week. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Develop and train ML models — including sequence, embedding, and classification models — on large\-scale financial and behavioral data. * Build feature and data pipelines that turn raw event data into training\-ready datasets, and keep training and serving features consistent. * Design offline and online evaluation for models and agentic workflows: success metrics, backtests, A/B tests, error tracing, and regression suites. * Take models to production and own them there — serving infrastructure, latency and cost tuning, retraining loops, and monitoring for drift and performance degradation. * Fine\-tune and adapt LLMs for internal use cases, and build the orchestration around them: prompting, memory and context pipelines, retrieval, and tool integrations. * Build backend services and RESTful APIs in Python that expose models and agentic applications to internal tools and product surfaces. * Instrument pipelines for observability — logging, tracing, and distributed monitoring across model and agent workflows. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with ML engineers, data scientists, and product to shape intelligent and safe AI features. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience * 2\+ years of industry experience building and shipping ML systems. * Strong Python and hands\-on experience with PyTorch and the standard ML stack (NumPy, pandas, scikit\-learn). * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar tools) as part of your software development workflow * Solid grounding in ML fundamentals: model architecture choices, training dynamics, regularization, and how to diagnose a model that isn't learning * Experience with large\-scale data processing (Spark, Databricks, or similar) and feature engineering on production data. * Experience designing evaluation for ML systems and LLM behavior — metrics, automated checks, offline test harnesses, and behavioral regression suites * Working knowledge of LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude), prompt engineering, and at least one agentic framework or custom equivalent. * Experience with API design, async workflows, and production database usage (SQL or NoSQL). * Clear communication and a collaborative mindset. * Experience with LLM fine\-tuning using frameworks such as Unsloth, Axolotl, LLaMA\-Factory, or HuggingFace PEFT/TRL, including parameter\-efficient methods (LoRA/QLoRA) is a plus * Experience with distributed training or representation learning is a plus. * Familiarity with MLOps tooling for experiment tracking, feature stores, or model registries (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, Feast) is a plus. * Familiarity with vector stores (e.g., Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant) is a plus * Knowledge of OpenTelemetry or similar observability frameworks is a plus * Exposure to container\-based deployment or serverless environments (Docker, AWS Lambda, etc.). * Background in fintech, fraud, risk, or credit modeling is a plus \#LI\-Hybrid At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. EarnIn is an E\-Verify participant. EarnIn does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third\-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.

jobs.title: Senior ColdFusion Developer
jobs.description: ERG is a research and consulting firm that provides a wide range of support to federal, state, and commercial clients. ERG offers multidisciplinary teams with nationally recognized skills in engineering, science, economics, public health, informational technology, and communications. We hire people with the best minds and then provide them with a vibrant and flexible environment in which to develop their careers. The qualified individual must be highly motivated with the skills to prioritize, perform, and communicate effectively in a fast\-paced environment. We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Developer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining robust ColdFusion applications while collaborating closely with Business Solutions and IT teams. This role requires strong expertise across the full software development lifecycle and solid technical skills in ColdFusion, database programming, and web technologies. ### **Job Description:** * Design, develop, and enhance ColdFusion\-based applications * Write and optimize SQL scripts, queries, stored procedures, and functions for Oracle databases * Design and implement Server database objects including tables, views, indexes, and triggers * Conduct application testing and debugging to ensure quality and performance * Develop and maintain front\-end components using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and modern JS framework * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support system implementation and resolve incidents following government lifecycle processes * Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation. Provide ongoing application support and enhancements based on business needs ### **Qualifications and Skills:** * Minimum of 10 years of overall experience in software development with B.S or B.A degree * Minimum of 10 years developing \& supporting ColdFusion applications * 5 years’ experience coding using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and JavaScript framework (ReactJS or Vue JS) * 4\~5 years’ experience writing SQL queries and stored procedures that integrate with ColdFusion applications * Experience in designing and modifying Oracle server databases * 3Experience with modern development processes * Ability to pass a public trust\-level background investigation as part of the credentialing process to work for our federal clients * Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills * Ability to manage multiple tasks and work in a fast\-paced environment ERG offers competitive salaries and excellent benefits, including health and dental insurance, life insurance, long\-term disability, educational benefits, FSAs, a generous 401k plan, profit sharing, an EAP, 11\-20 paid vacation days per year, 10 paid holidays per year, 56 hours or more of sick leave (based on the state you work in) per year (pro\-rated for part\-time) and more. The salary range for all positions depends on the years and type of experience. ERG is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable EEOC regulations. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual preference, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Please be aware, the only authentic corporate domain for ERG is https://www.erg.com. ERG may, on occasion, screen applicants via telephone or video interviews via Skype, Teams, GoToMeeting, or another type of video platform. However, any candidate extended a job offer might be asked to meet in person with an ERG employee before providing confidential personal information associated with new employment. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources via email at Resumes\-Lex@erg.com or call (781\) 674\-7293\. ERG fosters a friendly, flexible work environment. ERGers are dedicated to serving clients who are committed to making the world a better place. We promote and recognize principles of fairness and respect in the work we do, the partnerships we foster, and the culture we value both within and outside of our organization.

jobs.title: Outside Plant Engineering Specialist
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY:** The primary function of the Outside Plant Engineer Specialist II is to plan and prepare drawings for construction of new, and removal or rearrangement of existing, overhead, surface\-mounted, or underground lines, cables, conduits, and transmission systems to obtain optimum, economical, and legal location and operation of communications facilities by performing the following duties. This position efficiently uses corporate resources by applying the appropriate engineering practices and procedures for outside plant design and construction. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES, FUNCTIONS \& KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** *(include but are not limited to)* * Collects and records geographic subscriber growth on a routine basis and the performance of growth forecast * Prepares proposed facility schematics for use in feeder and distribution facility design * Performs job cost estimates related to Outside Plant Engineering projects for feasibility purposes upon request * Assists in activities related to facility percent utilization monitoring * Prepares construction drawings and procure and file right\-of\-way permits * Inspects work quality and quantity both during and after those outside plant construction projects assigned by the Outside Plant Engineering Supervisor * Completes performance of acceptance testing and final document material tabulations necessary for contract close\-outs * Maintains Continued Property Records, in particular, those associated with outside plant facilities * Ensures staking and installation of outside plant facilities comply with tariff, FCC, NEC, and other regulatory agency requirements * Assists departmental budget preparation related to proposed and planned construction projects * Maintains a clean and safe workplace in and around a subscriber's home or business * Assists OSP Engineering Supervisor in planning and coordination of all Outside Plant Facility construction and rearrangement activities * Inspects truck equipment such as tires, lights, brakes, gas, oil, and water and performs emergency roadside repairs such as changing tires * Other duties as assigned **KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS:** * Stimulates morale among fellow employees by example of behavioral conduct * Works to maintain and enhance the public image of the organization * Adheres to and encourages adequate safety practice * Reports violations of safety to Central Office Facilities Manager immediately * Uses corporate resources effectively and efficiently to perform all job\-related duties * Readily accepts criticism to job performance with the intention of diligently seeking improvement upon those areas * Continuously evaluates own performance to identify areas need improvement, then takes appropriate actions to improve **BEHAVIORS:** * Upholds and acts in accordance with REV’s Guiding Principles. **EVALUATION:** Performance of this job will be evaluated in accordance with procedures established by the company on the evaluation of management personnel. **QUALIFICATIONS \& PREREQUISITES** **Required:** * High School diploma or general education degree (GED) * Basic drafting skills with the ability to read, interpret, and update outside plant construction drawings, maps, and facility records * Basic understanding of fiber optic outside plant construction practices, including aerial, buried, underground, conduit, handhole, and pedestal placement * Ability to identify and document fiber routes, splice locations, pole attachments, slack storage, drops, and related construction requirements * Ability to perform field reviews, collect accurate site information, and verify construction conditions for fiber build\-outs and facility rearrangements * Working knowledge of safety practices related to outside plant construction, utility locating, work zones, and field inspections * Ability to communicate clearly with contractors, internal departments, supervisors, and other stakeholders regarding fiber construction requirements and project status **Preferred:*** Three to five years of related outside plant engineering, fiber construction, telecommunications, or utility construction experience and/or training * Equivalent combination of education, technical training, and related field experience * Experience in the telecommunications industry, with emphasis on fiber\-to\-the\-home, fiber backbone, middle\-mile, or distribution fiber construction projects * Experience preparing or reviewing fiber design packages, staking sheets, construction prints, as\-built documentation, and material estimates * Familiarity with GIS mapping systems, CAD or drafting software, fiber management systems, and construction tracking tools * Knowledge of permitting, right\-of\-way, make\-ready, pole attachment, joint\-use, and utility coordination processes * Understanding of fiber splicing, testing, OTDR results, loss budgets, and acceptance documentation * Experience coordinating with construction contractors and inspecting completed fiber construction for compliance with company standards and project specifications **GENERAL INFORMATION:** This job description does not restrict the company’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job at any time. This job description is subject to change at any time.

jobs.description: Company Summary: EchoStar is reimagining the future of connectivity. Our business reach spans satellite television service, live\-streaming and on\-demand programming, smart home installation services, mobile plans and products. Today, our brands include Boost Mobile, DISH TV, Gen Mobile, Hughes and Sling TV. Department Summary: Our Manufacturing teams are the gatekeepers who ensure our groundbreaking products meet the standards of innovation and performance we pride ourselves on. From the engineers who design large\-scale production systems and cutting\-edge quality assurance tools to the hands\-on associates who manage our massive inventory flow, they make up a diverse group of behind\-the\-scenes team members dedicated to the success of our organization. Job Duties and Responsibilities: The Senior Engineer is a self\-directed role that is responsible for driving and developing projects while mentoring peers. This individual will support a culture of continuous improvement to drive solutions that will reduce waste through innovation. **Key Responsibilities:*** Launches new product and processes * Provides direct engineering support to operations covering all aspects of assigned process or area of responsibility * Applies Lean Manufacturing concepts to continually improve efficiency of manufacturing processes * Designs and implements testing methodology * Prepare and maintain documentation * Works with vendors and manufacturers to design and develop products and implement a cost\-effective design * Engages in the typical responsibilities of a manager requiring planning, evaluating, organizing, integrating, and controlling * Analyzes designs and implements improvements to facilitate manufacture at lowest cost consistent with results desired * Designs electrical or mechanical equipment, components, systems, instruments, and products * Defines and directs projects to identify and implement continuous yield and process improvements leading to cost effective, high quality, high yield world class manufacturing capabilities * Relies on data collection and analysis, experience, and judgment to plan and initiate change, and accomplish goals * Coordinates manufacturing, installation, maintenance, and testing activities to ensure compliance with specifications, codes, and customer requirements * Estimates cost of labor, materials, equipment, construction, etc. * Enforces standards, policies, and procedures This list is not meant to be a comprehensive inventory of all duties and responsibilities assigned to this position and other duties may be assigned. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, ability to adjust focus, read and interpret documents and instructions; frequent identification of letters, numbers, and symbols in a warehouse or office environment. This position may require sitting for long periods of time at a workstation. The employee must have the ability to use a keyboard and equipment typically found in a warehouse or office work setting. Individuals must have the ability to lift 45 lbs. and stand for long periods of time. **Work Environment:** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. jobs.title: Overhead Transmission Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** ============== Overhead Transmission Engineer **Location:** ============= Charlotte, NC **Job Summary and Description:** ================================ ### **Break Out of the Office. Prove the Science. Shape the Grid.** ### **Are you ready to move beyond routine modeling and step into a role where fundamental engineering principles are tested, challenged, and proven in the real world?** ### **At EPRI, our Overhead Transmission team isn't just following industry standards—we are defining them. We are an elite group of established subject matter experts (SMEs) dedicated to solving the power sector's most critical design and reliability questions through** **hands\-on empirical testing and full\-scale experimental evaluation** **.** ### **If you thrive on creative problem\-solving, curiosity, and practical discovery, this is where your expertise directly shapes the resilience, safety, and modernization of global energy infrastructure.** ### **Why Join EPRI’s Overhead Transmission Team?** * ### **Hands\-On Empirical Science:** **Move past theoretical assumptions. We design creative, novel test methods to evaluate the real\-world characteristics, mechanical limits, and thermal performance of transmission assets, conductors, and hardware.** * ### **Deepen Your Engineering Core:** **Master fundamental mechanical and electrical engineering principles by observing physical systems under stress. You won’t just analyze data—you’ll architect the experiments that generate it.** * ### **Unrivaled Network \& Fast\-Tracked SME Status:** **Build technical authority fast. Collaborate directly with a vast global network of utility leaders, world\-class testing labs, manufacturers, and academic researchers.** * ### **High\-Visibility Industry Impact:** **Lead initiatives that directly influence grid reliability, emergency restoration strategies, advanced conductor adoption, and international design standards.** ### **What You’ll Do** * ### **Innovate \& Solve Complex Challenges:** **Identify critical industry gaps and engineer creative solutions for grid reliability, asset degradation, extreme weather resilience, and grid modernization.** * ### **Lead Applied jobs.title: Full Stack Developer / Product Engineer - ON SITE
jobs.description: Full\-Stack Developer / Product Engineer **Public\-Posting Performance\-Based Hiring Profile** **Build the whole product. Own the outcome. Pivot fast without losing momentum.** **LOCATION** Scottsdale, Arizona \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site **SCHEDULE** Flexible start within the 7:00 a.m.\-6:00 p.m. work window **COMPENSATION** $100,000\-$130,000 base, depending on demonstrated capability **ROLE MIX** Approximately 50% front\-end / 50% back\-end development **CORE STACK** Python back end \| TypeScript front end \| AWS \| APIs \| Practical AI integrations **This is not a ticket\-taking developer role.** Envita is looking for a true full\-stack builder who can move comfortably between front\-end and back\-end development, take an incomplete request from a non\-technical stakeholder, clarify what actually needs to be built, and carry the solution through production. The role is approximately 50/50 front end and back end, with Python as the primary back\-end language. AI is an important part of the environment, especially practical AI and API integrations, but this is not a machine\-learning role and we do not want someone who relies on AI without understanding the code, architecture, risks, or output. **Position Purpose** ==================== The Full\-Stack Developer / Product Engineer will build secure, reliable, cost\-conscious products across Envita business units. The role requires strong full\-stack range, direct stakeholder communication, rapid learning, practical AI integration experience, and a high degree of self\-direction. A defining requirement is the ability to pivot immediately when business priorities change while preserving the state, visibility, and restart point of every other active project. **Why This Opportunity Stands Out** =================================== * End\-to\-end ownership from requirements and architecture through build, integration, deployment, testing, and production follow\-through. * True full\-stack scope with meaningful work on both the user\-facing front end and the Python back end. * Direct access to the people using what you build, including clinicians, pharmacy and laboratory operators, business leaders, and executives. * Practical AI work, including AI\-provider APIs and AI\-enabled product features, without requiring machine\-learning specialization. * Variety, autonomy, and visible business impact across multiple Envita entities rather than one narrow product lane. * A flexible daily start window designed to support an on\-site Scottsdale work environment. **What Exceptional Success Looks Like After the First Year** ============================================================ Envita leaders can bring this engineer an important business problem and trust that it will be clarified, translated into a practical technical solution, built across the full stack, deployed securely, and supported with clear status and documentation. The engineer is equally credible in front\-end and Python back\-end work, uses AI and external APIs intelligently, understands and can explain the code they ship, and is known for being able to change direction quickly when the business requires it without allowing lower\-priority projects to disappear or restart from zero. **SMART Key Performance Objectives** ==================================== These outcomes define success in the role. Demonstrated capability and comparable accomplishments matter more than years of experience, prior title, or exact framework overlap. **1\. Deliver the First Full\-Stack Product Fast** -------------------------------------------------- **Required outcome:** Take an assigned project from the initial stakeholder conversation through requirements clarification, front\-end and Python back\-end development, API integration as needed, testing, and production deployment. Target a meaningful demo by approximately day 21 and a production\-ready release by approximately day 45\. **Evidence of success:** The stakeholder confirms the solution solves the intended problem; the engineer can explain the architecture and code; appropriate testing, authentication, secrets handling, logging, and production controls are in place; and the solution operates reliably after launch. **2\. Pivot on a Dime Without Losing Momentum** ----------------------------------------------- **Required outcome:** Operate effectively across multiple active projects while being able to immediately redirect attention when leadership or business needs change. When one project becomes critical, shift the majority of effort to it without allowing other work to become invisible, confused, or difficult to restart. **Evidence of success:** Priority changes are acted on quickly; stakeholders are informed; paused work has a documented current state, next action, blocker, and restart point; the critical project accelerates; and previously active projects resume without unnecessary rework or loss of context. **3\. Own Requirements From Ambiguity to Agreement** ----- modeling using Postgres or a comparable database, including schema design, indexing, transactions, and safe migrations. * REST/API design and integration experience, including authentication/authorization, validation, versioning, idempotency, structured errors, and reliability concerns. * Hands\-on AWS deployment ownership, including IAM/access control, secrets, networking fundamentals, logs/observability, and cost awareness. * Application\-security fundamentals, especially authentication vs. authorization, injection/XSS awareness, secret handling, transport security, least privilege, and sensitive data. * Unit and integration testing as a normal part of development, plus confidence standing up test coverage in existing or lightly documented systems. * Git fluency and the ability to navigate an unfamiliar repository and determine what the code actually does. * Meaningful practical AI experience, preferably integrating AI/LLM capabilities through APIs or building AI\-enabled product features. Machine\-learning model development is not required. * A recent, specific example of learning a new language, SDK, API, framework, or platform under deadline and successfully shipping with it. **What Separates Top Performers** ================================= * **Priority Agility:** Can change direction immediately when business priorities change, make the new priority successful, and preserve clean restart points for everything temporarily deprioritized. * **Full\-Stack Range:** Is genuinely comfortable delivering both user\-facing front\-end work and production Python back\-end services. * **AI Judgment:** Uses AI where it improves speed or quality, but never substitutes AI output for understanding, verification, security, or accountability. * **Requirements Discipline:** Asks clarifying questions before coding, confirms understanding, and avoids building the wrong thing quickly. * **Self\-Direction:** Creates structure when structure is light, keeps multiple projects visible, and escalates conflicts before they become surprises. * **Ship\-Quality Judgment:** Moves quickly while knowing which shortcuts are acceptable and which are not, especially around security, sensitive data, authentication, data integrity, and cost. * **Constructive Communication:** Explains choices and trade\-offs clearly and responds to changed priorities without defensiveness or loss of follow\-through. **The Environment** =================== This role is best suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, variety, speed, and incomplete problems. Requirements may arrive verbally. Priorities can change during the week or during the day. An engineer may be progressing several projects and then be asked to focus almost entirely on one urgent initiative. Success requires flexibility without chaos: make the pivot, communicate it, preserve the state of the other work, and keep commitments visible. There may not always be a mature product\-management process, complete design handoff, dedicated DevOps support, or perfect documentation waiting before work begins. **Culture and Working Style** ============================= * Patient and business impact comes before technology for technology's sake. * Integrity, humility, gratitude, learning agility, respectful collaboration, confidentiality, and accountability matter in how the work gets done. * Strong performers are comfortable receiving direct feedback, revisiting assumptions, and changing course when the evidence or business priority changes. * We value people who are curious, dependable, solution\-oriented, technically accountable, and willing to own the consequences of their decisions. **Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ Envita Medical Centers of America is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and considers qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **About the Role** Support Fanatics Collect's Unified Experience initiative, building seamless collector journeys across Fanatics Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, Topps, and future experiences. Today a collector can win a card in a live show, rip a pack, buy on the marketplace, and store it all in a vault — but those moments still feel like separate products. Your job is to make them feel like one. That means building the shared surfaces, APIs, and front\-end systems that connect experiences that were each built independently, and doing it without slowing any of them down. This is a hands\-on senior role. You'll own meaningful slices of the unified experience end to end — schema to API to UI — and you'll do it alongside a Staff Backend Engineer, mobile engineers, product, and design. **Why Join Us** Fanatics Collect is growing fast, and the unification work is the highest\-leverage engineering investment we have: every new app, drop, and live format gets easier once the shared foundation exists. You'll work across mobile, web, and internal tools, with real autonomy and a short path from idea to production. Your teammates are passionate about the space and most of them are collectors themselves. **Product Context and Scale** Our surfaces reach millions of collectors across iOS, Android, and web, with live, high\-traffic moments (breaks, drops, auctions closing) that make performance and reliability non\-negotiable. You'll be working in a landscape of multiple existing products with real users and real data, so migration, backward compatibility, and careful rollout are part of the craft. **First 90 Days** * Ship a meaningful, user\-facing piece of the unified experience end to end. * Build a working map of how Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, and Topps actually fit together today — data models, identity, entitlements, and the seams between them. * Establish working relationships with the backend, mobile, product, and design partners you'll depend on. * Identify one piece of duplicated or divergent logic across surfaces and make the case for consolidating it. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain fullstack features using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and TypeScript. * Build scalable, performant, highly available services and interfaces on AWS and Vercel. * Own features end to end: data model, API contract, front\-end implementation, tests, rollout, and post\-launch metrics. * Build and maintain reusable front\-end components, APIs, and shared libraries that multiple apps (web and mobile) depend on — and treat other engineers as first\-class consumers of what you build. * Contribute to cross\-surface concerns like shared identity, entitlements, inventory, and navigation between collector experiences. * Ship behind feature flags with instrumentation in place, and use the resulting data to decide what to keep, fix, or cut. * Prototype quickly with Product and Design when a working demo will settle a debate faster than a document. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, LLM\-backed workflows) to raise your own throughput, and share what works with the team. * Write meaningful tests across the stack — unit, integration, and E2E — using Playwright, Jest, React Testing Library, and Pytest, and keep CI/CD pipelines trustworthy. * Maintain component documentation and interaction specs via Storybook. * Participate in sprint planning, retros, and product strategy sessions; raise scope and sequencing concerns early rather than at the end. * Mentor engineers through code review and pairing, and raise the bar on code structure, testing, and documentation. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of professional fullstack development experience, with demonstrated proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Python, plus hands\-on cloud experience (AWS preferred). * Strong grasp of architectural patterns, API design, and application performance tuning — and the judgment to know when a simpler solution is the right one. * Track record of owning features end to end in production, including the parts after launch: monitoring, debugging, and iterating on real user behavior. * Solid front\-end fundamentals: responsive UI development, accessibility (a11y), and front\-end performance practices. * Experience with state management patterns and tools such as React Context, Zustand, Redux, or XState, and a thoughtful approach to complexity in large apps. * Strong testing discipline with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Pytest. * Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices. * Comfortable working across domains — backend APIs, customer\-facing web, mobile web, and internal tools — and context switching without dropping threads. * Clear written and verbal communication; able to work directly with Product, Design, and other engineering teams and drive alignment on your own work. * Experience using or a genuine appetite for AI developer tooling to improve velocity. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have** * Experience integrating or consolidating multiple existing products, including data migrations against live users. * Experience with high\-traffic, real\-time, or live\-event product surfaces. * Background in growth engineering or rapid experimentation frameworks. * Experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, or gaming live ops. * Design system or shared component library ownership. * Passion for collecting, trading, sports, or gaming — and an interest in being a user of what you build. If you like owning problems end to end, care about how software feels and not just whether it works, and want your work used daily by millions of collectors — we'd love to talk. *Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers* By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Director, Mainframe CICS/MVS Performance and Capacity
jobs.description: ### **Job Description:** **Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.** **Director, Mainframe CICS/MVS Performance and Capacity** **Mainframe Capacity and Performance** **Primary Domain** CICS/MVS Performance and Capacity ### **Business Overview** The Fidelity Mainframe Capacity and Performance team is responsible for capacity modeling and forecasting, performance analysis, system configuration tuning, monitoring, and L2/L3 problem determination supporting Fidelity’s large IBM z Systems infrastructure. The team supports critical online and batch applications across the enterprise and works closely with business partners, Mainframe Hosting, DBMS, CICS, MQ, Storage, Network, application teams, IBM, and other strategic vendors. This role is focused on the CICS and MVS/zOS performance and capacity domain, including CICS region behavior, transaction and program\-level performance, online response time, WLM and dispatching behavior, GP/zIIP utilization, batch and JES interactions, storage/I/O considerations, workload growth forecasting, stress\-test assessment, modernization measurement, and production resiliency. The role requires both deep hands\-on technical expertise and the ability to translate complex performance and capacity findings into clear business, resiliency, and cost recommendations for senior leadership. ### **Position Description** The Associate will focus on leading CICS and MVS/zOS performance and capacity analysis for Fidelity’s mainframe environments, providing end\-to\-end analysis, modeling, tuning recommendations, and strategic guidance for complex multi\-tier applications running on z/OS and using CICS, MQ, WAS, DB2, batch, VSAM, storage, network, and cloud\-to\-mainframe integration patterns. A major responsibility of this role is to lead and/or participate in the capacity and performance analysis of new technologies and production changes that affect online and batch workload behavior. This includes developing KPI projection models, analyzing application and infrastructure change impacts, assessing failover/failback behavior, evaluating CICS/MVS configuration choices, and driving practical recommendations that balance customer experience, resiliency, platform capacity, operational simplicity, and software/hardware cost. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. The Director is expected to guide engineers and partner business application teams through high\-severity incidents, performance reviews, stress\-test findings, modernization measurement, and ongoing capacity routines. The role also requires executive communication skills, vendor engagement, and the ability to influence application, infrastructure, and architecture decisions using data. ### **Primary Responsibilities and Skills** * Lead CICS and MVS/zOS performance and capacity analysis across production, non\-production, and business\-event scenarios including market open, batch, stress testing, cloud failback, large release windows, and modernization events. * Analyze CICS transaction, region, program, file, VSAM, DB2, MQ, WAS, DDF\-adjacent, and application flow behavior to identify response\-time drivers, CPU consumption, wait time, bottlenecks, saturation points, and resiliency risks. * Assess MVS/zOS subsystem and platform configuration opportunities including WLM policy, PR/SM weighting, LPAR logical CP and zIIP configuration, dispatching behavior, memory/real storage, JES/batch interactions, CF considerations, DASD/FICON, and I/O path behavior. * Perform transaction, program, job, STC, ASID, region, and application\-level analysis for high CPU, elongated response time, increased get/put activity, access\-path or routing changes, batch elongation, and regression findings from QA/stress\-test cycles. * Partner with application, DBMS, CICS, MQ, WAS, storage, network, modernization, and operations teams to connect performance symptoms to end\-to\-end application topology, failover behavior, transaction mix, business volume, and customer impact. * Use SMF, RMF, CICS/DBMS logs, SYSVIEW, IntelliMagic, OMEGAMON, Strobe/iStrobe, Broadcom tools, MXG/SAS, Grafana, Power BI, SQL, Python/R, JCL, REXX, and related tools to build objective performance findings and recommendations. * Develop forecasting and capacity models that connect business KPIs, transaction volumes, CPU/zIIP consumption, MSU/MIPS impact, batch demand, CICS region demand, middleware behavior, and application modernization activity. * Lead production incident analysis and problem Core Competencies * Passion for workflow automation and operational transformation. * Ability to analyze complex business processes and design scalable technical solutions. * Strong ownership mindset with a focus on delivering business value. * Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to work optimally across engineering, operations, and business teams. * Continuous learning mindset and adaptability to new technologies and platforms. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills. * Commitment to high\-quality software engineering and operational excellence. ### **Why This Role Matters** Workplace Investing is transforming how operational processes are designed, automated, and delivered. In this role, you will directly contribute to Fidelity's digital transformation efforts by building modern workflow solutions that simplify complex business processes, reduce manual effort, improve scalability, and enhance operational resiliency. field teams for tooling supplies, rentals and freight * Responsible for purchasing tool center materials and products * Liaison between field teams and tooling for scope and schedule * Create new digital toolkits in Tooling system when requested from site projects * Identify process improvements and recommend solutions * Participate in User Acceptance Testing sessions for new system functionalities as required * Complete required, annual safety training * Ability and willingness to work holidays, weekends and overtime as required by field assignments * Travel may be required * May be assigned other duties to help proactively drive our FieldCore vision and align with our organization’s core values. **Required Qualifications \& Experience**: * High school diploma or organizational skills * Ability to manage multiple priorities/tasks simultaneously and work well under pressure, in a fast\-paced environment * English Proficiency Required **Desired Characteristics:** * Bachelor’s degree **Physical Requirements (EU Excluded)** * Must be able to see and move throughout warehouse to resolve work problems and facilitate processes; repetitive motion activities may be involved. * Frequent walking, standing, bending, kneeling, and squatting. * Ability and willingness to handle repetitive weight up to 40 lbs. **Compensation and Benefits:** The hourly wage range for this position is $21\.63 to $35\.67\. Employees may be eligible for overtime. FieldCore benefits include insurance (medical, dental, vision, disability, and life), retirement savings, health and Wellness reimbursement, and a bonus or incentive program. jobs.title: Information Technology Internship (Summer 2027)
jobs.description: Overview: **Overview:** Imagine joining a talented global technology team for an industry\-leading investment firm committed to mentoring and developing early IT talent. It's an exciting time to join Fisher Investments as a summer intern; we're investing heavily in the future of our firm's technology and information security. Fisher Investments is looking for Information Technology Interns to support important project\-based assignments that impact our growing business. **The Opportunity:** During our 10\-week, paid summer internship program, you will receive hands\-on training, project\-based assignments, and dedicated mentorship to support your development as an Information Technology professional in the financial services industry. You will learn new technologies and help improve existing tools and standards as we move to our new technology platforms. Project based work may include: * Build automated reports using a variety of Information Technology (IT) systems. * Build templates/guidelines/standards for work intake and execution. * Develop, review, and edit documentation on software development practices and standards. * Develop or modify common code, integration, and security tools. * Capture and document solution requirements. * Contribute to programming specifications, logic flow charts and process diagrams. * Test and debugs work. * Assist with the support of infrastructure systems. In addition to training, you will participate in regular professional development activities where you will have the chance to engage with firm leaders, learn about the culture at Fisher Investments, and network with peers. **The Day\-to\-Day:*** Participate in industry\-leading training courses in the classroom and on\-the\-job training. * Contribute to assigned project work that will build essential skills supporting future business value. * Collaborate and engage with fellow interns through projects and competitions. * Participate in professional development programming to enhance your overall skills. * Develop competencies required for success in future opportunities in information technology positions within the firm. **Your Qualifications:** * Attending an accredited university graduating between December 2027 and August 2028\. * Knowledge of MIS systems, including Service Now, Jira, or similar tools, CRM. * Experience with developing software applications, integrations, and automation tools. * Ability to relocate and attend in person for 10 weeks at Fisher Investment in Camas, WA or Plano, TX. Additional qualifications may include:* Knowledge of various programming languages (C\#, .Net, SQL, DAX, etc.). * Knowledge of reporting tools, such as Power BI. * Knowledge of automation and test data management tools such as Test Complete Pro, NeoLoad, or GenRocket. * Knowledge of automation, configuration management, and deployment tools in cloud platforms, such as Azure. **Program Dates:*** Camas, WA: June 9 – August 13, 2027 * Plano, TX: May 24 – July 30, 2027 **Compensation:** * $20 an hour for 10 weeks at 40 hours per week * Eligible for a discretionary relocation stipend **Why Fisher Investments:** At Fisher Investments, we work for a bigger purpose: bettering the investment universe. From unmatched service to unique perspectives on investing, it's the people that make the Fisher purpose possible. We take great pride in our inclusive culture. We value the different perspectives and unique skills you bring to the team – it makes us all better. Success at Fisher Investments is motivated by results, a collaborative mindset and a commitment to accomplishing great things – so if you are ready to do that, we are ready for you! Apply today to be a part of a team environment where you make a difference in the lives of people by bettering the investment universe. FISHER INVESTMENTS IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER \#LI\-DNI

jobs.title: Manager, Data and Analytics
jobs.description: Location: Everett, WA (3 days in office) The Manager, Data and Analytics leads the data and analytics team within the CIO organization, with accountability for delivering trusted data products, reporting, and AI models that inform measurable business decisions. This role manages the analytics and AI modeling backlog, the datasets and pipelines those products depend on, and the day\-to\-day delivery practices of a team of analysts, data scientists, and data engineers. The manager partners closely with business stakeholders and with platform and engineering teams to translate business questions into analytics and modeling work, and to ensure models are validated, monitored, and used responsibly in line with enterprise governance. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead a team of data analysts, data scientists, and data engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and capability development. * Deliver business productivity via AI models forecasting, propensity, risk, demand, and anomaly detection from problem framing through validation, deployment, and ongoing monitoring. * Own the analytics and AI modeling roadmap for assigned business areas, sequencing work against stakeholder priorities and available team capacity. * Translate business questions into analytical problems, defining hypotheses, success criteria, and the data required to answer them. * Manage intake and prioritization of analytics and modeling requests, including feasibility assessment, effort sizing, and expected business benefit. * Build and maintain trusted datasets, pipelines, and metric definitions that support reporting, self\-service analytics, and model features. * Own data quality and documentation for the team's data products, ensuring consistent metrics across reporting and models. * Deliver decision\-ready dashboards and self\-service reporting, retiring redundant reports and eliminating duplicate metric definitions. * Establish standard work for the analytics lifecycle, including version control, code review, model documentation, testing, and reproducibility. * Monitor deployed models for accuracy, drift, and business impact, and retrain or retire models as conditions change. * Partner with Security, Privacy, and Legal so that data use, model use, and access controls follow enterprise policy and responsible AI standards. * Manage tooling and vendor usage within the team's approved footprint and provide input into platform and licensing decisions owned by the platform organization. * Provide clear status, risk, and results reporting to senior leadership, including value delivered and delivery KPIs such as on\-time delivery, cycle time, model performance, and adoption. * Define what is out of scope and hold the line (e.g., no modeling work without a named business owner and a defined decision it will inform; no production models without documentation and monitoring). **Role Characteristics** People\-management role with direct accountability for the delivery of analytics and AI modeling work, Reporting to the Director of HR Technology (Engineering \& Platform), this position sits at the intersection of HR systems, enterprise integration, and AI innovation, leading architecture decisions across Oracle HCM Cloud, Boomi, ServiceNow HRSD, Eightfold, LMS platforms, and the broader IT landscape. This role is the primary technical authority for HR platform architecture — defining how systems connect, how AI augments HR workflows, and how data flows reliably across the enterprise. The architect partners closely with HR Product Owners, IT/Enterprise Architecture, and vendor teams to deliver scalable, future\-ready solutions that support Fortive’s operating companies and HR functions globally. **Core Technology Landscape** * Oracle HCM Suite * Boomi Middleware * ServiceNow HRSD * Eightfold AI Platform * LMS Solutions * Integration APIs * Power BI Reporting * Oracle Analytics **Key Responsibilities** **1\. HR Systems \& Platform Architecture** * Own the end\-to\-end architectural design of Fortive’s HR technology landscape, including Oracle HCM Cloud (Core HR, Payroll, Talent, Compensation, Benefits), ServiceNow HRSD, Eightfold, and LMS platforms. * Develop and maintain architectural blueprints, data flow diagrams, and modernization roadmaps aligned to cloud\-native, API\-first principles. * Establish design standards, governance frameworks, and best practices across the HR tech portfolio. * Partner with IT’s Azure\-based infrastructure teams to ensure HR systems align with enterprise architecture standards and security posture. **2\. Integration Architecture \& Engineering** * Define and drive integration strategy across HR systems, moving from point\-to\-point patterns toward reusable, API\-first services. * Lead architecture and hands\-on implementation using Boomi (atoms, molecules, connectors, process routing) as the primary middleware platform. * Design scalable integration patterns — real\-time APIs, event\-driven integrations, and batch/file\-based flows — connecting Oracle HCM to Eightfold, LMS, payroll, benefits, and IT/ERP systems. * Maintain data integrity, auditability, and compliance (GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA) across all integration flows. * Supervise and guide integration developers through the full development lifecycle, including code reviews, design reviews, and documentation standards. **3\. AI Solutions \& Automation** * Identify and deliver high\-value AI and automation use cases across the HR lifecycle — intelligent onboarding, workflow automation, AI\-assisted case triage, talent insights, and conversational self\-service. * Architect and implement AI capabilities within Oracle HCM Cloud, Eightfold’s talent intelligence platform, and ServiceNow HRSD. * Build and prototype solutions leveraging HR\-specific AI platforms, taking ideas from POC to production. * Embed AI/ML, NLP, and chatbot capabilities into HR workflows and digital employee experience channels, aligned with enterprise AI governance standards. * Establish AI performance monitoring and responsible AI frameworks for HR use cases. **4\. Data Architecture \& Governance** * Design HR data models, master data management (MDM) strategies, and data lineage documentation in partnership with Data Engineering and BI teams. * Enable secure, governed access to HR data for analytics (Power BI, Oracle Analytics). * Define and enforce HR data contracts, quality standards, and privacy controls across all systems and integration points. **5\. Stakeholder Leadership \& Collaboration** * Serve as the primary technical advisor to HR leadership, Product Owners, and IT on HR technology architecture, AI strategy, and platform decisions. * Translate complex architecture and AI concepts into clear business outcomes tied to KPIs and strategic priorities. * Provide technical guidance on vendor selection and partnership for Oracle, ServiceNow, Eightfold, and integration tooling. * Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, L\&D, Total Rewards) to embed AI capabilities within HR programs. **Qualifications** **Required** * 10–12 years of progressive experience in HR technology and enterprise systems architecture. * Must be available to work full U.S. Eastern Time (EST) hours each day. * Deep expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud, including integrations, HCM Extracts, Security, and configuration across at least three functional modules. * Proven experience with Boomi or a similar enterprise integration platform (Dell Boomi preferred), including building and supporting production integrations. * Strong understanding of integration patterns, including REST and SOAP APIs, event\-driven architecture, synchronous and asynchronous processing, and data transformation. * Demonstrated success designing and deploying AI/ML and automation solutions within HR or other enterprise business systems. * Exp lieve in us.
