jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description: **OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY** Fox TV Stations FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11\. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad\-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV \& mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.**JOB DESCRIPTION** ------------------- **JOB DESCRIPTION** ------------------- FOX Television Stations owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations in the U.S. These include stations located in 14 of the top 15 largest designated market areas, or DMAs, and duopolies in 11 DMAs, including the three largest DMAs (New York, Los Angeles and Chicago). Of these stations, 18 are affiliated with the FOX Network. In addition to distributing sports, entertainment and syndicated content, our television stations collectively produce approximately 1,200 hours of local news every week. These stations leverage viewer, distributor and advertiser demand for the FOX Network’s national content. JOB DESCRIPTION KTBC Fox 7, a Fox\-owned and operated TV station in downtown Austin, TX, is seeking a full\-time customer service\-focused and team\-oriented Maintenance Engineer. The Maintenance Engineer is responsible for installing, operating, and maintaining video, audio, and other television broadcast and non\-broadcast equipment, including data networks including SMPTE ST 2110 standards, production control switchers, audio mixers, automation systems, routing switchers, server\-based record and play\-out systems, non\-linear editors, encoders, decoders and multiplexers, newsroom computer systems, media streaming systems, and RF transmission equipment. Responsibilities include: * Provide paramount customer service and collaboration with other departments. * Collaborate with an astute engineering team to design, install, test, and document new systems and equipment as assigned. * Manage and maintain data networks while conforming to our Information Security Team's strict policies. * Perform minor repairs and maintenance to all systems supporting broadcast operations for live and production events. * Accurately troubleshoot and repair technical faults quickly to minimize loss of service. * Perform software and hardware updates, tests, and installation as required. * Provide technical assistance and training to the technical operating staff on day\-to\-day operations and workflows. * Practice, teach, and encourage best engineering standards and practices. * Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications and Requirements: * Applicant must have the ability to solve complex problems and the capacity to concentrate for long periods. * Must have a solid working knowledge of broadcast and network systems. Experience in RF and fiber optic workflows is desirable. * Applicant must be able to work in a proactive, not a reactive, environment. * Candidate must be able to work in a team collaborative environment and be a self\-starter without direct supervision. * Must be flexible with changes in workflows, a clear communicator, detail\-oriented, and highly organized. * Applicants with prior experience in television, radio broadcast engineering, or similar technical disciplines are preferred. * An associate degree with an emphasis in Engineering/ IT is preferred, or at least four years of equivalent industry experience is needed. * Applicant must be able to climb ladders up to 20 feet, lift 40 pounds, and work in tight spaces. * Must be able to work flexible hours. * Must be able to work fully onsite, either at the station's Studio or Transmitter. * A valid driver's license and a good driving record are required to drive company vehicles. * Must pass a background check. *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.* Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $32\.50\-34\.50 per hour. This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. Benefits for Union represented employees will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement. View more detail about FOX Benefits.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Information Security
jobs.description: **OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY** Fox Corporation Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.**JOB DESCRIPTION** ------------------- Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking. **ABOUT THE ROLE** The role will drive cybersecurity strategy through software engineering, automation, and emerging AI capabilities, including agentic workflows and AI\-enabled security services. A core focus for this Staff Software Engineer, Information Security role will be on driving automation, codification of processes, and building unique services to enable cutting\-edge cybersecurity practices across the organization. This position will have the unique ability to build enterprise\-grade software that transforms information security practices. As part of the role, you will explore how LLMs, AI agents, tool\-calling, and emerging interoperability standards can safely automate and augment cybersecurity at enterprise scale. We are interested in someone who is willing to challenge the status quo. How can we automate driving “zero\-trust” into enterprise architecture? How can we enhance patching and vulnerability management? How can we automate identification of security issues and their remediations? How can AI be applied to information security? Have ideas on automation to bridge on\-prem and cloud environments? Tell us! **A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** * Deliver cybersecurity strategy through software engineering and automation * Implement solutions that create visibility into both on\-prem and cloud environments * Automate security workflows using AI agents, MCP servers, and emerging technologies * Build security software and micro\-services to be consumed by internal teams * Design, build, and maintain API infrastructure that will integrate with multi\-platform applications * Support and advise colleagues in solving software engineering problems and maintaining solutions * Propose innovative solutions to mitigate cybersecurity problems * Collaborate with peers and internal customers on innovative solutions **WHAT YOU WILL NEED** * Typically, 7\+ years of Software Engineering experience, including: * Creating high\-quality production\-grade services * Building enterprise\-grade solutions using Amazon Web Services (AWS) * Effectively using AI coding agents and AI\-assisted software development workflows * Software development utilizing Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python * Development utilizing modern application development frameworks * Different data storage options, SQL and NoSQL databases, key\-value, data lakes, etc. * Building AI\-enabled security systems with tool use, evaluation, and guardrails * Working knowledge of enterprise networking and IT infrastructure * Curiosity and passion for security * Collaborative approach to working with software engineers, enterprise IT staff, and network engineers * Belief that any process that is repeated may be a candidate for automation * A knack for simplifying processes and low\-friction security * Dedication to healthy and mature software development practices * Regular, on\-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement. **NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER** * Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) * Familiarity with Microsoft Azure * Understanding of contemporary risk assessment frameworks and GRC management tools Learn more about Fox Tech at https://tech.fox.com \#foxtech*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.* Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $143\.00\-190\.00 annually. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. Benefits for Union represented employees will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement. View more detail about FOX Benefits.

jobs.title: Ingeniero Proyectos
jobs.description: Freeport\-McMoRan es una empresa minera internacional líder con sede central en Phoenix, Arizona. Operamos grandes activos, de larga vida, geográficamente diversos con importantes reservas probadas y probables de cobre, oro y molibdeno. La compañía tiene una cartera dinámica de proyectos de operación, expansión y crecimiento en la industria del cobre. Freeport\-McMoRan es uno de los mayores productores mundiales de cobre que cotiza en bolsa, el mayor productor mundial de molibdeno y un importante productor de oro. Lo alentamos a que se tome el tiempo para explorar la oportunidad de tener una carrera en Freeport\-McMoRan. **Description** --------------- The Project Engineer – Pipelines will support the planning, coordination, and execution of pipeline engineering activities across the project lifecycle, contributing to the safe, efficient, and timely delivery of pipeline infrastructure. The role will coordinate technical activities, stakeholders, consultants, contractors, schedules, costs, risks, and engineering deliverables in alignment with company standards, project objectives, and applicable regulatory requirements. **Main Responsibilities** ------------------------- * Coordinate pipeline engineering and project execution activities, including technical reviews, progress tracking, documentation, and risk identification. * Support schedules, milestones, budgets, cost estimates, forecasts, resource planning, and project deliverables. * Work with internal teams, consultants, contractors, vendors, and technical specialists to ensure integrated pipeline designs and effective project execution. * Review and support key pipeline deliverables, including route selection, hydraulic analyses, crossing designs, materials selection, stress analyses, constructability reviews, design packages, scopes of work, procurement packages, and bid packages. * Coordinate technical interfaces with related facilities such as pumping stations, process plants, tailings facilities, water infrastructure, power supply systems, roads, and third\-party assets. * Support field investigations, constructability reviews, risk assessments, and technical issue resolution during engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and startup. * Promote compliance with safety, environmental, quality, and risk management requirements. **Mandatory Requirements** -------------------------- * Engineering degree or global equivalent. * Minimum five years of related work experience. * Experience in mining fluid transportation systems such as water, concentrate, tailings, slurry, or reclaimed water pipelines. * Strong technical knowledge, communication skills, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively under schedule requirements. * Technical English, with ability to interact with Spanish\-speaking and English\-speaking stakeholders. * Professional certification or registration, if required by local regulations **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience in large\-scale mining projects involving long\-distance pipelines, pumping systems, hydraulic design, and multidisciplinary execution. * Strategic thinking, accountability, adaptability, analytical problem\-solving, proactive reporting, and technical writing skills. * Basic proficiency in office, spreadsheet, presentation, email, and project management tools. Minera Freeport\-McMoRan South America Limitada es una empresa inclusiva con una política activa en igualdad de oportunidades y en virtud de la Ley 21\.015 y demás leyes aplicables, las postulaciones a cargos son consideradas sin discriminación alguna, ya sea por motivo de raza, color, religión, país de origen, ciudadanía, sexo, edad, discapacidad o cualquier otro fundamento que sea motivo de discriminación. Todas las decisiones de contratación de Minera Freeport\-McMoRan South America Limitada se basan exclusivamente en la idoneidad del/la postulante para el cargo al que aspira.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer - Site Reliability
jobs.description: **Working at Frontier Airlines** At Frontier, our mission is to Make Every Flight Count. That mission guides how we support our customers, our people and the operation every day. As a Frontier employee, your work connects to more than a single role. Whether you’re supporting flights, helping customers, maintaining aircraft, leading teams or working behind the scenes, you help create a travel experience that is safe, reliable and built around value. Our work is guided by our core values: customer first, safety always, operational excellence and one team. These values shape how we make decisions, support each other and deliver for the people who count on us. **Support for work, life and travel** Frontier offers benefits, programs and travel privileges designed to support eligible employees at work and beyond. Availability may vary by role, employment status, eligibility, location, schedule, applicable policies and current plan details. Depending on role and eligibility, available benefits and programs may include: * Medical, dental and vision coverage * 401(k) retirement savings options * Paid holidays, vacation time and sick time * Travel privileges on Frontier Airlines and participating partner airlines, based on current program rules and availability * Buddy passes, based on eligibility and program rules * Travel\-related discounts and employee discounts on select products, services and vendors * A hybrid schedule for eligible headquarters roles based in Denver, Colorado * Business casual dress options for eligible corporate and support roles * Employee support programs and resources, including the HOPE League, Frontier Airlines’ nonprofit organization **About Frontier Airlines** Frontier Airlines is a Denver\-based airline serving destinations across the United States and select international markets. Our people support every part of the travel journey, from airport operations and flight crews to aircraft maintenance, customer support, corporate teams and more. We’re focused on delivering meaningful value by making travel more accessible, practical and easy to personalize for our customers. **What Will You Be Doing?** As a **Lead Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)**, you will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational excellence of mission\-critical technology platforms. You will partner with engineering, platform, security, and operations teams to build resilient systems, drive automation, improve service availability, and establish reliability\-focused engineering practices across the organization. This role requires deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, observability, distributed systems, DevSecOps, and Site Reliability Engineering principles, with the ability to influence engineering teams and operational strategies across the enterprise. **Essential Functions** * Lead the design and implementation of highly available, resilient, and scalable cloud platforms leveraging AWS services and cloud\-native technologies. * Define and execute reliability engineering strategies, service level objectives (SLOs), service level indicators (SLIs), and error budgets across critical business services. * Architect and operate Kubernetes\-based platforms supporting containerized and microservices\-based applications. * Establish enterprise standards for reliability, availability, disaster recovery, resiliency testing, and operational excellence. * Partner with software engineering, platform engineering, security, and operations teams to improve service reliability and reduce operational risk. * Drive adoption of DevSecOps practices, CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and self\-service platform capabilities. * Define and implement observability standards including monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, synthetic monitoring, and operational intelligence. * Lead incident response, post\-incident reviews, root cause analyses (RCA), and continuous improvement initiatives. * Identify and eliminate single points of failure through proactive reliability engineering and resilient architecture practices. * Design and implement automated remediation, self\-healing capabilities, and proactive alerting solutions to improve operational efficiency. * Lead capacity planning, performance engineering, availability management, and scalability assessments. * Partner with FinOps and engineering teams to optimize cloud resource utilization while maintaining reliability objectives. * Evaluate emerging technologies, AIOps, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions to improve platform reliability and operational effectiveness. * Mentor SREs, platform engineers, and software engineers in reliability practices, observability, automation, and operational excellence. * Develop executive\-level reliability roadmaps, operational strategies, and platform investment recommendations. **Additional Responsibilities** * Act as a trusted advisor to executive lea xperience with AIOps, intelligent automation, and reliability analytics. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * **Reliability \& Platform Technologies** * + Amazon Web Services (AWS) + Kubernetes (EKS) + Container Platforms + Platform Engineering + Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) + Cloud Networking and Security + High Availability \& Disaster Recovery + Performance Engineering \& Capacity Planning * **Site Reliability Engineering** * + Service Level Indicators (SLIs) + Service Level Objectives (SLOs) + Error Budget Management + Reliability Engineering + Availability \& Resiliency Design + Chaos Engineering + Incident Response \& Disaster Recovery + Root Cause Analysis (RCA) * **Observability \& Operations** * + Monitoring \& Alerting + Distributed Tracing + Centralized Logging + Synthetic Monitoring + Operational Intelligence + AIOps \& Event Correlation + Incident \& Problem Management + Change \& Release Management * **DevSecOps \& Automation** * + CI/CD Automation + DevSecOps Practices + Infrastructure Automation + Platform Automation + Self\-Healing Systems + Configuration Management + Reliability Automation * **Leadership \& Business Skills** * + Operational Strategy \& Reliability Roadmaps + Cloud Financial Management (FinOps) + Executive Communication + Risk Management \& Mitigation + Technical Leadership Without jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Systems Software
jobs.description: **About Us** GRAID Technology develops GPU\-accelerated RAID solutions for NVMe SSDs, helping customers achieve high performance, low latency, and reliable data protection for demanding enterprise, AI, HPC, and data\-intensive workloads. Our engineering team works at the hardware/software boundary across Linux, Windows, NVMe, PCIe, CUDA, and system\-level performance optimization. **Role Overview** We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our U.S. Engineering team in Sunnyvale, California. This is a hands\-on systems software role for an experienced engineer who can design, build, debug, and optimize high\-performance software for GPU accelerated NVMe storage products. The ideal candidate combines strong low\-level engineering skills with technical leadership: someone who can own complex projects end to end, make sound architecture decisions, raise the quality bar, and mentor junior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and day\-to\-day technical guidance. **What You’ll Do** * Lead the design and implementation of high\-performance systems software for GPU\-accelerated NVMe RAID products. * Own major features from concept through architecture, detailed design, implementation, unit testing, integration, release, and post\-release support. * Design scalable, maintainable, and reliable software components across kernel space, user\-space, management tools, diagnostics, and automation where applicable. * Debug complex issues across software, driver, OS, PCIe, NVMe, GPU, and hardware interaction layers. * Analyze performance bottlenecks related to I/O behavior, latency, queue depth, CPU utilization, PCIe bandwidth, memory behavior, and GPU acceleration. * Partner with QA, product management, customer support, and field engineering teams to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and improve product quality. * Provide technical leadership through architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and implementation guidance. * Mentor junior engineers and help strengthen the team’s engineering practices, debugging discipline, and system\-level design capability. * Improve development efficiency by building tools, test automation, diagnostics, and internal documentation. * Participate in customer escalation support when deep technical analysis or root\-cause investigation is required. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience for senior\-level candidates. * Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ for system\-level software development. * Solid understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, concurrency, memory management, and performance\-sensitive software design. * Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining software on Linux; experience with Linux kernel modules, device drivers, or low\-level system components is highly desirable. * Strong debugging skills using tools such as gdb, perf, tracing tools, logs, crash dumps, or equivalent diagnostics. * Experience designing and delivering complex software features with clear design documentation, test plans, and maintainable implementation. * Experience with Git\-based development workflows, peer code reviews, issue tracking, and modern software development lifecycle practices. * Ability to lead technical discussions, evaluate tradeoffs, and make practical architecture decisions under ambiguity. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to engineers, QA, support, product, and leadership. * Demonstrated ability to mentor other engineers and improve team\-level engineering practices. **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep understanding of Linux internals, kernel development, device drivers, storage stack, or block\-layer behavior. * Experience with NVMe, NVMe\-oF, RAID, PCIe, DMA, interrupt handling, queueing models, or storage performance analysis. * Experience with GPU programming or acceleration technologies, especially CUDA. Experience with Windows driver development, storage drivers, or cross\-platform systems software is a plus. * Experience building test automation, diagnostic tools, or performance benchmarking frameworks. * Prior experience in enterprise storage, data center infrastructure, AI/HPC infrastructure, or performance\-critical systems. **What We Value** * Strong ownership and the ability to drive work to completion without heavy supervision. * Clear technical judgment, practical decision\-making, and willingness to dig deep into difficult problems. * A collaborative mindset and the ability to help others grow through constructive feedback and mentorship. * Attention to quality, reliability, maintainability, and customer impact. * Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies across storage, GPU acceleration, operating systems, and hardware/software integration. **Why Join Us** * Work on a technically challenging product at the intersection of GPU acceleration, NVMe storage, operating systems, and enterprise infrastructure. * Join a small, high\-impact engineering team where senior engineers can directly influence architecture, product quality, and engineering culture. * Solve real\-world performance and reliability problems for customers running demanding data\-intensive workloads. * Help shape the technical direction of the U.S. Engineering team while mentoring and developing the next generation of engineers. **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. Compensation will be standardized for all hires at the same level and location. The package may include stock options and a performance\-based bonus. \- * Senior\-Level Total Compensation: $150,000–$200,000 * Staff\-Level Total Compensation: $180,000–$250,000 **Work Authorization** Please note that GRAID is unable to sponsor work visas for this position at this time. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $250,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Developer
jobs.description: **Introduction** Welcome to Gallagher \- a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client\-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way. **Overview** The **AI** **Developer** builds and ships the components that make Gallagher's enterprise AI solutions work. You will write production C\#/.NET and Python code for RAG pipelines, AI agents, and Copilot integrations on our Azure stack, working from designs set by senior engineers while taking full ownership of the features assigned to you. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role built for someone who learns fast, asks good questions, and turns what they learn into working software \- in a regulated insurance environment where correctness, security, and auditability matter as much as speed. **How you'll make an impact** \- **Build Production AI Features**: Implement well\-scoped components of GenAI and agentic systems \- retrieval pipelines, tool integrations, prompt flows, API endpoints \- in C\#/.NET and Python, following the team's established patterns.* **Integrate Across the Azure Stack**: Wire AI capabilities into enterprise services using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, and Container Apps; connect to line\-of\-business systems through secure REST APIs and AI agents. * **Ship to Enterprise Surfaces**: Deliver working features into internal applications and support them once they are live. * **Test and Evaluate Your Own Work**: Write unit and integration tests, run the team's evaluation harnesses against your changes, and validate groundedness, accuracy, latency, and cost before asking for reviews. * **Participate in Code and Design Reviews**: Submit clean, reviewable pull requests, act on feedback quickly, and read others' code to learn the codebase and the standards behind it. \- **Follow Governance by Default**: Apply the team's responsible\-AI controls \- Entra ID/RBAC, data\-residency requirements, audit logging, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints \- as part of building the feature.* **Debug and Support What You Build**: Investigate production issues in AI pipelines and integrations, use logs and telemetry to isolate root causes, and deliver fixes with the same rigor as new features. * **Learn Continuously and Apply It**: Track how the AI tooling landscape is moving, run small experiments against real Gallagher problems, and bring what works back to the team with a clear explanation of why. * **Communicate Clearly**: Give honest status in stand\-ups, flag blockers early, document what you built, and explain your work in terms teammates and business partners can follow. **About You*** **Experience**: 1\-3 years of professional software engineering experience (internships and co\-ops count), or a strong equivalent portfolio of shipped work. * **Languages**: Working proficiency in C\#/.NET, Python, Typescript and Javascript, with the ability to become strong in .NET and Python; comfortable reading unfamiliar code. * **Cloud Fundamentals**: Hands\-on experience building or deploying on Azure (Functions, App Service, Container Apps, or equivalent), including authentication and configuration basics. \- **AI Exposure**: Practical experience calling LLM APIs and building something real with them \- a RAG prototype, an agent, a chatbot, or an internal tool \- whether at work, at school, or on your own. * **API and Data Skills**: Building and consuming REST APIs, working with JSON, and querying relational or vector data stores. * **Engineering Hygiene**: Git\-based workflow, familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or equivalent), and a habit of testing your own work. \- **Education**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field \- or demonstrable equivalent experience. **Preferred Differentiators** ----------------------------- * **Microsoft AI Ecosystem**: Exposure to Azure infrastructure, Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Agent Framework, or LangChain. \- **Regulated Industry Awareness**: Any experience \- internship, coursework, or prior role \- in insurance, financial services, or healthcare, where compliance shapes how software is built. * **AI\-Assisted Development**: Fluent use of AI coding assistants and agent workflows to move faster without sacrificing code quality. * **Evaluation Mindset**: Experience writing evals, test sets, or benchmarks for LLM outputs rather than judging quality by eye. * **Infrastructure Familiarity**: Reading or contributing to Terraform and similar infrastructure\-as\-code. * **Certifications**: Azure certifications such as AZ\-204, AI\-102, or AI\-900 are beneficial. **Professional Qualities** -------------------------- * **Relentlessly Curious**: Digs into how things actually work rather than stopping at the first answer; treats unfamiliar territory as the interesting part of the job. \- **Learns and applies**: Converts new knowledge into shipped work quickly \- the reading, the course, and the side experiment show up in the codebase and not just in conversation. * **Ownership Over Assignment**: Takes a task through to working software in users' hands, including the unglamorous parts: tests, edge cases, documentation, and cleanup. * **Ask Early, Unblock Fast**: Attempts a solution independently, then raises a specific, well\-framed question before burning a day on the wrong path. * **Receptive to Feedback**: Treats code review as the fastest way to get better; separates critique of the code from critique of the person. \- **Careful in a Regulated Setting**: Understands that Gallagher's AI touches client and business data, and builds accordingly \- secure, logged, and explainable by default. **Compensation and benefits** At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation * Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being * Career development opportunities and ongoing learning * A collaborative, people\-first culture with accessible leadership * The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact **At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

jobs.title: Lead Data Center Network Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: We are seeking a full\-time **Lead Data Center Network Engineer (Cisco ACI)** at Garmin's headquarters in **Olathe, Kansas**. In this role, you will serve as the technical leader for Garmin's global data center networking infrastructure, with primary responsibility for Cisco ACI environments, data center network architecture, lifecycle management, modernization initiatives, and operational excellence. You will lead large\-scale network deployments, upgrades, hardware refreshes, capacity planning efforts, and incident response activities while partnering with cross\-functional teams to ensure highly available, scalable, and secure network services. This position participates in a global 24x7 on\-call rotation and serves as a senior escalation point for critical network incidents and infrastructure outages. Responsibilities: **Essential Functions*** Provides technical leadership and contributes significantly to the data center networking roadmap and long\-term infrastructure strategy. * Serves as the subject matter expert for Cisco ACI and modern data center networking technologies. * Leads the design, implementation, maintenance, and support of enterprise data center network infrastructure. * Plans and executes Cisco ACI lifecycle management activities including fabric upgrades, code upgrades, hardware replacements, fabric expansions, and migration projects. * Develops reliable solutions to complex technical challenges requiring creativity, innovation, and advanced troubleshooting skills. * Leads major incident response efforts, root cause analysis activities, and corrective action planning for critical network infrastructure. * Serves as a senior technical escalation resource for production issues affecting business\-critical services. * Establishes and maintains network architecture standards, operational procedures, and engineering best practices. * Collaborates with server, storage, security, cloud, and application teams to deliver integrated infrastructure solutions. * Leads network capacity planning, growth forecasting, and technology refresh initiatives. * Evaluates and implements new technologies to improve reliability, scalability, automation, and operational efficiency. * Develops and maintains technical documentation, design standards, implementation procedures, and operational runbooks. * Provides mentorship, technical guidance, and leadership to less experienced engineers. * Participates in a global 24x7 on\-call rotation and responds to infrastructure incidents and emergencies as required. * Supports planned maintenance activities, change implementations, upgrades, and infrastructure migrations during approved maintenance windows. * Serves as a leader of change by driving continuous improvement initiatives and modernization efforts across the network environment. Qualifications: **Basic Qualifications*** Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Management Information Systems, or related field **AND** a minimum of 9 years relevant experience * Demonstrated strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. * Proven ability to lead complex technical projects and initiatives. * Extensive hands\-on experience with **Cisco ACI** in enterprise or large\-scale data center environments. * Experience performing Cisco ACI fabric upgrades, software upgrades, hardware replacements, lifecycle management activities, and fabric expansion projects. * Strong understanding of modern data center networking architectures including leaf\-spine designs, VXLAN, EVPN, and software\-defined networking concepts. * Hands\-on experience with Cisco Nexus platforms and NX\-OS. * Advanced knowledge of routing and switching protocols including BGP, OSPF, ECMP, HSRP, VLANs, and Layer 2/Layer 3 networking principles. * Experience planning and executing network hardware refreshes, platform migrations, and end\-of\-life/end\-of\-support remediation efforts. * Proven experience troubleshooting complex network issues within mission\-critical production environments. * Experience leading incident response efforts and coordinating activities across multiple technology teams. * Strong understanding of network resiliency, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity principles. * Experience with network monitoring, telemetry, performance analysis, and troubleshooting tools. * Experience participating in a 24x7 on\-call rotation supporting enterprise or data center network infrastructure. * Ability to work occasional after\-hours maintenance windows supporting upgrades, migrations, and infrastructure changes. **Desired Qualifications*** Cisco certifications such as **CCNP Data Center**, **CCNP Enterprise**, **CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure**, or **CCIE Data Center**. * Experience with **Cisco Routed Optical Networking (RON)** platforms and optical transport technologies. * Experience with DWDM, dark fiber, and inter\-data\-center connectivity solutions. * Experience supporting multiple geographically distributed data centers. * Experience with Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Network Insights, and related management platforms. * Experience automating network deployments and operational processes using tools such as Python, Ansible, Terraform, Git, or other automation frameworks. * Experience developing infrastructure\-as\-code and automated validation methodologies. * Knowledge of storage networking technologies and high\-bandwidth data center environments. * Previous experience serving as a technical lead, project lead, or engineering mentor. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision\-making skills. * Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise, cloud, or mission\-critical infrastructure environments. *Garmin International is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran’s status, age or disability.* *This position is eligible for Garmin's benefit program. Details can be found here:* *Garmin Benefits*

jobs.title: Project Manager II
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Do you consider yourself to be a highly technical, strong communicator with the desire to work in a team environment on complex projects? Gilbane is seeking a **Project Manager II** to serve as the on\-site Gilbane manager, responsible for the overall direction, completion, and financial outcome of a medium\-sized construction project. This position will be on the job site every day and will fill a key role on the project team. **Who are we?** As a Top\-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family\-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870\. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on\-time. You will have the opportunity to build schools, labs, hospitals, corporate offices, sports arenas and more! We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Who are you?** You are a coach/leader who leads with an inclusive and empathetic mindset. You provide feedback and guidance to help others excel in their current or future roles. You determine priorities, delegate work, and effectively communicate progress. You establish measures to assess the impact, quality, and timeliness of results while praising successes and sharing lessons learned. You build high performing teams by attracting, engaging, developing, and retaining talented individuals through motivation and discipline to maximize impact on the organization and the individual. You leverage business insights by understanding industry trends, local market/economic conditions, and Gilbane’s business model to make critical decisions and create competitive advantage. You deploy a strategic mindset when considering solutions to long\-term opportunities and risks that may develop in the future. *Your core values match Gilbane’s: Integrity, Caring, Teamwork, Toughmindedness, Dedication to Excellence, Discipline, Loyalty, and Entrepreneurship.* **What’s in it for you?** Gilbane offers employees multi\-dimensional training opportunities through a number of resources. While managing your responsibilities to the project, you will be able to enroll in trainings through our award\-winning Gilbane University to build leadership and technical skills. In addition, you will with experienced Sr. Project Managers and Project Executives on each job site which provides you with opportunity to learn new industry skills every day. You will protect and promote the interests of both Gilbane and the client in all matters as well as demonstrating the personal characteristics of a developing leader. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Contributes to the development of the project safety plan with corporate safety and provides jobsite leadership * Contributes to development of project controls and procedures, and develops risk mitigation processes to manage contract requirements * Establishes and monitors change management process and project financial forecast to meet contract requirements * Creates and manages a project\-specific quality plan aligned with the owner contract and contract documents and assist with execution * Creates and manages a closeout plan in alignment with the contract documents and assists with execution * Provides leadership in motivating the project team and maintains a positive work environment. This shall include assisting and/or direct supervision of work, project administration, project superintendents, and engineers to establish operational priorities. * Trains direct reports on processes, procedures, and completion of daily tasks * Contributes to the subcontracting strategy; write scopes and other deliverables to ensure the integrity of the buyout process * Implements and enforces all aspects of contracts, participates and implements risk mitigation plan; prepares draft contracts, agreements, and purchase orders * Participates in enrollment for insurance and bonds; tracks and obtains trade contractors’ compliance * Provides planning support and is accountable for the estimates of select bid packages and contributing to GMP preparation * Performs constructability and coordination reviews * Creates CPM schedule and prepares monthly schedule updates * Develops a basic understanding of the local market areas and profiles to create a networking strategy * Collaborates closely with business development to ensure seamless integration with sales strategies including performance metrics on your assigned projects, pursuits, and client deliverables. Actively participates in opportunities to strengthen client, partner, and industry relationships that position Gilbane as the “Builder of Choice” * Manages workload and performance of direct reports, ensuring alignment with overall company standards * Fosters a positive and inclusive work environment to motivate and engage team members * Aids in communicating company and department strategy to direct reports **Qualifications** ------------------ **EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or Construction Management * 5\-10 years of experience * Or equivalent combination of education and experience **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES** * Strong technical and communication skills are critical * Ability to work in a team environment * Knowledge of industry standard software, Microsoft Office (preferred) Salary to be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience of the applicant, as well as the internal equity and alignment with the team. For Albany, NY this ranges from $108,300 \- $137,500 plus benefits and retirement program. *Gilbane offers an excellent total compensation package which includes competitive health and welfare benefits and a generous profit\-sharing/401k plan. We invest in our employees’ education and have built Gilbane University into a top training organization in the construction industry. Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre\-employment substance abuse test.* *Gilbane is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or disability status.* ***Note to Recruiters, Placement Agencies, and Similar Organizations****: Gilbane does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our jobs alias, website, or to any Gilbane employee. Gilbane will not pay fees to any third party agency or firm and will not be responsible for any agency fees associated with unsolicited resumes. Unsolicited resumes received will be considered property of Gilbane and will be processed accordingly.*

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description: Technical / commercial position; responsible for the direct/indirect selling and support of the global distribution channel. Interprets customer specifications and application requirements in order to provide technical assistance and assurances of product capability. Coordinates the dissemination of order requirements throughout Gleason Metrology Systems to ensure effective engineering, manufacturing, assembly, product installation and acceptance to meet customer expectations. Conducts product pre\-acceptance activities to secure customer approval required for shipment. Provides applications support throughout the installation and final acceptance process at the customer site. **Job Responsibilities:** * Provide quality assurance function for outgoing products, ( run\-offs, GR\&R Studies, applications development). * Provide in\-house \& on\-site training to domestic and international customers as well as the Gleason global sales organization * Provide technical support to customers after machine installation. * Perform demonstrations, presentations and training as required during domestic and international trade shows, at customer locations and at GMS to facilitate sales of products and services. Keep technical presentations updated as required by product change. * Obtains and disseminates intimate knowledge of customers' requirements and expectations with regard to application, correlation, process speed, output, and data integration requirements, quality of detailed information as it relates to the project. * Build and maintain presentation materials for applications suite of software as modules are produced and updated. Maintain updates in the Gleason Sales Workbook. * Composes quotes and/or proposals for metrology solutions to meet customer specifications particularly applications requirements. * Composes Machine Order Forms (MOF) and related internal documents to facilitate the communication of order requirements and customer expectations to all GMS constituents. High emphasis on quality of information content. * Composes Engineering RFQs (Request For Quote) and related internal documents to facilitate the communication to appropriate GMS engineering staff of customer requirements and expectations with respect to specialized functions and features as applied to software / hardware requirements. * Maintains MLC commercial and machine acceptance schedule to current status. * Actively participates in improving Sales Order First Pass Yield (FPY) and on time delivery (OTD) metrics, Supports internal quality system, open issue items * Lead contract review sessions for assigned sales orders to disseminate requirements to the attending cross functional staff, (Eng., SW Eng., Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, \& Service. **Preferred Education/Training/Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical / industrial Engineering or other related technology degree with 2\-3 years’ work experience. * Associates degree in related field with 5\-8 years of work experience may be considered. * Minimum 2 years of technical / commercial / applications support experience related to an engineered system product. CMM (Coordinate Measurement Machine) product experience with is a plus. * Knowledge of GD\&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) is required. * Windows Office skills required. * Requires strong oral and written communication skills to convey complex ideas or systems operations. * Understanding of basic statistics, basic mathematic algorithms and strong mechanical blueprint reading capability. * Goal and accuracy oriented, timely completion and successful implementation of assignments. Some working knowledge of cylindrical and spiral bevel gear sets a plus.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best\-in\-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow. **Ready to take your career global?** Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We are seeking a highly skilled and forward\-thinking AI Engineer to join our AI Engineering team. This role is ideal for a hands\-on technologist with deep expertise in machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), and a strong working knowledge of Generative AI technologies. You will design, build, and optimize intelligent systems that power automation, personalization, and decision\-making across our FinTech platforms. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI research and real\-world enterprise applications. **What you’ll own** * Design, develop, and deploy ML, DL, and Generative AI models that solve complex business problems and deliver measurable value. * Build and maintain scalable ML pipelines and agentic workflows using modern frameworks and cloud\-native tools. * Collaborate with data scientists, product managers, and engineers to translate business requirements into AI\-powered solutions. * Implement and optimize AI solutions using platforms such as GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, and Snowflake Cortex. * Apply techniques such as prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation), fine\-tuning, and RLHF to enhance model performance. * Develop and deploy autonomous AI agents using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, and AgentSpace. * Integrate vector databases (e.g., PGVector) and LLM orchestration tools to support retrieval and memory in generative systems. * Ensure robust MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, versioning, and lifecycle management of models. * Stay current with AI research and industry trends, and evaluate emerging tools and techniques for enterprise adoption. * Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, documentation, and best practices for responsible and ethical AI development. **What you’ll bring** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 4\+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with a strong foundation in ML/DL algorithms and systems. * Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Transformers. * Hands\-on experience with Generative AI models (e.g., GPT, Mistral, Claude) and agentic AI systems. * Experience with NLP, conversational AI, and LLM\-based applications. * Familiarity with vector search and semantic retrieval technologies. * Strong understanding of MLOps, including model deployment, monitoring, and retraining. * Experience building production\-grade AI systems at scale in cloud environments. * Hands\-on experience with development on Google Cloud Platform. * Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills**.** **It’s a bonus if you have** * Experience with prompt engineering, RLHF, and LLM evaluation techniques. * Understanding of AI governance, safety, and responsible AI principles. * Familiarity with reinforcement learning, multi\-agent systems, and autonomous workflows. * Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Apache Spark, Kafka) and real\-time data processing. * Experience with data engineering techniques and data warehousing platforms (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake). * Contributions to open\-source AI projects or publications in the AI/ML field.Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, and cloud\-native AI tooling. * Ability to work proactively with a high level of initiative and accuracy. * Ability to manage multiple assignments effectively and meet established deadlines. * Strong interpersonal skills to interact professionally with staff and stakeholders. * Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. * Critical thinking ability ranging from moderately to highly complex tasks. * Flexibility in adapting to changing business needs and priorities. * Ability to work creatively and independently with minimal supervision. * Ability to utilize experience and judgment in accomplishing goals. * Experience in navigating organizational structures and collaborating across teams. **About the team** Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders. **What makes a Globalpayer?** Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do. jobs.title: Systems Engineer (2027 New College Graduate)
jobs.description: **About GlobalFoundries** GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Research Scientist
jobs.description: **About Goodfire** ------------------ Goodfire is a research company using interpretability to understand, learn from, and design AI systems. Our mission is to build the next generation of safe and powerful AI—not by scaling alone, but by understanding the intelligence we're building. Scaling has proven powerful, but today's approach is fundamentally limited: we can't meaningfully understand, debug, or shape what models learn. Every engineering discipline has been gated by fundamental science and AI is at that inflection point now. We're advancing the science of how AI systems actually work. Treating models as black boxes is an unnecessary handicap—we have access to the structures inside them, and understanding those structures lets us steer what models learn, make them safer and more useful, and extract the vast knowledge they contain. Our goal is to make AI that can be understood, debugged, and shaped like software. Goodfire is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco with a team of the world’s top interpretability researchers and engineers from organizations like OpenAI and DeepMind. We're backed by over $200M from B Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed, Eric Schmidt, and others. **About the role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Research Scientist to join our team to work directly with customers to apply our interpretability platform to solve novel problems for our customers. You’ll work closely with a small, mission\-driven team of scientists and engineers to conduct novel research, build practical tools, and push the field forward. **Where you might contribute:** * **Forward deployed research** – lead research with our partners to interpret advanced models. * **Project delivery and implementation** – own research delivery on high\-stakes projects with customers and do whatever it takes to make delivery successful, including: problem and hypothesis definition, data sourcing, tool building, iteration, and implementation. Translate research into tools for real\-world applications. **Key Responsibilities:** * Work directly with customers to conduct original research in interpretability. * Prototype techniques to visualize and manipulate internal model structures. * Collaborate with engineering to turn research into production\-ready tools. * Drive partnership success by collaborating closely with our customers and partners. * Help define and evolve our research direction. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- ### **Required experience** * MS/PhD or equivalent experience in CS, with a strong ML background and experience in interpretability. * Deep familiarity with large models and a passion for understanding how they work. * Fluency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch. * Strong writing and communication skills for explaining complex ideas. * Drive to move quickly and take ownership. ### **Preferred qualifications** * Experience leading research in a forward deployed environment and in service of a customer’s requirements. * Experience in startup or fast\-paced lab environments. **Our values** -------------- Goodfire is looking for individuals who embody our values and share our deep commitment to making interpretability accessible. We are building a team first and foremost. **Put mission and team first** All we do is in service of our mission. We trust each other, deeply care about the success of the organization, and choose to put our team above ourselves. **Improve constantly** We are constantly looking to improve every piece of the business. We proactively critique ourselves and others in a kind and thoughtful way that translates to practical improvements in the organization. We are pragmatic and consistently implement the obvious fixes that work. **Take ownership and initiative** There are no bystanders here. We proactively identify problems and take full responsibility over getting a strong result. We are self\-driven, own our mistakes, and feel deep responsibility over what we’re building. **Action today** We have a small amount of time to do something incredibly hard and meaningful. The pace and intensity of the organization is high. If we can take action today or tomorrow, we will choose to do it today. **Where we work** ----------------- We are hiring for this position in our San Francisco HQ. We are in person 5 days a week, with one company\-wide remote week per month. **What we offer** ----------------- This role offers market competitive salary, equity, and competitive benefits. The expected salary range for this position is $220,000 \- $315,000 USD Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to join a vital mission at an important point in its trajectory — we are developing groundbreaking technology with a world\-class team on the critical path to ensuring a safe and beneficial future for humanity. If you want to do your life’s work with us, even if you believe you do not meet every single requirement, apply now.

We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **https://haccretion.com** **Haccretion** is building a connected real estate ecosystem designed to bring property discovery, property data, professional identity, social networking, communication, brokerage operations, transaction infrastructure and eventually financial services into one network. We're hiring a **Founding Software Engineer** to help turn that architecture into a platform capable of operating at scale. **Compensation: $150,000/year** This is not intended to be a conventional software engineering position. The engineers joining Haccretion at this stage will work directly on the foundational architecture of the platform and will have an opportunity to grow with the technical organization they help create. As Haccretion expands its engineering organization, exceptional early engineers may progress into **Lead, Director, VP of Engineering, or other senior technical leadership positions**, potentially overseeing major areas of the Haccretion platform. We are looking for people who want to **build the system—and potentially help lead the organization that grows around it.** What You're Building Haccretion approaches real estate as a network rather than a collection of disconnected products. The platform is being designed around several interconnected systems: **Property Graph** — Persistent digital identities for real estate, connecting property information, history, listings, ownership relationships and market activity. **Social Graph** — Persistent identities and relationships connecting buyers, sellers, property owners, agents, brokers, lenders, investors and service professionals. **Marketplace** — Property discovery across residential, commercial, land and other real estate categories. **Communication** — Messaging and interaction between consumers, professionals and businesses within the real estate environment. **Transaction Infrastructure** — The systems connecting discovery, professional relationships, brokerage activity, documents and ultimately transactions. **Haccretion AI** — Intelligence operating across property, social and transaction data to support search, matching, automation, market intelligence and future platform capabilities. The long\-term objective is straightforward: **Everything real estate. Connected.** What You'll Do You will work directly with Haccretion's founder and future engineering team to translate the existing product architecture into scalable production infrastructure. Your responsibilities may include designing and developing core platform services; rebuilding and scaling existing functionality; developing APIs and data architecture; building property, identity and relationship systems; creating marketplace and search infrastructure; developing messaging, notifications and social functionality; integrating external property and business data; developing transaction\-oriented systems; establishing engineering standards and infrastructure; and helping recruit and mentor additional engineers as the organization grows. This position will have substantial influence over technical decisions made during Haccretion's foundational engineering stage. The Leadership Opportunity We're deliberately recruiting engineers before building a traditional hierarchy around them. That creates an unusual opportunity. Someone joining an established technology company inherits systems, organizational structures and engineering decisions made years earlier. A Founding Software Engineer at Haccretion will help make those decisions. As the company scales, we expect the engineering organization to divide into specialized areas such as: **Platform Engineering · Property \& Data Infrastructure · Marketplace · Social \& Identity · Transactions · AI \& Intelligence · Mobile · Infrastructure \& Reliability** Early engineers who demonstrate the technical ability and leadership required to own these systems will be natural candidates for senior leadership as those divisions develop. **The people who help build the foundation should have the opportunity to help lead what gets built on top of it.** Who We're Looking For We're looking for engineers who are comfortable with ambiguity, large systems and ambitious technical problems. Strong candidates will have experience in several of the following areas: full\-stack software engineering, backend systems, modern frontend frameworks, API architecture, relational and/or graph\-oriented data systems, cloud infrastructure, search systems, geospatial applications, scalable consumer platforms, real\-time communication, security, AI/ML integration or high\-volume data systems. Real estate experience is **not required**. The ability to understand complicated systems and build reliable software is substantially more important. Compensation \& Long\-Term Opportunity **Base Salary: $150,000/year** This role is being recruited as part of Haccretion's broader company\-building and financing strategy. Haccretion's founder is allocating **20% of company equity to the employee compensation pool** as the company builds its foundational team alongside its current **$20 million funding round**. Individual equity awards, vesting, role scope and other compensation terms would be established separately as part of an employment offer and should not be inferred from the size of the overall employee pool. The objective is to create meaningful alignment between Haccretion and the people responsible for building its long\-term infrastructure. Why Join at This Stage? Because the engineering organization isn't finished. Neither is the architecture. You're not being hired to maintain somebody else's mature product. You're being hired to help **build Haccretion's technical foundation, establish how the platform scales, and potentially become one of the people responsible for leading that infrastructure as the company grows.** Pay: $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Sr Red Hat/UniVerse Administrator
jobs.description: Hajoca Corporation is one of the country’s largest privately\-held wholesale distributors of plumbing, heating \& cooling, and industrial supplies. Founded in 1858, Hajoca is a company based on the principles of “Service, Integrity, Reliability,” and on relationships of trust and support with teammates, customers, and suppliers. Throughout its history, Hajoca has played an active role in shaping advances in plumbing. However, we attribute our success to two simple truths; a unique business philosophy and talented people. Hajoca is all about the people, who give us our advantage, and who will guide us successfully into the future. Hajoca has over 400 locations nationwide, called Profit Centers; and at the foundation of our family of businesses is a National Support Center (NSC) where Centers of Excellence are dedicated to enabling the success of our Profit Centers. The Infrastructure Operations team in our National Support Center (NSC) is looking for a Sr Red Hat/UniVerse Administrator at their Lafayette Hill, PA office. This position is remote. Do you have deep, hands\-on experience administering Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Rocket UniVerse or another MultiValue database? Do you enjoy tuning, securing, and troubleshooting the infrastructure supporting a mission\-critical ERP platform? Are you excited by the opportunity to own the SQL replication pipeline connecting Eclipse operational data to enterprise reporting and analytics? If so, then we’d like you to join our dedicated team as a Senior Red Hat / UniVerse Administrator. **About the Role:** The Senior Red Hat / UniVerse Administrator is the senior technical owner of the platform that Hajoca’s Epicor Eclipse ERP runs on — the Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) operating environment, the Rocket UniVerse MultiValue database beneath Eclipse, and the near real time SQL replication layer that feeds the enterprise data warehouse and business intelligence. This role keeps a mission critical, 24×7 distribution platform stable, secure, high performing, and highly available across production and non production environments, while ensuring that operational Eclipse data flows accurately and continuously into SQL Server for reporting and analytics. The ideal candidate blends deep Linux systems administration with hands on MultiValue database expertise and a strong data integration mindset — someone who can tune the OS and the UniVerse database, work fluently within the Eclipse ecosystem, and own the replication pipeline that turns nested MultiValue records into clean relational data for Power BI, SSRS, and Excel. **In this role, you will:** Own Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Administration * Install, configure, patch, and upgrade RHEL servers (physical and virtual) that host the Eclipse/UniVerse environment, keeping the estate on current, supported releases. * Tune the kernel, filesystems (LVM/XFS), memory, and CPU for MultiValue database workloads and heavy transactional I/O. * Automate provisioning, patching, and configuration management with Red Hat Satellite and Bash scripting to drive consistency and reduce manual effort. * Monitor system health, forecast capacity, and proactively tune performance to sustain availability targets. * Administer users, groups, permissions, SSH, sudo/PAM, and OS hardening in line with security policy. * Manage, networking (interface bonding, firewalld, DNS, NTP), systemd services, logging, and scheduled jobs. Own Rocket UniVerse / MultiValue Database Administration * Administer Rocket UniVerse (U2\) MultiValue database instances underpinning Epicor Eclipse — including accounts, files, file sizing/resizing, hashing, and record/group locks. * Diagnose and resolve locking, contention, and session issues; tune uvconfig, phantom processes, and shared memory parameters for optimal throughput. * Perform backups, transaction logging, and point in time recovery; validate restore procedures on a regular cadence. * Apply MultiValue performance monitoring (e.g., Rocket MVX: Performance) to track sessions, locks, host resources, and replication health. * Use RetrieVe/UniQuery and read UniVerse BASIC to investigate data issues and support reporting. * Maintain UniVerse licensing, TLS transport encryption, and data at rest encryption; open and manage support cases with Rocket Software or the VAR. Own Epicor Eclipse SQL Replication \& Maintain the Data Warehouse * Own the Epicor Eclipse SQL Replication engine that provides near real time replication of core Eclipse UniVerse (MultiValue) database files directly into a structured SQL Server data warehouse environment. * Configure, schedule, and continuously monitor replication so operational transactional data syncs into SQL tables with acceptable latency and completeness. * Manage the mapping and transformation that flattens nested multi value fields — such as multiple order lines within a single record — into standard relational rows and columns. * Administer the Information Control Engine (ICE) inte parable MultiValue based distribution ERP) sufficient to support the underlying database and data pipeline — Eclipse application administration is owned by a separate partner role. * Possess a working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and of data replication / ETL concepts. * Be proficient in Bash scripting and automation with Ansible. * Possess strong analytical and troubleshooting skills and the ability to react quickly and decisively during incidents. * Have virtualization (VMware) and enterprise storage (SAN/NAS) experience. * Be available for after hours maintenance windows and shared on call support. * Have direct experience with Epicor Eclipse SQL Replication and the Information Control Engine (ICE). * Possess reporting/BI integration experience with Power BI, SSRS, and Excel against a replicated SQL data warehouse. * Have a background in wholesale distribution or another multi site, high transaction environment. a background in wholesale distribution or another multi site, high transaction environment. * Be familiar with UniVerse BASIC and comfortable reading and adjusting existing MultiValue code. * Have experience coordinating vendor support relationships (Epicor, Rocket Software, and VARs). * Have experience with Rubrik Data Protection for management of backups, recovery, and vulnerability scanning. * Have experience with Zerto Continuous Data Protection. * Demonstrate strong functional knowledge; take ownership of skills, knowledge, and relationships needed to perform the job. * Be professional, organized, and able to manage work, time, and problems. * Be results oriented; focused on attaining goals and objectives. * Have a keen ability to interpret technical problems and systematically troubleshoot and resolve. **The benefits of working with us:** Our culture is well\-suited for exceptional people who use their talents to drive business and want to share in the financial success their efforts yield. In addition to a competitive starting wage, we offer a Profit\-Sharing Program that provides each team member with an opportunity to earn a direct share of the profits on an annual basis. In addition to our generous compensation package, Hajoca also offers: Full\-time benefits (for team members working 30 or more hours per week): * Medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage * Accident, Hospital Indemnity, and critical care coverage * Life insurance and Long Term Disability * Pre\-tax accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuter benefits * Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time (sick time also offered to PT team members as required by state law) * Paid pregnancy and parental leave * Paid day of community service **Full\-time and part\-time benefits:** * 401(k) * Retirement cash account with company contributions * Targeted training programs focused on your personal and professional growth * Company wellness program * Employee discounts * College tuition benefits * Please note that benefit offerings may differ for teammates employed through an intern program. EEOC Statement Hajoca Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer (Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected category pursuant to federal, state or local laws and will not be discriminated against on the basis of any such categories/status. Hajoca is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities including, but not limited to, during the application process. Please let us know if you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability. Background Screening Statement We are a drug free workplace. Employment is contingent upon pre\-employment drug screening, and successful completion of a criminal background investigation subject to any federal, state and local laws.
