jobs.title: Software Engineer - Automated Testing
jobs.description: Handi Quilter is a worldwide leader in longarm quilting machines and accessories. We develop innovative products that help quilters create their best work, and we are committed to high\-quality products, responsive service, and a collaborative work environment. Handi Quilter is looking for a software engineer to help us improve the reliability of software for our longarm quilting machines. This position is focused on writing automated tests for Windows applications built with C\# and .NET. You will work directly with our software, mechanical, electrical, product, and support teams. Because our software controls and communicates with physical equipment, you will work on\-site with your manager for the first few weeks while learning our products, systems, and development process. After the initial training period, our team generally works in the office three days per week. Work\-from\-home flexibility is based on demonstrated performance, independence, and the needs of the team and project. We are looking for someone who manages their work responsibly, communicates proactively, and does not require close supervision. **What Matters Most** In order of importance, we are looking for someone with: 1\. Experience writing and maintaining automated software tests. 2\. Strong C\# and .NET programming skills. 3\. The ability to investigate failures, find root causes, and communicate results clearly. 4\. An understanding of practical software\-testing methods and how testing fits into product development. 5\. The ability to mentor manual testers and recommend practical improvements to our testing processes. **What You Will Do** * Build and maintain automated tests for our Windows software using C\#, .NET, and MSTest. * Use Selenium for user\-interface testing where appropriate. Prior Selenium experience is helpful but not required. * Run tests in our build and release process, investigate failures, and clearly document defects and root causes. * Work with developers to improve testability, test coverage, and release quality. * Test software with Handi Quilter machines and related hardware. * Mentor manual testers and recommend practical improvements to our testing processes. **Required Qualifications** * Experience writing production or test code in C\# and .NET. for Microsoft Windows applications or services. * Experience creating automated tests with MSTest, NUnit, xUnit, or a similar framework. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills. * Working knowledge of Git or another version\-control system. * Ability to collaborate with software engineers and other technical teams. * Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and communicate progress without close supervision. * Ability to explain technical problems clearly in writing and conversation. **Preferred Qualifications** * Formal education, coursework, certification, or professional training in software testing or quality engineering. * Experience integrating automated tests into Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or another CI/CD system. * Experience with Selenium or another user\-interface automation tool is helpful but not required. * Experience testing software that communicates with machines, electronics, or other hardware. * Working knowledge of C\+\+. * Familiarity with WPF desktop applications. * Experience working in an Agile development environment. * A degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale. **About the Role** ================== As a **Senior Software Engineer** on the Consumer Experience team, you'll build the products that connect millions of students with employers. You'll drive meaningful technical initiatives, shape the technical direction of the team, and deliver high\-quality, scalable solutions that directly impact one of the fastest\-growing career platforms in the world. **Your Role** ============= * Lead the design and development of consumer\-facing features that enhance user engagement and streamline the student\-employer connection process * Architect and scale distributed systems to support millions of users, ensuring high availability and performance * Influence technical direction by collaborating with cross\-functional teams to align engineering efforts with business goals * Mentor and elevate engineers across the team, fostering a culture of growth and technical excellence * Champion engineering best practices that raise the bar on product quality and team efficiency **Desired Capabilities** ======================== * 8\+ years of software engineering experience with a proven track record of owning and delivering large\-scale, complex systems * Demonstrated experience operating at a staff\-level scope, influencing technical direction across multiple teams * Expertise in building and scaling distributed systems, preferably within consumer platforms or social products * Strong proficiency in Go, Python, or JavaScript with a focus on maintainable, high\-quality production systems * Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern system design principles * Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences * Experience mentoring senior engineers and elevating engineering culture **Extra Credit** ================ * Background in search, recommendations, ranking systems, or personalization at scale * Experience with user identity knowledge graphs, including entity resolution and real\-time inference * Experience building AI\-powered systems, including LLM\-based applications * Prior experience in high\-growth or rapidly scaling environments **Perks** ========= Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported—and thrive at work and in life. The below benefits are for full\-time US employees. **Ownership:** Equity in a fast\-growing company **Financial Wellness:** 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching **Family Support:** Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching **Wellbeing:** Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, wellness stipend **Growth:** Learning stipend, ongoing development **Remote \& Office:** Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office **Time Off:** Flexible PTO, 15 holidays \+ 2 flex days **Connection:** Team outings \& referral bonuses Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at **joinhandshake.com/careers**. Compensation Range: $225K \- $250K

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (Ranking & Relevance)
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote; New York City; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- All Cost CentersResearch \& DevelopmentEngineering \& TechnologyEngineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $265\.2K – $331\.5K • Offers Equity We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential. 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. **About Ranking \& Relevance at Headway** Every patient who comes to Headway is asking one question: which of these therapists is right for me? Ranking \& Relevance owns the answer. We build the retrieval and machine\-learned ranking systems that decide which providers a patient sees, in what order, and why \- across search, matching and personalization. Headway is a three\-sided marketplace, and the engine that powers that marketplace is the match\-making system. A good match means a patient who books and stays in care, a provider whose caseload fills with the clients they are genuinely good at, and a payer whose members get effective care. Those goals overlap most of the time and compete some of the time, and this team owns that tradeoff in code. It is the hardest product problem at Headway, and match quality is not a vanity metric: the gap between a good match and a poor one is the difference between a patient who stays in care and one who gives up on it. Today our matching is still largely filter\-based. We are rebuilding it as an intelligent system that uses communication style, data\-backed expertise signals, patient\-reported outcomes and real behavioral signals to surface the right provider for each patient at the moment they are ready to book. Learning\-to\-rank went live this year and has already moved patient conversion, cancellations, provider activation and payer utilization. That is the first mile of a much longer road. **Principles that guide us** * Mutual matches, not clicks. We optimize for matches that hold up months later, not impressions that convert today. * Measured or it didn't happen. Every change ships behind an experiment with a decision rule agreed in advance. * Own the outcome, not the model. The team that trains a model ships it, runs it and improves it, pager included. * Clinical stakes are engineering stakes. A ranking regression is not a dashboard problem. It changes who gets care, and how soon. **About this role** We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Ranking \& Relevance. You will lead eight engineers today \- a mix of senior software and machine\-learning engineers. You will partner daily with a staff product manager, two data scientists, and the payer and provider engineering organizations whose outcomes depend on your ranker. This is a domain\-depth role, not a span\-of\-control role. The systems are young enough that your technical judgment will shape them, and consequential enough that a ranking regression is visible to the whole company within days. You will report to the Director of Engineering for Core Patient Experience and work alongside the managers for onboarding, profiles and checkout, and activation, so what your team builds lands in the same patient journey theirs does. **The problems you'll solve in your first year** * Make matching intelligent rather than filter\-based. Ranking today leans on filters and hand\-tuned boosts. You will lead the shift to a system that learns from communication style, expertise signals, outcomes data and real behavior, and you will decide where a model belongs and where a simpler rule is honestly better. * R ealthcare marketplace, with a direct line from your team's work to whether a patient finds the right therapist. * Build the ranking discipline at a company early enough for your standards to become the standards. * Work on a problem where the business metric and the human outcome point the same direction. * Define what AI\-augmented engineering looks like on a team where the product itself is machine learning. **Our interview process** After you apply to Headway, here are some details of what to expect during the interview process. * Initial screen: You'll connect with someone in recruiting so you can learn more about the team, Headway's mission and exciting growth, and we can get a better idea of your background. * First rounds: You'll meet with an engineering leader on the team to go deeper into your team and people leadership experience. You'll also complete an AI Coding round — a collaborative session where we're less focused on syntax and more on how you think through problems and work with AI tools in a technical context. * Final rounds: You'll meet team members across product and engineering leadership for multiple behavioral interviews and one more technical interview (System Design), leaving you with a fuller picture of what it's like to work at Headway. * References and the Offer: Our favorite part of the process! We'll send over all of the details, including specifics on employee equity, and congratulatory messages from excited future team members! **Compensation and Benefits:** ------------------------------ The expected base pay range for this position is $265,200 \- $331,500, based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for an equity grant, depending on the position and level. *We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.* * Benefits offered include: + Equity compensation + Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage + HSA / FSA + 401K + Work\-from\-Home Stipend + Therapy Reimbursement + 16\-week parental leave for eligible employees + Carrot Fertility annual reimbursement and membership + 13 paid holidays each year as well as a Holiday Break during the week between December 25th and December 31st + Flexible PTO + Employee Assistance Program (EAP) + Training and professional development We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview. Headway participates in E\-Verify. A notice to Headway applicants: To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that Headway only accepts applications through our official careers page at https://headway.co/careers. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com email address. If you are contacted by someone claiming to be from Headway via an unofficial channel, please do not share any information and report it as spam.

Mentor and support Level I Enterprise Support Engineers by sharing technical expertise related to internal systems, tools, and processes. esign, build, and maintain a technical equipment inventory system to ensure required resources are available for support operations. Develop, document, and implement support processes and best practices to improve response times, service quality, and customer satisfaction. Collaborate with sales, finance, marketing, development, and other internal teams to understand customer requirements and implement effective technical solutions. jobs.title: Buyer
jobs.description: JOB SUMMARY: While upholding Hoyt’s Policies and Mission and Values Statement, the Junior Buyer is responsible for procurement of supplies, materials, and services for Hoyt to provide optimum value for the company. I – ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: *Responsible for ordering and timely delivery of products and services:*Uses forecast generated from Production planning to create Purchase Orders for inventoried items based on requirements. Places orders with suppliers, confirms/negotiates pricing and delivery, and enters the purchase orders into Manage 2000\. Reviews delivery dates of all open purchase orders and communicates with suppliers to ensure materials are received when needed. Works closely with Accounts Payable and Receiving departments to research and resolve quantity and/or pricing discrepancies on invoices. Production support: Supports the production floor with its immediate materials needs. Determines action/s required and acts accordingly. Actions might include expediting parts, locating parts in house, counting inventory, identifying / resolving root cause. Negotiates pricing, freight terms and credit terms with suppliers. Works closely with Supplier’s to ensure the proper amount of inventory is being ordered. Adjusts inventory levels up and down with seasonality trends and forecast requirements to ensure the proper amount of inventory. Works closely with suppliers to understand and reduce lead times. Review requisitions, place purchase orders for all non\-inventory needs. Works closely with Engineering during new product design and implementation. Recommends current suppliers or sources new suppliers for materials for the new product year or for mid\-year changes. As new technologies are introduced and become available, forwards information to Engineering for consideration. Works with engineers and suppliers to solve problems that arise concerning parts. Attends regular meetings and communicates frequently with Inventory, Production, Quality, Accounting, and Engineering. Participates in project teams as assigned. ***Hoyt Management System:*** Works with the Purchasing Manager to communicate and resolve supplier quality alerts. With the assistance of suppliers, develops cause analysis and preventative actions plans. **Additional Responsibilities:** Responsible for general housekeeping of their desk; works all scheduled hours; maintains good attendance; adheres to all safety policies, procedures, and rules; adheres to the company’s Tobacco Free policy; and performs other duties as assigned by top management. II – JOB REQUIREMENTS: **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** This position requires: * General knowledge of computers and software packages such as word processing and excel. * Basic knowledge of supply chain management. * Writing skills to be able to properly communicate procedures, memos, contract terms, and quality issues. * Interpersonal skills including the ability to tactfully direct the work of others as well as outside the department and suppliers. * Negotiation skills * Basic math skills. * Critical thinking skills. **Training and Education:***Type of Training* Associates Degree in Business or related field required, B.S. degree preferred. Additional training and professional development through seminars and involvement in a professional association is encouraged. **Required Prior Work Experience:**##### **Type of Experience Length of Experience** Purchasing experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment 1\-3 years array of commodity experience. Note: Management reserves the right to require specific training for this position. However, depending upon the type and the quality of prior work experience, some exchanges can be made between training and experience. III – QUALITY AND COMPETENCY REQUIREMENTS: **Decision Making and Problem Solving:** The Junior Buyer is responsible for investing the company's money to realize the greatest return. This individual recommends and implements strategies to develop and maintain a reliable supplier base capable of meeting Hoyt’s requirements. Problems are solved by considering courses of actions within the framework of management’s goals and standards. **Interaction with Others:** The Junior Buyer regularly interfaces with all levels of personnel throughout the organization. This individual works with suppliers to ensure healthy relationships and to maintain an open line of communication for the discussion of business issues with the suppliers. **Supervisory and Leadership Responsibilities:** This position does not directly supervise others. IV \- WORKING ENVIRONMENT: **Physical environment** **–** **This position spends most of the time in an office environment at a desk with potential exposure to wrist and eye strain from computer use. Some time is spent in the production area with potential exposure to slips and falls and varying temperatures and noise levels.** -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ***Mental pressure*** \- This position is a highly stressful one in that there are constant deadlines to meet. There are constant interruptions that can be distracting to work requiring accuracy and concentration.* *Note: The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the employer.*

as Code (Terraform). * Experience building and managing CI/CD platforms using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes platforms including AKS, GKE, and OpenShift. * Experience administering and supporting enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly. * Experience implementing software supply chain security, dependency governance, vulnerability remediation, and secure software delivery practices. * Strong Linux/Unix administration and Windows administration experience. * Advanced scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python. * Experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI\-assisted development tools. * Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and platform reliability practices. * Experience supporting enterprise\-scale DevOps platforms and developer enablement initiatives. * Experience operating within HIPAA, SOC2, or other regulated compliance environments. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise DevOps platforms. * Experience leading enterprise DevOps platform modernization, onboarding, adoption, and governance initiatives. * Familiarity with DORA metrics and DevOps models. * Experience integrating automated testing, security scanning, and compliance controls into CI/CD pipelines. * Experience supporting healthcare technology platforms or other highly regulated industries. * Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, or related cloud certifications. * Experience with software supply chain security and governance frameworks. * Healthcare industry experience preferred. **Additional Information:** Limited Geography Remote \- This is a remote position but located within a specific geography. To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees' ability to work effectively, the self\-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. Humana will provide Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees with telephone equipment appropriate to meet the business requirements for their position/job. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required. **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40**Pay Range** The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $106,900 \- $147,000 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.**Description of Benefits** Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices. * Deploy and manage Kubernetes platforms (AKS, GKE, OpenShift). * Own and administer enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly. * Support Humana Military and enterprise teams through software supply chain security, artifact governance, and platform operations. * Implement vulnerability management, dependency governance, and secure software delivery practices. * Design and support feature flag management and progressive delivery capabilities using LaunchDarkly. * Develop automation and self\-service solutions using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and AI\-assisted engineering tools. * Ensure HIPAA, SOC2, and regulatory compliance across DevOps platforms and processes. * Configure and support enterprise build agents and runners across Linux, Windows, and GitHub Runner environments. * Provide L3 support, incident response, root cause analysis, and on\-call support for critical platform services. * Create engineering standards, documentation, reusable templates, and developer enablement resources while participating in Agile delivery practices. **Use your skills to make an impact** ===================================== **Required Qualifications** **Experience** * 7\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, platform engineering, or operations. * 5\+ years of hands\-on DevOps engineering experience. * Experience designing and supporting cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP. * Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). * Experience building and managing CI/CD platforms using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes platforms including AKS, GKE, and OpenShift. * Experience administering and supporting enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly. * Experience implementing software supply chain security, dependency governance, vulnerability remediation, and secure software delivery practices. * Strong Linux/Unix administration and Windows administration experience. * Advanced scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python. * Experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI\-assisted development tools. * Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and platform reliability practices. * Experience supporting enterprise\-scale DevOps platforms and developer enablement initiatives. * Experience operating within HIPAA, SOC2, or other regulated compliance environments. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise DevOps platforms. * Experience leading enterprise DevOps platform modernization, onboarding, adoption, and governance initiatives. * Familiarity with DORA metrics and DevOps models. * Experience integrating automated testing, security scanning, and compliance controls into CI/CD pipelines. * Experience supporting healthcare technology platforms or other highly regulated industries. * Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, or related cloud certifications. * Experience with software supply chain security and governance frameworks. * Healthcare industry experience preferred. **Additional Information:** Limited Geography Remote \- This is a remote position but located within a specific geography. To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees' ability to work effectively, the self\-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. Humana will provide Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees with telephone equipment appropriate to meet the business requirements for their position/job. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required. **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40**Pay Range** The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $106,900 \- $147,000 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.**Description of Benefits** Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Architect
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= Are you interested in leveraging technology and business strategy to deliver improved member \& patient experiences as well as health outcomes? Are you IT Professional obsessed with a business\-centric outlook? At the Humana Enterprise Architecture unit, our mission is to deliver a perfect member/patient experience by bringing forth the alignment of business strategy to technology strategy, enabling the effective and efficient execution of the technology strategy and to facilitate the adoption and delivery of the Humana Enterprise Architecture principles, standards, policies and methodologies. The Senior Enterprise Architect translates business needs into technical systems solutions and architectural roadmaps. The Senior Enterprise Architect work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of variable factors. You will report to the Director of Enterprise Architecture. As a Senior Enterprise Architect, you play a pivotal role in the alignment of the business vision, technology strategy and framing enterprise standards. You will be an integral part of the delivery of critical business outcomes, as well as the creation of technology strategies to leverage the IT. Additionally, as a Senior Enterprise Architect, you will provide mentorship and guidance to other enterprise, solution, technology, and system architects across Humana. * Serve as a strong advocate for the business within IT and ensure that technology execution aligns with business strategy. * Help achieve value\-driven outcomes by ensuring Humana's Technology Strategy is executed in alignment with corporate vision and segment business strategies. * Engage in enterprise technology modernization initiatives working with the application teams and key business and IT stakeholders and help deliver value through architecture guidance and execution support. * Mentor pattern\-based development with a strong focus on resource \& cost optimization. * Serve as an evangelist for, facilitate and drive adoption and delivery of the lean enterprise architecture practice within an agile delivery framework. * Collaborate with business and technical teams and leadership to align and map the jobs.description: Overview: Together, We Enhance Innovation and Growth i2G specializes in advanced physical electronic security and life safety solutions. I2G has proven experience in surveillance, access control, and intrusion detection systems, biometrics, fence sensors, radars, ground sensors, anti\-drone technologies, and more. This **Electronic Security Systems Engineer** position will provide engineering design and support for security solutions for new and existing clients while working alongside internal teams, external teams, clients, and subcontractors to ensure project success. Qualifications: * A minimum of 3\-7 years previous experience in the industry. * Associate or bachelor’s degree in relevant field preferred or applicable amount of experience in the appropriate field may be substituted for the educational background. * Experience in the design and planning of access control and video systems. * Professional Electronic Security Certifications or training (Lenel, Genetec, C\-Cure. Avigilon, Axis, Bosch, Milestone, etc.) preferred. jobs.title: Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS) Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- Intel Corporation is one of the world's leading semiconductor companies, driving innovation that shapes the future of technology. From powering the devices people use every day to enabling breakthroughs in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and advanced manufacturing, Intel is at the forefront of what's next. Our Ocotillo campus in Chandler, Arizona is one of Intel's most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites in the United States, representing a significant investment in domestic chip production and American technological leadership. At Intel, we believe in the power of human ingenuity — and we're looking for bold, curious, and driven engineers to help us build the future. We are seeking a talented and motivated Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS) Software Engineer to join our team at Intel's Ocotillo campus in Chandler, Arizona. In this critical role, you will be at the heart of Fab 62's operations, designing, developing, and sustaining the software systems that power the automated movement and storage of semiconductor wafers and reticles across our world\-class manufacturing facility. You will work in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment alongside cross\-functional teams, equipment vendors, and automation partners to ensure our factory automation systems operate at the highest levels of reliability and performance. This is a unique opportunity to make a direct and meaningful impact on semiconductor manufacturing in the United States. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Design, develop, test, validate, debug, and sustain** software solutions that support automated material handling and storage systems across the Ocotillo campus. * **Support the integration, installation, qualification, and startup** of AMHS and manufacturing equipment for Fab 62 and campus\-wide operations. * **Enable reliable automated movement and storage** of semiconductor wafers and reticles throughout the OTF campus, ensuring operational continuity and production readiness. * **Collaborate with manufacturing customers, operations teams, and project stakeholders** to identify requirements and deliver effective automation solutions. * **Partner with the AMHS Command Center and Project Management Office (PMO)** to troubleshoot operational issues, manage escalations, and drive timely resolution of system events. * **Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions** to continuously improve system reliability, performance, and maintainability. * **Work cross\-functionally with Intel Foundry Automation organizations and external suppliers** to support ongoing system enhancements and operational excellence. * **Participate in an on\-call rotation** supporting a 24x7 high\-availability automation environment, with flexibility to adjust scheduled hours to support new factory project milestones. **As a Successful Candidate, You Will Bring:** * **Strong communication skills —** skills **Attention to detail —** meticulous in testing, validation, and documentation to ensure system accuracy and reliability. * **Proactive problem\-solving attitude —** takes ownership of challenges and drives issues through to resolution with urgency and thoroughness. * **Resilience under pressure —** maintains composure and effectiveness when managing escalations or high\-priority system events. * **Curiosity and continuous learning —** eager to stay current with emerging automation technologies and manufacturing best practices. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience would be obtained through a combination of prior education level classes, and current level school classes, projects, research and relevant previous job and/or internship experience. This Position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's or master’s degree in STEM, computer science, computer engineering, information systems, or a related field. * Work in a 24x7 high\-availability environment and participate in an on\-call rotation. * 1\+ years of experience with any of the following: + Unix/Linux operating environments. + Familiarity with VB scripting, SQL query writing, and log analysis tools. + Data extraction and analysis. + Troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, with experience applying Model\-Based Problem Solving methodologies. **Preferred Qualifications:** * 1\+ years of experience in: + Project Management and Lean Six Sigma methods + Semiconductor or advanced manufacturing experience **Job Type:** ------------- Experienced Hire **Shift:** ---------- Shift 1 (United States of America) **Primary Location:** --------------------- US, Arizona, Phoenix **Additional Locations:** ------------------------- **Posting Statement:** ---------------------- All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. **Position of Trust** --------------------- N/A **Benefits** ------------ We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. jobs.title: Software Developer/Analyst
jobs.description: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non\-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions\-driven, passionate change\-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world\-wide for a better future. We aim to make our programs a model for the highest global standards and to cultivate power and lasting change not just for our clients but for all people affected by humanitarian crises. To achieve that vision, the IRC’s Technical Excellence (TE) group, located within the Crisis Response, Recovery and Development (CRRD) Department, provides technical assistance to IRC’s country program staff and shares what we learn to influence policy and practice. IRC’s Technical Excellence team is comprised of seven teams which have deep expertise in their respective fields: Education, Economic Wellbeing, Governance, Health, Violence Prevention and Response, MEAL, and Grants \& Operations. **Monitoring, Evaluation, Technology, Accountability, and Learning at the IRC** The METAL Unit is responsible for supporting CRRD to have a culture of strong data and evidence use through stewardship of the Data \& Performance Ecosystem, and for coordinating successful piloting and uptake of innovative technology solutions. The METAL Unit provides specialized support across four pillars to strengthen program effectiveness, improve decision\-making, and enhance organizational learning: Global MEAL Practice, Technology for Programs, Regional MEAL Support, and CRRD Data \& Analytics. **Job Overview** The Software Developer will be part of the METAL team which is responsible for delivering products that support the collection, management and visualization of KPIs relevant to higher\-level decision\-making for CRRD Programs. The Software Developer will build and support data tools that drive decision\-making across IRC, working with platforms like PowerApps, Power BI, Databricks, and Azure SQL. They will be a skilled contributor to the CRRD Data \& Analytics team with strong experience in Microsoft PowerApps and Power Automate. Specific tasks include data platform development, support, configuration, technical assistance and routing of technical issues, 2nd line help desk support, and participation in setting standards for processes, data quality, data security, and systems configuration. The Software Developer will report to the Technology Development Lead. They will work closely with other developers, QA, Project Manager and the Program Data Systems Product Manager. **Major Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain PowerApps and Power Automate solutions * Support development and rollout of organization\-wide data products in collaboration with METAL and sector experts * Create technical documentation including system diagrams and implementation manuals * Implement and maintain data quality processes and development standards * Ensure compliance with IRC’s data protection, confidentiality, and security policies * Provide Tier\-2 and Tier\-3 technical support, including issue routing and resolution * Collaborate with IT and data engineering teams on systems integration * Review software requirements and translate them into development tasks * Contribute to setting and enforcing standards for processes, data quality, and system configurations * Provide hyper\-support during pilot phases of technology rollouts * Perform other duties as assigned **Key Working Relationships** * Position Reports to: Technology Development Lead * Direct Reports: None * Management in Partnership: None **Key Internal Relationships:** * METAL Product Managers * METAL QA Analyst * METAL Project Manager * IT Data Team **Desired Experience and Skills** * At least five years of experience working in technology domain to develop and rollout data platforms for programs – out of which, at least three years of experience developing, implementing, and supporting PowerApps applications for large and complex programs. * Experience in source code and version control platforms, for example, GitHub, Azure DevOps, or similar. * Strong in team development processes including pair programming, shadow sessions, code reviews and other strategies to ensure high quality programing. * Strong code quality assurance practices including unit testing, integration testing, as well as regression testing to ensure quality of the code getting shipped into production. * Ability to effectively communicate in English both in verbal (i.e., day\-to\-day discussions, team meetings) and written (requirements and design specifications) form, as well as an overall ability to be clear and concise in all communications. * Strong analytic curiosity and innovative problem\-solving skills using a system thinking approach. * Demonstrable ability to work both independently and in a dynamic, cross\-functional team structure. * Demonstrable ability to establish and maintain working relationships across all departments and levels of the organization. **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related discipline * Experience with Databricks, Dataverse connectors, APIs, and Microsoft Azure * Certifications such Microsoft Power Platform Developer are an added advantage **Compensation:** (US Pay Rate: $85,000 \- $95,000/yr; UK Pay Rate: £46,780 \- £55,552/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements. **Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way \- Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, AI-Native Developer Platform
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit's 8,000\+ developers build products that power the financial lives of hundreds of millions of people. PDX — Platform Developer Experience is the team that makes those developers faster, safer, and more effective. Our north star is 3x Developer Velocity: measurably tripling the speed at which developers move from idea to production — not through incremental tooling improvements, but through a fundamental shift to AI\-native, Done\-For\-You platform experiences. We're looking for a Staff PM who can operate at the intersection of strategy and execution across multiple platform layers simultaneously — infrastructure, operational intelligence, developer tooling, and production reliability. You won't just define what gets built. You'll shape how PDX thinks about AI\-native platform design, define the measurement frameworks that show up in company\-wide goal reporting, and move 8,000 developers faster by changing the platform beneath them. This role sits at the frontier of how enterprise developer platforms are evolving: from infrastructure teams that ship APIs, to intelligence teams that ship AI\-native experiences directly in developer workflows. If that transition excites you, read on. Why This Role Is Exciting * You'll operate across multiple platform layers simultaneously — infrastructure, data intelligence, developer tooling — each with different users, adoption motions, and success metrics * You must drive adoption without mandate across 8,000\+ developers and dozens of platform teams * You're defining new interaction models (natural language interfaces, MCP\-based tooling, agentic workflows) — not iterating on existing ones * Success requires changing developer behavior at scale, not just shipping features * You'll own measurement frameworks that directly feed executive\-level goal reporting — the numbers have to be right, and the story has to be clear The 3x Developer Velocity Mission 3x is not a slogan — it's a design constraint. Every platform capability PDX builds is evaluated against one question: does this meaningfully reduce time spent on toil across the developer lifecycle? As Staff PM, you will own the measurement framework that makes 3x visible and credible: * Inner Loop: Lead Time to Change, PR Merge Velocity, Coding Start Time * Outer Loop: Deploy Time, Incident Resolution, Infrastructure Config Time * RDR Loop: Change Failure Rate, MTTR, Agent\-Driven Proficiency * Your products should move these numbers. Your dashboards should prove it. What You'll Own This role will focus on one or two of the following areas based on candidate strengths and business priorities, while influencing the broader PDX ecosystem as a Staff\-level contributor. * ODL Intelligence — Unlocking Intuit's Operational Data Lake (Key Strategic Investment) Transform Intuit's Operational Data Lake from a resource accessible only to SQL experts into an AI\-native, self\-serve intelligence platform — where any PM, TPM, developer, or engineering leader gets operational insights in seconds using natural language. Own the product strategy across five pillars: DFY Ingestion, Data Catalog \& Consumption, AI/ML Enablement, Mid\-Market Readiness, and Scalable Governance. jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** In this role, you will report to the Electrical Engineering Manager and serve as a principal technical and project lead for development of electromechanical chassis systems, including steering and driveline products. This position requires a strong understanding of overall software and hardware development processes, practical experience with embedded systems and test environments, and the ability to provide hands\-on technical support when needed. This is a principal role for an engineer who can align project goals, technical tasks, and development resources while also contributing directly to problem solving, testing, and system integration. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Lead complex engineering programs by defining project objectives, managing risks and resources, and coordinating cross\-functional teams to achieve customer and business goals. * Serve as the technical authority for software, electronic hardware, system integration, and control system development, providing guidance on architecture, requirements, technical reviews, and issue resolution. * Lead technical reviews of requirements, specifications, interfaces, drawings, validation plans, and test results, providing recommendations to improve product performance, quality, manufacturability, and development efficiency. * Define and lead verification and validation activities, including planning, traceability, test coverage, and the development of calibration, diagnostic, communication, and test tools to support efficient product development and issue resolution. * Support product launch and production by partnering with manufacturing, quality, and supplier management teams to resolve production issues, implement corrective actions, and improve quality, yield, and process robustness. * Lead and contribute to critical technical activities across product development, integration, validation, and production support, providing hands\-on expertise in problem solving, technical reviews, and issue resolution when required. * Work additional hours, including weekends, when directed by the immediate supervisor or when necessary to complete essential job duties. * Develop and maintain responsive, cooperative relationships with internal and external customers while treating others with dignity, trust, and respect. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but includes project leadership, technical leadership, mentoring, and coordination of cross\-functional engineering activities. **Job Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * Strong understanding of electromechanical systems, embedded controls, electrical architectures, vehicle networks, diagnostics, and system integration. * Strong understanding of automotive software and hardware development processes, including requirements management, model\-based development, verification and validation, configuration management, and V\-cycle development. * Ability to apply control theory, system modeling, signal analysis, and closed\-loop control principles to system design, performance evaluation, and problem solving. * Working knowledge of HIL, dynamometer, laboratory, and vehicle test environments, including system integration, instrumentation, test automation, and data acquisition. * Working knowledge of automotive communication protocols and development tools, including CAN/CAN FD, diagnostics, calibration, and measurement systems. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and technical communication skills. **Benefits:** * Medical, Dental, Optical * Supplementary Insurance * Optional Benefits (pet insurance, legal consultation, cyber security, retirement support, mental health services, etc.) * 401K (With match) * HSA contribution * Success Sharing * Paid Time\-Off * Educational Reimbursement **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline required; Master's degree preferred. * Minimum 10 years of experience developing automotive electromechanical systems, preferably steering, braking, chassis, driveline, or other safety\-critical products. * Experience leading complex product development programs from concept through production launch and field support. * Experience with engineering risk assessment and structured problem\-solving methodologies, including FMEA, FTA, 8D, and root\-cause investigation. * Experience using automotive development and validation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, Vector CANoe/CANalyzer/CANape, HIL platforms, calibration tools, and data acquisition systems. * Experience supporting product launch and manufacturing operations, including troubleshooting production issues and implementing corrective actions. * Experience with functional safety and automotive development processes, including ISO 26262, ASPICE, CMMI, or equivalent methodologies, preferred. * Experience applying automation, data analytics, machine learning, or AI\-based tools to improve engineering productivity, testing efficiency, or decision\-making is a plus. **Work Environment:** * Work is mostly performed in a normal office setting with minimal exposure to health or safety hazards, and with substantial time spent working on a computer. * Performing this position may occasionally require exposure to manufacturing areas which require the use of personal protective equipment such as safety glasses with side shields and mandatory hearing protection. * Travel by automobile and plane required approximately 5\-10% of time.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer III
jobs.description: At Jack Henry, we’re more than a technology company, we’re a force for good in financial services. We’re redefining how community banks and credit unions connect with the people they serve. Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. We deliver cutting\-edge solutions that are paving the way for the next generation of digital banking and payments, but our true impact begins with our associates. If you're ready to help transform an industry and grow with a company that values purpose, collaboration, and excellence then we’d love to meet you. We are seeking a talented and self\-motivated Systems Engineer with the ability to work in a team environment and drive for results. This individual will have advanced Commvault knowledge with a strong VMware infrastructure skillset. This team is responsible for the underlying infrastructure at Jack Henry which is inclusive of hypervisor and data protection. We participate in driving projects to completion and also internal initiatives. The ideal candidate should enjoy working collaboratively while also being able to work independently. This environment is fast paced, challenging, and rewarding. This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70\-mile radius of our office locations in Louisville, KY; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Cedar Falls, IA; Allen, TX; Lenexa, KS; Springfield, MO; or Monett, MO. This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H\-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in\-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity. **What you’ll be responsible for:*** Develops and designs complex system architectures that meet business requirements and performance objectives. * Performs IT functions such as design, analysis, evaluation, testing, debugging and implementation of applications programs in support of one or more functional areas. * Executes test processes and scenarios, tracks results, and makes recommendations of system fixes. * Implements security best practices and measures to protect systems from internal and external threats. * Performs troubleshooting and remediation, ensures successful project implementation, and performs post project end user support. * Manages and documents system configurations and oversees all transitions into production. * Coordinates with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure project deliverables are met on time and within budget. * Ensures compliance with industry standards, regulations, and organizational policies related to data security and privacy. * May perform other job duties as assigned. **What you’ll need to have:*** A minimum of 4 years of data protection and disaster recovery experience. * A minimum of 3 years of experience with hypervisor. * Experience using PowerShell, Python, or other scripting tools to automate work and improve day\-to\-day processes. * Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience. * Experience as an individual contributor in projects. * Ability to participate in an on\-call rotation. * Experience troubleshooting scripts, code, or automation workflows when supporting technical processes. * Contributes to the team, shares knowledge, and helps move work and projects forward. **What would be nice for you to have:*** Experience with Zerto or other disaster recovery tools. * Experience building self\-service or request\-based workflows. * Experience working with enterprise storage platforms or storage concepts. * Experience with APIs, GitHub or other source control tools, Terraform, or Ansible is a plus. If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team. **Why Jack Henry?** At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “*Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.”* It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. We recognize that our associates are the key to our success, and we’re deeply committed to their wellbeing. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally. We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders. **Culture of Commitment** Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. Visit our Corporate Sustainability site to learn more about our culture and commitment to our people, customers, community, environment, and shareholders. **Equal Employment Opportunity** At Jack Henry, we know we are better together. We value, respect, and protect the uniqueness each of us brings. Innovation flourishes by including all voices and makes our business \- and our society \- stronger. Jack Henry is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing equal opportunity in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, performance management, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, education, training, social, and recreational activities to all persons regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, and military and veteran status, or any other protected status protected by local, state or federal law. jobs.title: Engineering Development Program - Electrification
jobs.description: There are over 7 billion people on this planet. And by 2050, there will be 2 billion more... many moving into urban centers at an unprecedented rate. Making sure there is enough food, fiber and infrastructure for our rapidly growing world is what we're all about at John Deere. And it's why we're investing in our people and our technology like never before! Here the world's brightest minds are tackling the world's biggest challenges. If you believe one person can make the world a better place, we'll put you to work. RIGHT NOW. *John Deere is an equal opportunity employer, including disabled \& veterans.* ***Primary Location:*** *United States (US) \- Illinois \- Moline* ***Function:*** *Product Engineering (CA)* ***Title:*** *Engineering Development Program \- Electrification \- 123504* ***Onsite/Remote:****Onsite Position* **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- Engineering Development Program (EDP) for Product Engineering. Provides graduating engineers an opportunity to gather experiences and exposures throughout John Deere. Provides rotational opportunities to develop an understanding of John Deere's products and services and establish a network of people to support personal and professional growth. Performs Product Engineering assignments. Available locations for Electrification EDPs Moline, IL and Waterloo, IA. An Electrification EDP supports product analysis, design, and/or testing activities for electric drive components and systems used on vehicles worldwide. Specific activities vary by rotation but will include one or more of the following responsibilities: * Electrification system and vehicle development inclusive of design, analysis, vehicle integration, and testing of electric drive systems consisting of batteries, inverters, motors, converters, and chargers to meet vehicle performance goals. This includes requirements, system concepting, vehicle integration and interfaces, lab testing of system performance, and vehicle testing of performance. * Electric machine development inclusive of design, analysis, and testing of 250W \- 200kW\+ surface permanent magnet motors and internal permanent magnet motors, electromagnetic design, thermal design, high speed structural design, position sensing, and mechanical design. * Power electronics hardware development inclusive of design, analysis, and testing of inverters, converters, and chargers. Topology, power stage, sensing, thermals, power passive components, and packaging. * Control systems for motor drives and converters inclusive of simulation, implementation, and system testing of new algorithms, control system parameters, physical system modeling, system identification, signal estimation, and advanced diagnostics/prognostics. * Embedded control system development for electric powertrain systems and products utilizing Model Based System Design methodology. VISA Sponsorship is NOT available for this position **What Skills You Need** ------------------------ * Excellent communication skills. * Working knowledge and hands\-on experience testing electrical components using standard lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies. * Familiarity with a symbolic programming language such as Simulink or LabView. * Experience using modeling tools such as Matlab/Simulink or circuit analysis software. * Experience with electric machines, inverters/converters/chargers, Li\-Ion batteries, electric vehicle systems, or electric drive control systems. * Completion of your junior year of studies is required by the time of the internship. Graduate students are preferred for advanced engineering topics. * Strong candidates will have course work or research with a concentration in electric machines, power electronics, batteries, hybrid vehicles, or dynamics and control. * Minimum required cumulative GPA of 2\.8 on a 4\.0 scale. (3\.4 or higher preferred) **Education** ------------- * Currently pursuing or recent college graduate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related Engineering degree with an anticipated graduation date of December 2026 through August 2027 * Desired cumulative GPA of 3\.0 or above on a 4\.0 scale. Minimum cumulative GPA required of 2\.8 on a 4\.0 scale **What You'll Get** At John Deere, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. Here, you'll enjoy the freedom to explore new projects, the support to think outside the box and the advanced tools and technology that foster innovation and achievement. Additionally, we offer a comprehensive reward package to help you get started on your new career path, including: * Flexible work arrangements * Highly competitive base pay * Savings \& Retirement benefits (401K and Defined Contribution) * Healthcare benefits with a generous company contribution in the Health Savings Account * Adoption assistance * Employee Assistance Programs * Tuition assistance * Fitness subsidies and on\-site gyms at specific Deere locations * Charitable contribution match * Employee Purchase Plan \& numerous discount programs for personal use * Vacation and Holiday Pay $67,692\.00 \- $101,532\.00 \+ Benefits Follow this link to learn more about our Total Rewards Package https://bit.ly/3XCd8fL Must be 18 years of age or older to apply The information contained herein is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and qualifications required of individuals performing the job. The qualifications detailed in this job description are not considered the minimum requirements necessary to perform the job, but rather as guidelines. The terms of the applicable benefit plans, and all company actions administering or interpreting these plans, continue to control. Deere \& Company reserves the right to suspend, amend, modify, or terminate the Plan(s) in any manner at any time, including the right to modify or eliminate any cost\-sharing between the company and participants. Changes, which can be made at any time, are made by action of the company's board of directors, or to the extent authorized by resolution of its board of directors, or by the Deere \& Company Compensation Committee. In the event of a conflict between the language of the official Plan Documents and this document, the language of the official Plan Documents will control. jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description: **What you will do** Under general direction from the Installation/Operations Manager and/or Project Manager, you will be responsible for the profitable execution of assigned small dollar Fire Install Projects. Collaborate with Sales, Operations Leadership, and other teams as needed to provide sales support activities early in the project development process, offering input on strategy, vendor/partner selection, scope enhancements, value engineering, risk assessment, and more. You will provide work direction to project execution teams that may include Engineers, Designers, Technicians, Project Coordinators, Estimators, and Subcontractors, ensuring that assigned projects are completed accurately, on\-time, billed, within budget, and within the scope of the contract. You will also be responsible for maintaining positive cash flow and actively pursuing change orders. Ensure that work performed complies with state, local, and Federal legal requirements while upholding the highest ethical standards. You will adhere to and ensure that Johnson Controls staff and subcontractors adhere to all safety standards, following consistent and repeatable project management procedures and processes. Maintain an effective balance between customer satisfaction and project financial results. **How you will do it** Ensure that Johnson Controls resources and our subcontractor/vendor resources are adhering to the site/JCI safety policies, whichever is more stringent. Manage the scope, costs, resources, and risks on assigned projects to deliver projects on time and within budget. Act as the primary on\-site leader for execution teams on assigned projects. Develop a Project Execution Plan, including but not limited to Work Breakdown Structure, Organizational Chart, Safety Plan, Project Schedules, Issues/Risk Logs, and Staffing Requirements to execute projects according to plan. Evaluate the contractual scope of work and the impact of client issued instructions/notices, field directives, and/or project schedule changes. Actively pursue change orders for said changes and additional opportunities. Perform associated cost estimates, prepare proposals, and negotiate final settlement prices as well as customer acceptance. Manage project\-related accounts payable, billing, and collections. Complete project billing with the assistance of the project coordinator in a timely and accurate format to the client to maintain positive cash flow. Review and interpret contract Terms and Conditions to ensure work is completed to customer satisfaction and JCI standards. Analyze financial reporting systems and project schedules to proactively address potential problems. Effectively communicate project progress, issues, and financial status to management as required. Manage risks and establish project recovery plans when required. Resolve disputes with minimal need for escalation. Prepare RFPs, negotiate, and issue subcontracts. Ensure project document controls comply with contract requirements and JCI standards. Oversee project construction for compliance with specifications, local codes, and installation techniques. Manage the selection, ordering, and delivery schedule of materials to be procured for the projects assigned. Develop and maintain viable long\-term relationships with customers, consultants, prime contractors, and subcontractors. Attend job progress meetings as required. Ensure subcontractors understand project expectations. Coordinate with the Installation/Operations Manager and/or Construction Manager for allocation of resources needed to meet project objectives. Ensure any engineering and commissioning performed by the field team is in accordance with established standards. Facilitate escalation of product\-related problems. Assist Installation/Operations Manager and/or sales in project development efforts. Provide feedback on the performance of Engineers and Designers to Engineering and Design Team Leaders as well as Operations Management. Perform Installation to Service turnover toward the end of every project. **What we look for:** Bachelor’s degree in Construction, Civil/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or Architecture is preferred. An Associate degree with equivalent work\-related experience and/or a minimum of five years of direct field experience in the Building Construction Industry is required. Must have the ability to verbally and non\-verbally communicate technical material to both a technical and non\-technical audience. Travel may be required based on project assignment and needs. Must be proficient in Project Management software and financial accounting systems. Experience working with MS Project, MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Adobe Writer, Visio, and basic Windows environment. Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred. **HIRING SALARY RANGE:** $81,500\-$112,000 (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) This role offers a competitive Bonus plan that will take into account individual, group, and corporate performance. This position includes a competitive benefits package.

jobs.title: HVAC Building Controls Application Engineer
jobs.description: **Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team** As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.
