jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Data Centers America
jobs.description: **About FläktGroup** FläktGroup is a global leader in energy\-efficient air technology and mission\-critical cooling solutions, with more than a century of engineering heritage across Europe, North America, and Asia. Our Data Center Cooling business designs and manufactures high\-performance thermal management equipment for the world's largest hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data center operators. Our product portfolio spans four core platforms: Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAH), custom Air Handling Units (AHU), Fan Coil Units and Fan Coil Walls (FCU/FCW), and Coolant Distribution Units (CDU) in both direct\-expansion and liquid\-to\-liquid configurations supporting the rapid growth of AI and high\-density liquid cooling. Our equipment is deployed at some of the most demanding mission\-critical facilities in the world, where uptime, safety, and qualification standards are non\-negotiable. We are building a world\-class in\-house Controls and Electrical Engineering organization and executing a comprehensive product standardization program — moving from project\-by\-project engineering to a single, disciplined standard product architecture. This role is central to that mission. **Position Summary** The Senior Electrical Engineer owns the electrical design of data center cooling equipment from concept through production release and field commissioning. You will develop UL 508A\-compliant control panel designs, produce complete electrical schematic packages in EPLAN Electric P8 and AutoCAD Electrical, and perform all electrical engineering calculations required to substantiate the design — power, protection, sizing, and thermal. You will be a key contributor to our electrical standardization program, converting today's outsourced, project\-specific drawing sets into controlled, reusable, in\-house standard design packages across the CRAH, AHU, FCU/FCW, and CDU product lines. This is a hands\-on senior individual contributor role with significant design authority, cross\-functional visibility with manufacturing and global engineering teams, and direct interaction with hyperscale customers, panel builders, and component vendors. **Key Responsibilities** **Electrical Design \& Schematic Development** * Develop complete electrical schematic packages — power distribution, motor/VFD circuits, control circuits, safety circuits, terminal plans, panel layouts, wire/cable schedules, and interconnection diagrams — using EPLAN Electric P8 and AutoCAD Electrical. * Design industrial control panels in full compliance with UL 508A, including panel layout, component selection, spacing/bending requirements, wire sizing and color coding, and nameplate/marking requirements. * Build and maintain EPLAN master data: symbol libraries, macros, article/parts databases, project templates, and title block standards to enable reusable, configurable standard designs. * Design power circuits for EC fan arrays, VFD\-driven pumps and fans (Yaskawa and equivalent), transformers, control power supplies, UPS backup circuits, and heater loads across 120V–600V, single\- and three\-phase, 50/60 Hz systems. * Design low\-voltage control and instrumentation wiring for Siemens Climatix (POL family) controllers, I/O extension modules, HMIs, sensors, safety relays, and BACnet/Modbus network segments, in coordination with the Controls Engineering team. * Design hardwired safety chains (HOA,E\-stop, smoke detection, leak detection, external interlocks) with fail\-safe, normally\-closed architecture consistent with product safety standards. **Engineering Calculations \& Analysis** * Full Load Amps (FLA) and Minimum Circuit Ampacity (MCA) / Maximum Overcurrent Protection (MOP) calculations for complete units per NEC and UL 60335\-2\-40 / UL 1995 as applicable. * Short\-Circuit Current Rating (SCCR) determination for control panels per UL 508A Supplement SB, including component ratings, series ratings, and current\-limiting device application. * Conductor and cable sizing, ampacity derating, and voltage drop calculations per NEC Articles 310, 430, and 440 for branch circuits, feeders, motor circuits, and control wiring. * Overcurrent protection and coordination: fuse and circuit breaker selection, motor branch\-circuit protection, transformer primary/secondary protection, and selective coordination analysis. * Transformer and control power supply sizing, including inrush, regulation, and load growth margin. * Panel heat load / thermal dissipation calculations and enclosure thermal management design (ventilation, cooling, heater sizing for condensation control). * Motor and VFD sizing verification, harmonic considerations, and 50 Hz vs. 60 Hz parameter validation for equipment built. * Grounding and bonding design, wire pull and conduit fill calculations, and arc\-flash awareness input where required. **Standardization \& Documentation Control** * Serve as document owner for assigned electrical standard documents within the controlled document register chnical direction to external drafting partners and panel builders; review and approve vendor drawings, panel layouts, and as\-built documentation. * Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT): develop electrical test procedures, witness testing, disposition non\-conformances, and drive corrective actions. * Provide root\-cause analysis and engineering disposition for field electrical issues, manufacturing deviations, and supplier quality escapes. **Travel Requirements** This role requires 25–30% travel, domestic and international, including: * Manufacturing plant visits (US and international facilities) for design support, first\-article inspection, and production issue resolution. * Panel builder and supplier facility visits for design reviews, quality audits, and FAT witnessing. * Customer data center sites for SAT support, commissioning assistance, and field issue investigation. * Customer and consultant offices for design review meetings and qualification activities. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (or closely related field) from an accredited program. * 8\+ years of electrical design experience in industrial equipment, HVAC/mechanical equipment, control panels, or mission\-critical infrastructure. * Expert\-level proficiency in EPLAN Electric P8 — including project structuring, macro development, article management, and cross\-referencing — and strong working proficiency in AutoCAD Electrical. * Demonstrated ownership of UL 508A panel designs, including SCCR calculations per Supplement SB; UL 508A MTR certification or ability to obtain within 6 months. * Strong command of the NEC (NFPA 70\), particularly Articles 310, 409, 430, and 440, and the ability to perform and document all supporting calculations independently (FLA/MCA/MOP, voltage drop, conductor sizing, protection coordination, transformer sizing, panel heat load). * Hands\-on experience with VFDs, EC motors, three\-phase power distribution, control transformers, and 24V control architectures. * Experience producing complete, production\-ready drawing packages and managing formal document revision control. * Ability to travel 25–30%, including internationally (valid passport required). **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with data center cooling equipment (CRAH, CRAC, AHU, fan walls, CDUs) or other mission\-critical HVAC products. * Familiarity with hyperscale customer qualification programs and their electrical/EMC/safety requirements. * Working knowledge of BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP/RTU, and controls integration concepts; exposure to Siemens Climatix or similar DDC/PLC platforms. * Knowledge of IEC standards, CE marking, and IECEE CB Scheme for multi\-market product certification; understanding of 50/60 Hz design deltas. * Familiarity with UL 60335\-2\-40, UL 1995, IEC 62443 cybersecurity concepts, and IEEE color book methods. * Professional Engineer (PE) license or progress toward licensure. * Experience working with global engineering teams across time zones. **What We Offer** * A ground\-floor role in building an in\-house electrical engineering capability and a durable product standardization program. * High\-visibility work on equipment deployed at the world's largest data center operators, at the center of the AI infrastructure buildout. * Modern engineering toolchain (EPLAN Electric P8, AutoCAD Electrical), (EPLAN certification). * Competitive salary, performance bonus, comprehensive benefits, and career growth within a global engineering organization. *FläktGroup is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.* Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee discount * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Electrical Designer (Revit)
jobs.description: Overview: SSOE is seeking mid\-to\-senior level **Electrical Designers with strong Revit experience** for our **Industrial Facilities team**. This position is ideal for a mid\-to\-senior level electrical design professional who combine strong technical expertise with advanced Revit capabilities and a collaborative approach to project delivery. You will develop and coordinate detailed electrical designs, create and manage Revit models, and work closely with engineers, designers, and project teams to deliver high\-quality solutions for some of the world's leading industrial clients. The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of electrical systems design, experience working within industrial facilities sector, and demonstrated proficiency using Revit as a primary design and coordination tool. **\*\*This role will be hybrid with regular commuting to our Toledo, Ohio office\*\*** **Why Join SSOE?** Our growth trajectory allows us to offer the opportunities normally associated with a large firm while embracing the collaborative and supportive culture often found in smaller firms. As a member of the SSOE team, you'll work on exciting and diverse projects for Fortune 100 clients around the globe, supported by the best technology for the task at hand. You'll experience our employee‑centric culture that strives to offer a healthy balance, flexible working arrangements, direct access to leadership at all levels, and a continuous learning mindset. * 28% – of our employees have been with SSOE for 10 years or more. * 15% – percentage of employees with tenure exceeding 15 years. * 99% – our CEO’s approval rating on Glassdoor. * 98% – portion of our clients who say they would recommend us to a colleague. AI and Innovation: At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows. Responsibilities: **Key Responsibilities:** ========================= * May serve as lead designer on assigned projects. * Develop and coordinate designs using Revit and other design tools. * Collaborate with engineers, designers, and project teams. * Provide direction to design staff and CAD/Revit support personnel. * Communicate effectively with clients and internal stakeholders. * Support project planning, scheduling, and design coordination. * Ensure designs meet applicable standards and project requirements. * Applies standard design techniques and procedures exercising judgment in making minor adaptations and modifications to design concepts. * Receives instructions on specific assignment objectives, complex features, and assistance in deriving possible solutions to unusual problems. * Coordinates and directs the work effort of designers on the same project with some responsibility for checking portions of the completed drawings. * Prepares addendums and bulletins. Initiates project change orders for submittal to the project manager. * Attends construction meetings and produces site observation reports and final punch list. * May trouble\-shoot design problems in the field during construction. * Travel required. * Valid driver's license required. May be waived for international assignments. Qualifications: **Qualifications:** * Associate degree or certification of completion of other post\-secondary training in engineering field preferred. * **Minimum ten (10\) years of electrical designer experience.** * **Experience with power system design and familiarity with lighting software.** * **Advanced experience with Revit software is required** * Experience within the industrial facilities space and ability to execute related designs. * Ability to work independently as well as in a team\-oriented environment. * Strong communication skills with the ability to manage junior level staff and delegate work to design team. * Ability to communicate with clients directly and facilitate a professional relationship. * Ability to work with remote office team members, across various company office locations and client personnel. **What We Offer:*** **Competitive Salary**: **$85,000 \- $110,000 / year** depending on location, education, experience, and certifications. * **Comprehensive Benefits:** Health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, 401K retirement savings plan (with company matching), professional development and training, generous PTO, and paid holidays. **Additional Perks:*** **Continuous Learning:** Embrace a culture of perpetual learning where curiosity is celebrated, innovative ideas are welcomed, and your career growth aspirations are fully supported. * **Career Stability:** A diversity of market sectors, project types, and geographic locations that help insulate your career from economic ups and downs. * **Career Advancement:** Embark on a structured career journey with abundant opportunities for growth and advancement. * **Holistic Compensation:** A holistic approach to compensation and benefits that supports your physical and mental health, encourages work\-life balance, and empowers your career advancement and financial success.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Stic is modernizing out\-of\-home, one of advertising's oldest formats. Billboards and transit ads have always sold impressions on faith. Stic replaces faith by turning everyday vehicles into GPS\-tracked, mobile media. Brands get proof instead of best guesses. Drivers earn passive income on miles they're already driving. Stic Vision is how it works. An edge AI device small enough to live inside a decal, streaming informative analytics with no vehicle\-level integration required. The global out\-of\-home advertising market is worth roughly $40 billion a year. Stic is building the measurement layer that legacy OOH never had. Stic is trusted by brands like TikTok, Dunkin Donuts, e.l.f., and PacSun. The traction is already showing up in results: a SXSW campaign for TikTok Radio put 44 vehicles on the road in Austin and generated 3\.9 million tracked impressions. That's real, revenue\-generating proof in a category still mostly sold on assumptions. Stic is lean by design. People joining now build the playbook rather than inheriting one. This means fast execution, without the layers of process that slow down bigger companies. **About You** We're looking for a Fullstack Software Engineer to join our team and help build and maintain modern web and mobile applications from end to end. This is a great opportunity for a developer who's eager to grow, ship meaningful features, and collaborate closely with a tight\-knit engineering team. **What You’ll Do** * Design, develop, and maintain fullstack web and mobile applications using TypeScript and React on the frontend, with PostgreSQL\-backed services on the backend. * Integrate and maintain RESTful and GraphQL APIs as well as third\-party SDKs. * Participate in architecture discussions, write clean and testable code, contribute to CI/CD pipelines, and work with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform and Firebase. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with product, design, and other engineering teams to deliver high\-quality software across platforms. **What You’ll Need to Have** * 3–5 years of professional software development experience. * Proficiency in TypeScript and React. * Experience building modern web and mobile applications. * Hands\-on experience integrating and consuming APIs and third\-party SDKs. * Hands\-on experience with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL. * Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Firebase or similar technologies. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Base Salary:** $120,000 \- $130,000 **Work Location:** Los Angeles \- in person **Benefits** * Join a well\-funded early\-stage company disrupting traditional advertising with patent pending technology * Explosive career growth * Health \& dental insurance * PTO policy: 26 days off per year (15 PTO / 11 holidays) prorated for any partial year of employment * 401(k) **Additional information** This position does not offer visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the applicable country without requiring employer\-sponsored immigration status. We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive, and building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company is core to our mission. Our goal is to ensure that Stic upholds an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. Stic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, citizenship, or other protected characteristic.

The firmware you write is what turns a manufacturable sticker into a living sensor node. **Why This Role Matters** This role is the backbone of Stic's transition from prototype to a fully integrated, proprietary hardware and intelligence platform. The firmware you write directly powers data capture, edge intelligence, and real\-world deployment at scale across the largest untapped sensor network on the planet: the existing vehicle fleet. **What detection, vehicle counting, facial sentiment analysis, and demographic measurement * Implement BLE communication stacks — advertising, scanning, data payloads, and RSSI\-based logic * Integrate validation across EVT/DVT/PVT cycles **What You Have to Have** * 3\-5\+ years of professional embedded software engineering experience * Strong proficiency in C, micropython and C\+\+ for embedded analyzers * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience **What You Should Ideally Have** * Experience with OpenMV or similar embedded computer vision / ML\-enabled camera modules * Familiarity with nRF, STM32, Snapdragon, NVIDIA Jetson, ESP32, or similar platforms * Experience with LTE/5G module integration and GNSS systems * Background in edge AI inference, sensor fusion, or on\-device ML * Exposure to EVT/DVT/PVT processes and scaling hardware from prototype to production * Experience in IoT, automotive, or rugged field\-deployed systems **Base Salary:** $130,000 \- $190,000 **Work Location:** Los Angeles \- in person **Benefits** * Join a well\-funded early\-stage company disrupting traditional advertising jobs.description: **Department:** Electrification R\&D **Location:** Sacramento, CA, US, 95817\-1899 **\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; } **Category:** **Minimum Pay Rate:** $128,481\.60 **Maximum Pay Rate:** $170,144\.00 **Civil Service Status:** Civil Service **Apply by Date:** 09/22/2026 SMUD is committed to leading the way in sustainable energy solutions, innovative grid technology, and exceptional customer service. This role will drive high\-impact projects that shape how we serve growing electric demand, integrate emerging distributed energy technologies, and deliver reliable, affordable, and future\-ready solutions to our customers. Key to this role is managing foundational projects primarily focused on Transportation Electrification and Vehicle\-Grid\-Integration technologies, such as the Flexible Service Connection and Electric School Bus Vehicle\-to\-Grid projects. These initiatives help us connect customers faster in constrained areas, maximize existing grid assets, and enable cleaner transportation and grid\-interactive capabilities. Both projects are pivotal in advancing SMUD's strategic goals of accelerating electrification, modernizing the grid, and supporting sustainability. As an advanced journey\-level project management professional, you'll coordinate complex projects across multiple internal teams and external partners, manage schedules and resources, and ensure strategic initiatives move smoothly from planning through execution. Your leadership will be essential to maintaining momentum on these emerging programs that inform SMUD's future operational models, customer offerings, and grid capabilities. **Application Preparation:** As part of the application process, candidates will be required to answer a screening question when submitting their application. Please be advised, "Refer to resume" responses will not be accepted. Purpose Provides project management and professional skills and services in assigned area including to plan, organize, manage, coordinate, and execute activities related to assigned projects to ensure adequate, reliable, efficient, and cost effective systems and projects for SMUD. Nature and Scope Serves as an advanced journey level resource in a relevant professional discipline; works independently on projects of moderate complexity; exercises independent judgment and discretion; may serve in a Lead role and assist in planning, coordinating, prioritizing, monitoring and evaluating the work results in assigned area and in selecting, training, motivating, evaluating and developing lower\-level personnel. This role typically oversees or leads multiple small projects, or at least one large complex project. May manage a smaller portfolios of projects with budgets of up to $5,000,000\. Duties and Responsibilities Coordinates activities and projects in assigned area; develops necessary project plans, cost estimates, project budgets, work breakdowns and schedules, and project summary descriptions and justifications for department review. Coordinates project planning with other staff through meetings and shared written and oral reporting and communications. Ensures assigned work activities successfully contribute to the overall completion of assigned projects; plans, coordinates, prioritizes, monitors, guides, reviews, and conducts work activities associated with assigned projects in accordance with established task objectives and schedule as outlined in the project plans. Reviews the work of project team members; ensures work methods meet SMUD policies and quality standards; provides project guidance to project team; prepares employee performance evaluations, conducts one\-on\-one feedback sessions, and identifies and implements development actions to improve employee performance and skill base. Negotiate, prepare, and manage participation agreements and other contracts with outside contractors as needed; directs contractor activities in accordance with contract requirements. Develop and monitor project resources as necessary to complete project tasks ensuring proper and efficient use of SMUD and other participant resources and smooth coordination with external parties. Ensures the availability of timely and accurate project status and related information on assigned projects; collects, verifies, organizes, and maintains data; prepares and provides written summaries, reports, and recommendations for SMUD projects; responds verbally or in writing to inquiries on projects from SMUD management, Board of Directors, regulatory bodies, other utilities, public agencies, and other SMUD departments. Performs related duties as required. Required Education A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in a field directly related to area of assi in that classification. The capitol of California, Sacramento is the state's sixth\-largest city, and the 35th largest in the U.S. Local universities include California State University, University of the Pacific's McGeorge School of Law, and the University of California, Davis and several competitive community colleges. The UC Davis Medical Center, a world\-renowned research hospital, is one of more than a dozen hospitals and shared services centers in the Sacramento region. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer-Backend
jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! **Overview** As the Senior Software Engineer for Scout Motor's digital products, you will play a key role in the development and enhancement of our software products, from concept to deployment. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, and implement scalable and robust solutions that meet our customers' needs and exceed their expectations. Some of the key products as part of digital portfolio are – mobile and desktop applications, vehicle connectivity solutions, mapping services, production, inventory and planning optimization, servicing and repairs, and more. At the same time, you'll have plenty of opportunities to be hands\-on building key systems and will be directly responsible for the successful delivery of complex and large\-scale technical efforts as well acting as a technical mentor and leader for other engineers. #### **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Work with engineers \& technical leaders across the company to ship interoperable products and systems on strong foundations that manage customer interactions inside and outside of the vehicle * Contribute to architecture and lead the design and implementation of of complex software systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications and deliverables * Design, implement and support identity, access and profile related services for multiple web applications, mobile apps and vehicle apps supporting internal and customer as users * Implement best practices and standards for software development, including code reviews, testing, and documentation * Mentor and coach junior team members, providing guidance and support to help them grow and succeed * Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, continuously learning and experimenting with new tools and techniques to improve our software development process * Be responsible for the services that are owned by your team, ensuring 24/7 on\-call coverage * Use AI\-assisted development tools effectively to improve productivity, code quality, and delivery. **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in **Fremont, California.** * This role requires 3 day per week in the office, with regular in\-person meetings and events. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. #### **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field. * 5\+ years in software development, with a focus on back\-end technologies. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment, both independently and as part of a team * Proficiency in one of Go, Node.js, Python, Java, or Ruby * Experience with both relational and/or non\-relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) * Experience with identity management systems (e.g., Azure AD, AWS Cognito, LDAP, Okta, Keyclock) and directory services for user authentication and management * Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices * Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills, with a passion for finding elegant solutions to complex challenges #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: * Competitive insurance including: + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans * 401(k) program with: + An employer match and immediate vesting * Generous Paid Time Off including: + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave #### **Pay Transparency** This is a full\-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range \= $140,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 Initial California, Washington and New York base salary range \= $154,000 \- $187,000 Internal leveling code: IC9 **Notice to applicants:** * To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. * Residing in **San Francisco**: *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* * Residing in **Los Angeles**: *Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.* * Residing in **New York City**: *This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.* **Equal Opportunity** Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre\-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.description: SkyGrid, a Wisk Company, exists to open the sky for autonomous flight. Based in Austin, Texas, SkyGrid builds ground\-based high\-assurance third\-party services to enable the safe operations and airspace integration of highly automated and autonomous aircraft. SkyGrid also acts as a key operational nexus for advanced air mobility, integrating and managing data, infrastructure, access, and traffic to support seamless and efficient air traffic services. The SkyGrid team is looking for a **Senior Systems Engineer** **(Surveillance)** to lead and support surveillance system activities across the company portfolio. In this role, you will play a critical part in defining, architecting, and integrating SkyGrid’s ground\-based surveillance architectures across the Systems Engineering “V”, including the development of requirements, use cases, and functional architectures for technologies such as Detect and Avoid (DAA), ADS\-B, Radar, and Traffic Collision Avoidance Systems (TCAS/ACAS). This role directly supports certification, safety, and verification \& validation (V\&V) planning while utilizing a Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) paradigm throughout the system lifecycle. You will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, Integrated Product Team (IPT) leads, other systems engineers, program managers, and system architects. Success in this role requires a strong blend of surveillance technical domain expertise, system safety rigor, collaborative communication, and technical leadership. This role will report to the Systems Engineering Manager and while a hybrid workplace is preferred, it can be considered a fully remote role. ### **Performance Objectives:** * Deliver high\-quality systems lifecycle artifacts and technical leadership through the current CDR phase of the program and ensure on\-time completion to support CDR review in the next 18\-24 months. * Establish complete end\-to\-end bi\-directional requirements traceability (from top\-level operational needs down to subsystem allocations) for surveillance systems, ahead of CDR review. * Support the development of the System/Subsystem Design Description documents in relation to the Critical Design Reviews. * Identify and mitigate technical and performance risks covering traffic surveillance aspects of the system. standards (e.g., FAA, EASA, applicable RTCA MOPS). * Develop and maintain SysML models (Use Case, Activity, Sequence, State machine, etc.) using MBSE methodologies and tools like Cameo. * Support the system architecture definition and technical integration for surveillance sensors and systems (e.g., ADS\-B In/Out, Radar, DAA/ACAS, and transponders). * Advance and support system development activities including the current design phase through implementation, verification and validation, all the way through certification. * Support compliance with ARP4754B development practices and collaborate on system safety assessments per ARP4761A (FHA, PASA, SSA). * Support technical program reviews for SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and qualification reviews. * Ensure compliance with customer, contractual, and regulatory requirements. * Coordinate cross\-functional activities across engineering teams and review/supervise the technical work of junior and mid\-level systems engineers. ### **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Aerospace Engineering or related STEM degree from an accredited university or college. * 7\+ years of experience working in a highly technical, aerospace\-related industry. * 5\+ years of experience working in a Systems Engineering position. * Hands\-on experience with surveillance avionics systems, collision avoidance, or sensor fusion technologies (e.g., ADS\-B, Radar, TCAS / ACAS X, DAA, Mode S Transponders). * Familiarity with all phases of the SE design process: ConOps, requirements development, software / system Architecture, system Integration and test, and Verification and Validation. * Experience with ARP 4754B and ability to support System Safety reviews per ARP 4761\. ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s degree in engineering or related field. * Experience developing aircraft systems, Unmanned Aircraft System Traffic Management (UTM), or Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) platforms. * Exposure to RTCA/EUROCAE standards relevant to surveillance systems (e.g., DO\-365, DO\-260, DO\-185, DO\-386\). * Familiarity with DO\-178C (Software) and DO\-254 (Complex Hardware) airborne development processes. * Experience with requirements management tools such as Polarion, DOORS. * Experience applying MBSE principles using SysML and one or more MBSE tools (Cameo Systems Modeler/MagicDraw). ### **Join Our Team and Enjoy Exceptional Benefits:** * **Comprehensive Health Coverage from Day One****:** Enjoy immediate access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, including HSA and FSA options. Need** **Required:** * Solid foundational knowledge of data engineering: ETL/ELT concepts, SQL proficiency, and data pipeline design * Working knowledge of **dbt** (or strong readiness to ramp quickly if exposure is limited) for transformation and modeling * Understanding of **fact and dimensional modeling** principles (star/snowflake schemas, grain, SCDs) * Familiarity with the concept of a **semantic layer** and why it matters for consistent, trustworthy reporting * Strong **data translation fundamentals** — the ability to take a business question or reporting requirement and reason through the correct data structure/logic to answer it accurately * Ability to work independently and complete assigned tasks with minimal day\-to\-day supervision once requirements are clear * Comfort using AI tools as a core part of the development process — this is a non\-negotiable expectation of how we build, not an optional add\-on * Strong written communication skills for documentation and cross\-team collaboration **Preferred:** * Prior experience in **healthcare data** (claims, eligibility, EHR, or similar) — familiarity with concepts like UB\-04 revenue codes, claims adjudication, or payer/provider data structures is a plus * Experience with **Snowflake** specifically * Exposure to **Terraform** or other infrastructure\-as\-code practices * Familiarity with **Sigma**, Looker, jobs.title: Civil Engineering Intern - Water (Summer 2027)
jobs.description: Learning begins in the classroom but there’s no better place to gain real\-world experience than with Stantec. Interns are an integral part of our teams, working to solve some of the world's most complex challenges. As an intern, you’ll work alongside our experienced practitioners and with our clients and communities. This hands\-on experience will equip you with practical skills, build your network, and provide opportunities that set you up for success. Many of the world’s top engineers and scientists come together in our Water business because they view a community’s interaction with water a bit differently—as a single holistic system, rather than unconnected networks divided by jurisdictional boundaries. Working throughout the hydrologic cycle, we are delivering sustainable solutions to make sure water is where it should be and available when needed. Our experts guide our work with scientific rigor, an innovative spirit, and a vision for growth. Every day, we help communities improve, reuse, and protect this precious resource for future generations. By 2025 we’re hiring 2,000 people (like you) to join our team. Grow with us, H2O\+U. Your Opportunity Stantec’s Phoenix, AZ office is seeking a Student Intern to join our multi\-disciplinary team of integrated water resources professionals, each committed to delivering sound and strategic consulting services to a range of local, regional, state and federal clients. This role will support our local design staff collecting and organizing data, preparing calculations, preparing charts and graphs, modeling using Excel or hydraulic modeling software, preparing drawings, backcheck drawing/technical memoranda corrections, writing portions of technical memoranda, researching technical information, proposal and resume writing, client interactions, presentations, note taking, field investigations, coordinating production of reports, and/or support of design documents (plans and specifications). As a Student Intern, you will work in a team environment and have exposure to water resources projects which may include pipeline, conveyance, pump station, and other water infrastructure design. Key Responsibilities The Intern must have good attention to detail. They need to possess a willingness to assist full time staff with various tasks. Responsibilities of this position include the following: * Gain and apply experience in water/wastewater infrastructure design and applicable laws/policies/regulations. * Participate in multi\-disciplinary teams on water and wastewater infrastructure projects throughout Arizona and the western U.S. * The work may include assisting with development of planning and designs for municipal water/wastewater conveyance pipelines, lift stations, and stormwater drainage structures. * Work may include administration of construction phase activities. * Assisting engineering team with planning and development of design documents and permit applications. * Assist in the development of plans and exhibits with CADD and GIS software. * Gathering information for inclusion in engineering reports and technical studies. * Assisting project managers and project engineers on other projects, as needed. * Duties may also involve field work. Your Capabilities and Credentials * Must have a valid driver’s license. * Minimum 10 hour per week commitment. * Good MS Office skills including Word and Excel; PowerPoint a plus. * Experience in AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D a plus.\- Specific coursework or exposure to one or more of the following: * Hydraulics and hydraulic modeling. * Planning, design, and construction of water/wastewater conveyance pipelines and pump stations. * Water/wastewater treatment processes. * Advanced and emerging technologies. * Excellent written and oral communication skills. * Versatility, flexibility, and willingness to work within the team. * Willing and able to take initiative when needed. * Strong interpersonal abilities for working in diverse team environments with staff, clients, and stakeholders. Education and Experience * In progress toward earning a Bachelor's degree (minimum) or Master’s degree in civil/environmental engineering, biosystems engineering, water resources engineering, or related field; with a minimum of 2 years of related undergraduate coursework. * Must have a minimum GPA of 3\.0 on a 4\.0 scale. \\\#Student Key Benefits * An internship opportunity is the singular best way to discover if a career pathway is right for the candidate. * An opportunity to apply classroom learning to a real\-world environment. * An opportunity to seek out new experiences. * A chance to make a meaningful contribution to an organization through quality work for our clients in all aspects of project work – planning, design and construction. * A resume builder – Stantec experience sets a new graduate apart from the “rest”. * Discipline mentorship/shadowing with acting professionals. * Professional coaching to grow your career: resume writing, public speaking, work approaches, communications, and interviewing. Typical office environment includes working with computers and remaining sedentary for long periods of time. This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required. Other activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice. Stantec is a place where the best and brightest come to build on each other’s talents, do exciting work, and make an impact on the world around us. At Stantec, we live our corporate values every day. **Pay Transparency:** In compliance with pay transparency laws, pay ranges are provided for positions in locations where required. Please note, the final agreed upon compensation is based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. At Stantec certain roles are bonus eligible. Actual compensation for part\-time roles will be pro\-rated based on the agreed number of working hours per week. **Benefits Summary:** Regular full\-time and part\-time employees (working at least 20 hours per week) have access to medical, dental, and vision plans, a wellness program, health saving accounts, flexible spending accounts, 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase program, life and accidental death \& dismemberment (AD\&D) insurance, short\-term/long\-term disability plans, emergency travel benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional membership fee coverage and paid family leave. In addition, employees will be eligible to accrue vacation between 10 and 20 days per year and eligible for paid sick leave (and if more generous, in accordance with state and local law). jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most. **HYBRID** Qualified candidates must live within a **180\-mile radius** of a hub location listed below and should plan to spend time working from home and some time working in the office as part of our hybrid work environment**.** **HUB LOCATIONS: Bloomington, IL; Richardson, TX; Atlanta, GA; or Tempe, AZ****SPONSORSHIP:** Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H\-1B visa) for this opportunity. Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential: Responsibilities: We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Availability Analytics and Automation (AAA) teams, working on innovative SRE, automation, and AI/ML solutions. The SRE team helps product teams strengthen application reliability and resiliency through capabilities such as Neighborhood Watch and Resiliency Assessments. The team leverages AWS and ROSA technologies, along with MCP servers and Agentic AI, to build and enhance these solutions. The AAA team develops GenAI\-powered tools that help investigate and troubleshoot production outages and generate ESS summaries, using GenAI Gateway and AIDE APIs to interact with LLMs. In this role, you will collaborate with Lead Software Engineers and Staff Engineers to design and develop solutions for Service Level Objectives (SLOs), observability dashboards, AI\-powered tools and agentic workflows, and automated recovery capabilities. Qualifications: * Develops, tests, debugs, documents, maintains, supports applications/components and primarily completes assignments with guidance and direction. * Develops an understanding in programming and is actively developing in a core programming language (e.g. Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, etc.). * Develops an understanding with State Farm compute environments, including but not limited to AWS, ROSA, CaaS, etc. * Develops an understanding with State Farm security, standards and governance. * Handles and resolves basic application and environment problems and issues. * Develop an understanding of the State Farm organizational structure. * Develops understanding of Agile techniques, activities and DevOps methods. * Develops fundamental understanding of insurance and financial services operations and Experience with AWS, ROSA desired, but not required. * Demonstrates strong consulting and problem\-solving skills. * Drives initiatives with a strong focus on achieving measurable outcomes. * Champions the use of Generative AI (e.g., Co\-Pilot) in daily development workflows (coding, documentation, testing, and ideation). * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams and business areas. Embraces change, adjusts easily to new challenges, and maintains a focus on excellence in outcome delivery. * Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week! * Potential starting salary range: $85,500 \- $110,000 * + Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience + High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. jobs.description: Subsidiary: Aluminum Dynamics Overview: **What Does Steel Dynamics Do?** Steel Dynamics is a leading industrial metals solutions company that produces lower\-carbon, high\-quality steel products primarily from recycled scrap. Operating through a circular manufacturing model, the company manufactures a wide range of steel products including flat roll, structural, and long products for industries such as construction, automotive, energy, and manufacturing. In addition to steel production, Steel Dynamics operates metals recycling facilities, steel fabrication plants, and aluminum production operations, serving customers across North America with a focus on innovation, efficiency, and sustainability. **This is an Aluminum Dynamics (ADL) Internship. What Does ADL Do?** Aluminum Dynamics is developing a state\-of\-the\-art, 650,000\-tonne low\-carbon recycled aluminum flat rolled mill, supported by two satellite recycled aluminum slab centers. jobs.description: Do you have a passion for children and education? Would you like to positively impact families in need of help? We want to speak with you! Step Up For Students empowers families to pursue and engage in the most appropriate learning options for their children. Job Summary Step Up For Students empowers families to pursue the most appropriate learning options for their children. We unite communities to provide scholarships that open doors to a stronger future. With this support, students can choose the right learning environment and access resources to reach their full potential. **Our culture is rooted in two core values:** * Everyone is an asset * Every event is an improvement opportunity These values guide how we work together and continuously improve. We expect every team member to bring these principles to life in their daily work. The Software Architect serves as a technical leader responsible for designing, guiding, and overseeing the implementation of enterprise software solutions. This role provides hands\-on architectural leadership across multiple development teams, ensuring technology solutions are scalable, secure, high\-performing, and aligned with business objectives. Working closely with cross\-functional stakeholders, the Software Architect drives architectural consistency and supports enterprise\-wide integration initiatives. The role is accountable for ensuring solutions adhere to established software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, architecture standards, security requirements, performance expectations, and privacy regulations. As a forward\-thinking technology advocate, the Software Architect shapes the organization's technology strategy by promoting modern architectural patterns, service\-oriented design, and modular application development. This role identifies opportunities to improve system flexibility, reusability, and maintainability, enabling the organization to scale and adapt to evolving business needs. Additionally, the Software Architect mentors and influences engineering teams, fostering technical excellence, innovation, and the adoption of best practices in software design, development, and architecture. **Location:** Remote (United States) **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and execute software solutions to accurately address business requirements as well as non\-functional business requirements. * Provide the development team with architectural blueprints, hands\-on example driven help and mentoring. * Remain plugged in to enterprise architecture and security groups to ensure our solutions remain compliant with emerging standards. * Create high\-level product specifications and multi\-level design documents. * Determine and execute on root cause for the most complex software issues and develop practical, efficient, and permanent technical solutions. * Remain current on new technologies and available vendor packages; evaluate and make recommendations as necessary. * Test and review system designs; * Ensure strict adherence to enterprise standards and influence changes to such standards. * Be champions of DevSecOps as well as delivery of top\-tier quality and secure code. * Be an enigmatic technologist who is looked upon as an SME equally by members of IT and business teams. * When needed, facilitate Joint Application Design (JAD) sessions with cross functional teams of Engineers, Analysts, Product Owner, other business and technical stakeholders. **Qualifications:** * Demonstrated success and a proven track record in professional/life experience in specific job functions, projects, or industries. Military service can substitute for professional experience and/or formal education requirements. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field or equivalent demonstrated experience in addition to the minimum years of specified experience can substitute for the formal education requirements. * 5\+ years of technical leadership and software development experience. * 2\+ years of proven experience in software architecture roles. * Deep experience with modern designing, developing, and maintaining Hosting Infrastructure (Cloud and Traditional) techniques and best\-practices. * Experience with current architectural patterns for High Availability, Performance, Scale Out architecture, Disaster Recovery, Security Architecture. * Knowledge of cloud\-based architectures, deployment, and operational aspects of Azure and AWS cloud. * Ability to provide in\-depth evaluation and analysis of unique complex technological issues and platforms. **You’ll Stand Out If You Have:** * In depth understanding of Azure and AWS cloud. **Key Competencies:** * Knowledge of JavaScript, JQuery, HTML, HTML5, CSS, CSS3, Web Programming Skills, cross browser compatibility, Web User Interface Design (UI), Security Principles, Object\-Oriented Design, Web Services (REST/SOAPAPI's), C\#, .NetCore, MVC, MS SQL, Microservices, Azure Function Apps, Message Queuing. * Knowledge of cloud\-based architectures, deployment, and operational aspects of Azure and AWS cloud. * Demonstrative Software development experience in an Agile / Dev Ops environment using MS AZURE with CI/CD. * Ability to provide in\-depth evaluation and analysis of unique complex technological issues and platforms. * Proven ability to Partner with Product, Engineering, Program Management, Operations and other stakeholders to successfully launch and maintain complex products. * Hands on experience and ability to develop and maintain end to end solution process flows at both high and detailed levels. * Proven ability to understand what the technology needs to do and will zero in on and mitigate risks that may inhibit the technology delivering what the business needs. * Experience implementing event\- or message\-driven distributed architectures. * Experience planning and shipping complex software releases in an agile software development lifecycle. * Leadership skills; experience being a mentor and support to Software Engineers. * Excellent analytical skills, ability to understand complex business issues and translate to solutions based on both quantitative and qualitative analysis. * Excellent communication skills in verbal, written, and presentation settings with a range of audiences both business and technical, individual contributor and leadership. * Consultative mindset in order to bridge gap between technology feasibility with business needs. **Interview Process:** * Veriff Identity Verification * Recruiter Video Interview * Chief of Staff to CIO Video Interview * Final Video Interview with CIO **Why you’ll love working here:** * Award\-Winning Culture: We’ve been named one of the Best Companies to Work For four years in a row by Florida Trend and Workforce Research Group and honored as one of the Healthiest Companies by Florida’s First Coast Worksite Wellness Council. Fast Company recognized us as one of the Best Workplaces for Innovators—proof that we foster an environment where big ideas and bold thinking are encouraged. * Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA, FSA, and Lifestyle Spending Accounts. We also offer a competitive 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future. * Flexibility \& Work\-Life Harmony: Remote work options and unique time\-off programs—including 14 paid holidays, Care and Parental Leave, and our Flexible Leave policy. * Growth \& Development: From mentorship programs to management training and professional development opportunities, we invest in your career journey every step of the way. * Supportive Professional Environment: Our dedicated coaching team is here to help you succeed, and employee\-led committees give you a voice in shaping our workplace. Collaboration isn’t just encouraged, it’s how we work. **Working Conditions and Equipment Use:** * Work is performed indoors in a typical office environment \- not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions. * Valid driver’s license and proof of insurance may be required, depending on role responsibilities. * Must be able to lift up to fifteen (15\) pounds. * Frequent use of office machines to include telephone, computer, and printer. system integrators, vendors, and internal stakeholders * Experience leading data work through Kanban or Agile practices * Strong communication, prioritization, team leadership, business partnership, and project management skills **Education \& Experience:** * Bachelor’ iability, security, governance, cost, supportability, and strategic fit. * Ability to interpret instructions provided in written, oral, diagram, architecture, workflow, or schedule form. **Computer Operations:** To perform this job successfully, an individual should have strong working knowledge of enterprise data and reporting platforms, including Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, SSIS, SSRS, SSAS, Azure Data Gateway, Azure DevOps, source control, Microsoft Office, and Microsoft Visio, along with the ability to learn and effectively use technologies supporting data engineering, analytics, governance, AI\-enabled DataOps, observability, automation, and service management. **Planning/Organization:** * Ability to prioritize and re\-prioritize as enterprise needs, stakeholder demand, platform dependencies, incidents, partner commitments, and service expectations evolve. * jobs.title: Junior Commissioning & SCADA Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** We are seeking a motivated **Junior Commissioning \& SCADA Engineer** to support the commissioning, testing, and operational integration of utility\-scale renewable energy facilities and electrical infrastructure. This role provides hands\-on experience with SCADA systems, plant controls, commissioning activities, and NERC compliance while working alongside experienced engineering and field teams. The ideal candidate is an early\-career electrical engineer who is eager to develop technical expertise in power systems, renewable energy, substation controls, and grid operations. **Key Responsibilities** **Commissioning Support** * Assist with commissioning of utility\-scale solar, BESS, substations, and related electrical infrastructure. * Support pre\-commissioning inspections, functional testing, energization, and turnover activities. * Review commissioning procedures and verify completion of required documentation. * Coordinate with EPC contractors, equipment vendors, utilities, and project teams during commissioning. * Participate in startup, troubleshooting, and performance testing of electrical equipment. **SCADA \& Controls Support** * Assist with configuration, testing, and validation of SCADA systems. * Support integration of inverters, protective relays, meters, RTUs, PLCs, and communications equipment. * Help verify point\-to\-point testing between field devices and control centers. * Troubleshoot communication issues involving fiber, Ethernet, serial communications, and industrial protocols. * Support development and maintenance of SCADA documentation and system drawings. **NERC Compliance Support** * Assist with maintaining documentation required for applicable NERC Reliability Standards. * Support compliance audits, evidence collection, and record retention. * Help track required testing, maintenance, and cybersecurity documentation. * Work with operations and engineering teams to support ongoing compliance initiatives. **Engineering Support** * Review electrical drawings, one\-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, and control schematics. * Assist with equipment inspections and field quality verification. * Prepare commissioning reports and technical documentation. * Support engineering evaluations and field issue resolution. * Travel to project sites as required. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or closely related field. * 0–3 years of engineering experience (internships or co\-op experience welcomed). * Understanding of electrical power systems. * Basic knowledge of substations, renewable energy systems, or industrial controls preferred. * Familiarity with SCADA systems or industrial communications is a plus. * Exposure to protective relays, PLCs, RTUs, or power system automation is desirable. * Knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards is preferred but not required. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to travel approximately 30–50% to project sites.

jobs.description: **Job Title:** AI Software Developer **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Department:** ITS **Reports To:** Director of ITS **Summary** The AI Software Developer works with the Lead Developer and Software Architect to design, build, and support AI and software solutions across the organization. This role develops reliable applications, AI platforms, and automation solutions that improve efficiency and support business needs. **Essential Responsibilities:** **Leadership and Mentoring:** · Provide technical support and guidance to developers. · Promote teamwork and knowledge sharing. · Support discussions and decisions related to AI design, best practices, system performance, and responsible development. **Design and Development:** · Design, build, and maintain AI applications that integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into business workflows. · Set up logging and monitoring to track application and AI performance. · Develop and maintain backend services, APIs, databases, and integrations. · Build and support automation and AI solutions using Azure AI Foundry, including Foundry workflows, AI hubs, models, and datasets. · Create solutions that reduce manual work and improve efficiency. · Coordinate requirements, timelines, and issue resolution across projects. · Work independently and as part of a development team. · Maintain and improve application features, architecture, and frameworks. · Research and implement development tools and technologies as needed. **Code Quality, Testing, and Troubleshooting:** · Review and improve code for quality, performance, security and maintainability. · Test software, identify issues, and troubleshoot problems. · Create and maintain unit tests for application features, and business rules. **Documentation:** · Create and maintain technical documentation, including developer guides. **Collaboration and Communication:** · Work with developers, stakeholders, and other teams. · Coordinate with development, testing, and operations teams throughout the lifecycle. · Work closely with the Lead Developer and Software Architect on needs. **Problem Solving and Technology Planning:** · Develop scalable and reliable solutions that improve system performance and user experience. · Help evaluate and recommend tools, and technologies that support business needs. · Contribute to long\-term technology and architecture decisions. **Minimum Qualifications** · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent education and experience will be considered. * 4 to 5 years of experience as an AI Software Engineer or in a similar role Azure OpenAI or similar enterprise AI platforms. * 1 to 2 years of experience with LLM evaluation/testing, API integration, Azure OpenAI or similar enterprise AI platforms. * Experience with developing in Python and C\#. * Experience with REST API, web services and backend applications. * Experience implementing human\-in\-the\-loop AI workflows. * Experience writing queries using MySQL, SQL Server, or similar databases. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with RAG solutions, prompt engineering, and multi\-model AI systems. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. **Advanced/Expert\-level knowledge of:** * JavaScript * React and Redux * TypeScript * ASP.NET * Microsoft Visual Studio * GitHub * Bitbucket * Git * JetBrains .NET and Visual Studio tools * jQuery * XML * SQL Server 2012 or newer * Atlassian Suite (Confluence, Jira) * SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS) * MySQL (MySQL Database) **Desirable Qualifications** · Experience in the Surplus Lines or insurance industry. · At least 1 year of experience leading or mentoring a development team in the AI field. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Referral program * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Do you currently require, or will you require in the future, employer\-sponsored work authorization, or are you working under a temporary visa? Experience: * AI Software Engineer : 4 years (Preferred) * Open AI: 4 years (Preferred) * LLM: 1 year (Preferred) * C\#: 2 years (Preferred) * Python: 2 years (Preferred) * REST API: 2 years (Preferred) * MySQL: 2 years (Preferred) * Microsoft SQL Server: 2 years (Preferred) * CI/CD: 2 years (Preferred) * RAG Solutions: 2 years (Preferred) * JavaScript: 2 years (Preferred) * React: 2 years (Preferred) * Redux: 2 years (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pflugerville, TX 78660

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Suttell \& Hammer** Driven by success, Suttell \& Hammer, P.S. strives to be the pre\-eminent creditors\-rights law firm in the across the country. We pride ourselves on providing the highest quality and efficient legal representation to our clients. We proudly serve creditors in WA, OR, ID, CA, CO, AK, MA, TX, HI, UT and AZ. Over the last three years, the Firm's case load has increased over 200%. **About the Role** Suttell \& Hammer is seeking an experienced Software Developer / Systems Engineer to join our IT Division. This position is ideal for someone with a strong C\# and SQL development background who also understands enterprise IT infrastructure and production support. Unlike a traditional software development role, this position will work directly with business applications, databases, APIs, infrastructure, and end users. We are looking for someone who can independently troubleshoot problems, develop solutions, and support applications in a production environment. We are looking for a software engineer who is seeking a long\-term role maximizing the potential output of the Firm and who can mentor junior engineers in best\-practices as the Firm continues to grow. We are looking for someone who can operate independently and take ownership of technical problems from investigation through resolution. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable writing C\# code, troubleshooting a SQL query, investigating an application failure, and working with IT staff to determine whether an issue originates in the application, database, server, network, or user workflow. This is a hands on technical position with the opportunity to have a significant impact on the applications and systems that support our business. **Location** This position will work out of our HQ in Kirkland, WA. **Pay \& Benefits** * Pay will be dependent level of experience * Medical and Dental * Paid Time Off \& Holidays * 401k with 6% match * Life Insurance * Subsidized Gym Membership (Lifetime Fitness) **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot C\# business applications, including Windows Forms applications * Develop and maintain integrations with REST APIs and third\-party systems * Write, optimize, and troubleshoot SQL queries, stored procedures, and database processes * Diagnose application, database, and system performance issues * Develop internal tools and automation to improve operational efficiency * Troubleshoot production issues across applications, databases, Windows servers, and user workflows * Support and enhance existing business applications and integrations * Work directly with IT and business teams to translate operational requirements into technical solutions * Assist with application deployments, upgrades, testing, and production support * Document applications, integrations, database processes, and technical procedures * Identify opportunities to improve system reliability, performance, security, and automation **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of relevant professional experience in software development, systems engineering, application support, or a combination of these disciplines * Strong C\# and .NET development experience * Experience developing and maintaining Windows Forms applications * Strong Microsoft SQL Server skills, including complex queries, stored procedures, troubleshooting, and performance analysis * Experience developing or consuming REST APIs and integrating third party systems * Experience troubleshooting production applications and business systems * Working knowledge of Windows Server and Microsoft enterprise environments * Ability to independently investigate technical problems and develop practical solutions * Strong understanding of how applications, databases, infrastructure, and end user workflows interact **Preferred Experience** Candidates with prior experience in systems administration, enterprise IT, or infrastructure in addition to software development are particularly encouraged to apply. Experience with any of the following is beneficial: * Active Directory and Windows Server * Microsoft 365 and enterprise authentication * Application and database performance troubleshooting * PowerShell or other automation technologies * Source control and software deployment processes * Network and infrastructure troubleshooting * Legal, financial services, healthcare, collections, or other highly regulated environments * Supporting business critical applications with large transactional databases Suttell \& Hammer is an equal opportunity employer. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off Experience: * software developer/system engineer/application support: 5 years (Preferred) * C\#: 5 years (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer I
jobs.description: Watch your work come to life in landmark projects around the world when you partner with Syska Hennessy Group! As a global leader in consulting, engineering, and commissioning services, we specialize in MEP, information and communication technology, architectural lighting, vertical transportation, and commissioning. We currently have an entry level opportunity for an **Electrical Engineering I.** Our dynamic work environment provides the optimal setting to take your engineering career to the next level. From our supportive culture, diverse workforce, and competitive compensation to our flexible work schedule Monday to Thursday in the office for 9 hours and Friday for 4 hours remotely at home and fun social events, it is everything you will need for an exciting, challenging, and rewarding career. **Job Responsibilities:** As an entry level engineer, you will support our engineering teams working toward our designs that are inspiring, demanding, and highly collaborative. You will learn from others, and they will expect to learn from you. You will share in the responsibility, rewards, and recognition of producing truly innovative solutions and complete client satisfaction. Some responsibilities include: * Create basic designs under the direction of the senior engineer and/or senior designer * Learn drawing organization and company standards. * Perform CAD/BIM drafting for a variety of projects and project sizes to begin to understand architectural engineering design and documentation. technical staff * Coordination with the designs of other trades (architectural, engineering / internal, and external) under the guidance of more senior * Support the design and engineering efforts of systems for new installations, system retrofits, system replacement, and system upgrades for a wide variety of projects and project types. * Take ownership of the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the work assignments. * Assist engineers with field investigations and construction site visits to observe and attend project coordination meetings. * Participate and regularly attend the EDT program training sessions and support activities that are part of the EDT program * Attending our Engineering Development Program continuing education seminars on technical and professional enhancing topics. **Job Requirements:** The ideal candidate will enjoy a team environment and be flexible enough to work independently where needed. Candidates for this role will be eager to learn and will expand their knowledge and hands\-on experience by challenging themselves and using the highly technical resources around them. Additional job requirements: * Bachelor's Degree from an accredited university in Electrical engineering, or Architectural Engineering with a graduation date of **Winter 2026, Spring or Summer of 2027** * Previous engineering internship, a plus * Knowledge of the latest version of MEP Auto CAD; REVIT experience is a plus. * Proficient in design and calculation software; MS Office Suite * E.I.T. or FE required. **Benefits:** As an employee at Syska Hennessy, you will be part of a global firm with an amazing history! We are committed to being the best, to advancing engineering design practice, and to supporting our clients with integrity. To make all of that happen, we rely on the talent, drive, enthusiasm, and the total job satisfaction of the great people who work here. Our Company is committed to developing engineers into respected technical experts and versatile business leaders through our Engineer Development Program (EDT). **About the EDT Program** Recent graduates interested in our Engineering Development Training (EDT) program can expect to participate in an accelerated, but thorough training curriculum. This curriculum will teach not only the technical aspects of our profession, but industry specific business aspects as well. Our senior engineers will work closely with each participant to foster a strong mentor/apprentice relationship. This time\-honored program is a trademark of Syska's commitment to the development and education of young engineers through mentoring and technical training. As a member of our highly collaborative team, we provide our full\-time employees with a flexible benefits package that reflects our respect for your workplace contributions, professional goals, and personal priorities. The personal benefits program at Syska Hennessy Group includes: * Robust, comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance and supplemental benefit plans * 401(k) plan with a generous employer matching program * Training and professional development courses * Professional development incentive bonuses * Dynamic Employee Resource Groups * Competitive Paid Time Off (PTO) policy * Transit/parking employer stipend * ½ day work from home Fridays all year long At Syska, we have cultivated a community that supports learning and provides guidance for professional development and furthering our culture of excellence. We promote an environment that is committed to embedding diversity and equality into the core of our business and culture. We empower our employees so they can take ownership of their work and development and strive to continually improve themselves and our firm. We rely on the talent, drive, enthusiasm and the total job satisfaction of the great people who work here for our success! Syska is a place where you can build an exceptional career and have a lasting impact on the world. **Syska Hennessy Group** **Integrating the best minds and technology to help clients create exceptional environments.**
