We started in the workforce space because contingent labor is the biggest operational pain point our manufacturing and logistics customers face. We used it to embed ourselves inside their daily operations and create a far better customer experience through technology. Now those same customers are pulling us beyond staffing into the broader operational workflows that run their facilities. That foundation gave us proprietary data from millions of shifts and deep enterprise relationships. But our edge is more than data. By connecting to the systems running across every facility and activating the workers already on our platform to execute against them, we are building applied AI that drives real productivity gains and transforms how the global supply chain operates at scale. We are backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst. **The Role** ------------ We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced Product Manager to join as a founding member of the Agents team and help us build the next layer of Traba's product, an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. Think Claude, but for Light Industrial businesses. You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agents that understand context, reason through ambiguity, make decisions, and execute work on behalf of users. This is a true 0\-to\-1 product role operating at the frontier of applied AI. You will work directly with founders, product engineers, ML teams, and early design partners to define workflows, shape product strategy, and build products while the underlying model ecosystem continues changing beneath us. The assumptions, capabilities, and constraints will evolve rapidly and the product will evolve with them. This role reports directly to our VP of Product. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Architect and steward product strategy for Traba’s AI agent platform * Solve complex customer problems by balancing user needs, technical constraints, and evolving AI capabilities * Write detailed product requirements and partner deeply with product engineers and ML teams * Rapidly validate and prototype ideas alongside customers and design partners * Design agent systems that reason through workflows, orchestrate tools, maintain context, and execute meaningful work * Define product behavior, evaluation systems, and quality frameworks that improve reliability and performance * Use data to uncover patterns and answer key product and system questions * Evolve our AI product portfolio with a deep understanding of model capabilities and system architecture * Visualize and communicate complex concepts from system behavior and evaluations to user experiences and business impact * Socialize your work across all levels and departments while synthesizing diverse stakeholder feedback **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- **Real agent builder.** You have launched customer\-facing AI products where the system took meaningful actions on behalf of users. We are intentionally setting a high bar here. Shipping AI features, copilots, chat interfaces, wrappers, or lightweight LLM integrations alone is not enough. You understand agents that execute workflows, orchestrate systems, use tools, maintain context, and perform work autonomously. **0\-to\-1 operator.** You have built products from scratch with real customers and understand the realities of finding product market fit. You have launched, rebuilt, changed direction, killed ideas, and iterated toward signals. You are comfortable creating structures where no playbook exists. **AI\-native problem solver.** You move quickly in environments where models evolve constantly and assumptions regularly break. You understand that building AI products often means navigating prompt rewrites, model shifts, reliability tradeoffs, and capability cliffs. **First\-principles thinker.** You spend equal time thinking about why, how, and what. You understand that strong product judgment often comes from deeply understanding systems and constraints rather than applying generic playbooks. **Customer\-embedded builder.** You believe the best products are built shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers. You have experience deeply embedding with early customers, understanding workflows firsthand, and rapidly shipping based on direct feedback loops. Experience with forward deployed environments or customer\-embedded product development models is highly valued. **Technical depth.** You are comfortable operating alongside ML engineers and highly technical teams as peers. You can understand evaluations, reason through system tradeoffs, prototype ideas, and participate deeply in technical conversations. You do not need to be an ex\-engineer, but you should have strong technical instincts and enjoy getting into the details. **Builder mentality.** Inventive and scrappy problem solver. You move quickly, embrace ambiguity, and know how to create meaningful outcomes without relying on giant teams or excessive process. **Deeply collaborative.** You work seamlessly across engineering, ML, operations, design, leadership, and customers to bring new products to life. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * 7 – 10 years of experience as a Product Manager * Evidence of launching products from scratch and driving meaningful customer outcomes * Experience building AI\-native products or customer\-facing agent systems * Strong technical abilities with the ability to work deeply with engineering and ML teams * Ability to read evaluations, reason through system performance, and prototype ideas * Experience operating in highly ambiguous startup environments with fast iteration cycles * Deep familiarity with AI tools and hands\-on experience building with modern AI systems * Desire to work at a startup and cover an exceptionally wide surface area * A strong work ethic and desire to build a category\-defining company **Benefits** ------------ * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via Grubhub \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Team building events * Gympass Benefit * Flexible PTO * ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Teledoc Health **Salary Range Details** ------------------------ The compensation range for this position is set between $180,000 and $210,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.We also offer a highly competitive equity package designed to ensure you share meaningfully in the long\-term success and upside of the business. The position is based onsite in New York City or San Francisco, five days per week, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with a high\-performing team in a fast\-paced, energetic environment. Being in person supports real\-time decision\-making, stronger teamwork, and the kind of creative problem\-solving that drives meaningful impact. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. **Our Values** -------------- **Dream Big \-** We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life\-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long\-term value for short\-term results. **Olympian’s Work Ethic \-** Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field. **Growth Mindset \-** We confront the toughest challenges head\-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience. **Customer Obsession \-** We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high\-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems Privacy Notice for CA Applicants Compensation Range: $210K \- $250K

jobs.title: Data Management Engineer
jobs.description: Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world. Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home. We boldly go. **Where is the work:** Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires. This person is responsible for developing and automating analytical tools and data process workflows that support order management and bill of material. This person will execute product changes within our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Configuration (DMC/MDP), and Trane sales tools (TSA). This person will partner directly with our design, engineering, manufacturing, and product support teams, so success in this key person requires collaboration with subject matter experts to translate engineering and customer needs into software tools and data products. * Responsible for implementation, maintenance, and audit of configuration management and bill of material aspects * Apply critical thinking to translate design, engineering, product support, and manufacturing requirements into supporting tools. * Continuously improve engineering analytics capabilities through improved workflow efficiency, automation, documentation, and enhancements. * Troubleshoot and resolve customer issues with data and applications. * Desire to maintain and improve documentation. * Able to define feature categories, feature codes, validation, nameplate and part picking rules into the Manufacturing Data Preparation Systems (MDP) independently for simple projects. * Understand principles of temporary variable categories (VCAT), how they can be created with validation rules and used as additional information for part picking rules. * Understand how to document within TSA/MDP the requirements to feed the factory end of the line tester. * Understand how to create or revise bills of materials and what rules are required for each bill. * Understands the functionalities of DMC/MDP and begins to gain knowledge to the interface of the field selection tools (TSA) and begin to load predefined data to support TSA changes. * Begin to understand the many change control processes within MDP, TSA and PLM system. * Responsible for completion of assignments, can test and verify own data with minimal coaching. * Works independently to analyze product documentation changes with coaching from senior staff. * Develop and exercise good communication skills. * Must be customer driven, innovative and quality minded in performance of all assigned duties. * Adheres to all company safety and security policies and procedures. **PHYSICAL EFFORT:** * Typical office environment spending the majority of their time using computers. Accommodations will be evaluated where needed. ADDITIONAL **REQUIREMENTS:** * Bachelors Degree in Engineering, Business, Information Systems (or related field) or equivalent degree. Minimum of 2 years of experience with Product Definition, Configuration concepts or HVAC experience preferred * 3\+ years of college in related fields plus 7 years experience may be considered * Preferred experience with PTC Windchill, Seimans Team Center or an equivalent PLM tool * Proven intermediate Microsoft Excel skills * Ability to read and comprehend engineering drawings, parts lists, bills of material, and rule based logic. * Standard logic and mathematical skills * Function in a technical engineering “team” environment. * Ability to travel. Expected travel time 5% **Annual Base Salary Range or Hourly Base Pay Range:** $65,200\.00 \- $137,200\.00 **Compensation Type:** Salary **Incentive Eligible:** No **Sales Commission Eligible:** No **Disclaimer:** We strive to provide competitive compensation for this position, tailored to a variety of factors. The actual compensation will depend on elements such as seniority, merit, geographic location, education, experience, travel requirements, and union designation. Our compensation range is generally based on the national average for the country. Additionally, benefits may vary depending on the region, business alignment, union involvement, and employee status. **Thrive at work and at home:** * Benefits kick in on DAY ONE for you and your family, including health insurance and holistic wellness programs that include generous incentives – WE DARE TO CARE! * Family building benefits include fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy assistance. * Paid time off includes up to 15 vacation days, paid holidays, sick leave, and additional options to support volunteer and parental leave. * 401K match up, educational and training opportunities through company programs along with tuition assistance and student debt support. **Disclaimer:** Benefit offerings may vary by site as well as Collective Bargaining Agreements and local/state regulations **Safety Sensitive Role:** NoThe company designates certain roles as Safety Sensitive. Safety Sensitive roles may require that you pass additional drug screening. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

jobs.title: Data Engineer I
jobs.description: **Who Are We?** Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it. **Compensation Overview** The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance\-based cash incentive awards. **Salary Range** $109,300\.00 \- $180,200\.00**Target Openings** 1**What Is the Opportunity?** Travelers Data Engineering team constructs pipelines that contextualize and provide easy access to data by the entire enterprise. As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in growing and transforming our analytics landscape. In addition to your strong analytical mind, you will bring your inquisitive attitude and ability to translate the stories found in data. You will leverage your ability to design, build and deploy data solutions that capture, explore, transform, and utilize data to support Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and business intelligence/insights. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. The company does not sponsor/support H\-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I\-983/STEM OPT, for this role.**What Will You Do?** * Build and operationalize complex data solutions, correct problems, apply transformations, and recommend data cleansing/quality solutions. * Design data solutions. * Analyze sources to determine value and recommend data to include in analytical processes. * Incorporate core data management competencies including data governance, data security and data quality. * Collaborate within and across teams to support delivery and educate end users on data products/analytic environment. * Perform data and system analysis, assessment and resolution for defects and incidents of moderate complexity and correct as appropriate. * Test data movement, transformation code, and data components. * Perform other duties as assigned. **What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?** * Bachelor’s Degree in STEM related field or equivalent. * Six years of related experience. * Strong proficiency in SQL with hands\-on Snowflake experience * Proven experience building ETL pipelines using tools such as AWS , dbt or any other ETL tool * Understanding of AWS cloud services and data architecture patterns (S3, IAM, Lambda, CloudWatch) * Experience with data modeling techniques (star/snowflake schema) and data warehouse design principles * Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices for data pipelines * Nice to Have: Experience with Ab Initio for enterprise\-scale ETL development is a plus * Proficient use of tools, techniques, and manipulation including Cloud platforms, programming languages, and an understanding of software engineering practices. * The ability to deliver work at a steady, predictable pace to achieve commitments, decompose work assignments into small batch releases, and contribute to tradeoff and negotiation discussions. * Demonstrated track record of domain expertise including the ability to understand technical concepts and possess in\-depth knowledge of immediate systems worked on. * Proven problem solving skills including debugging skills, allowing you to determine source of issues in unfamiliar code or systems and the ability to recognize and solve repetitive problems. * Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with team members and business partners. * Leadership \- Intermediate leadership skills with a proven track record of self\-motivation in identifying personal growth opportunities. **What is a Must Have?** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience. * 2 additional years of software/data engineering experience. **What Is in It for You?** * **Health Insurance**: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment. * **Retirement:** Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar\-for\-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers. * **Paid Time Off:** Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays. * **Wellness Program:** The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs. * **Volunteer Encouragement:** We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice. **Employment Practices** Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions. If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you. Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life\-at\-travelers/benefits/.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Position Description** The Embedded Software Engineer will design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software for next\-generation products. The ideal candidate will have strong C/C\+\+ programming skills, experience developing embedded Linux software, and a solid understanding of hardware/software integration. This role will work closely with electrical, mechanical, systems, and test engineers to translate product requirements into reliable, production\-ready embedded software. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** * Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded software for microcontroller\- and processor\-based systems. * Develop software primarily in C/C\+\+, including low\-level drivers, hardware interfaces, application code, and system services. * Develop, configure, customize, and maintain embedded Linux systems and associated build tools. * Integrate and configure real\-time operating systems (RTOS), middleware, communication stacks, and third\-party software components. * Develop and maintain firmware for interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, USB, Ethernet, and GPIO. * Collaborate with hardware engineers to bring up new circuit boards and troubleshoot hardware/software integration issues. * Analyze system requirements and translate them into robust software architectures and implementation plans. * Perform unit testing, integration testing, debugging, and performance optimization. * Use embedded debugging tools, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other laboratory equipment to diagnose system\-level issues. * Use Git for source\-code management, branching, merging, and code collaboration. * Use JIRA to track software development tasks, defects, requirements, and project progress. * Use development tools like Visual Studio Code (VS Code) and others to implement and debug embedded software. * Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and software development process improvements. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, including software specifications, design documentation, and test procedures. * Support product verification, validation, manufacturing, and field\-deployment activities. * Identify and resolve software defects and contribute to continuous improvement of product reliability and performance. PM21 Requirements: **Required** * BS in Computer Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent * 3\+ years in software and firmware engineering * Exceptional Communication skills · Strong proficiency in C and C\+\+ programming. * Experience developing software for microcontrollers or embedded processors. * Experience developing and maintaining embedded Linux systems. * Experience with Git for source\-code management and collaborative software development. * Proficiency with Visual Studio Code (VS Code) or a comparable integrated development environment. * Solid understanding of embedded systems concepts, including interrupts, timers, memory management, concurrency, and hardware interfaces. * Experience with embedded debugging tools and software development workflows. * Familiarity with software development processes, code reviews, testing methodologies, and configuration management. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to read and understand schematics, datasheets, and hardware specifications. **Desired** * Familiarity with UEFI BIOS and Intel x86 architectures * Familiarity with ARM \& embedded Linux development * Familiarity with PIC microcontroller development and other bare\-metal and low\-level firmware * Experience with the Yocto Project, including recipes, custom layers, BitBake, machine configurations, and image customization. * Experience with RTOS, such as FreeRTOS. * Experience with ARM processors. * Familiarity with Intel architecture. * Strong experience with embedded Linux system development and Linux kernel configuration. * Experience developing device drivers, bootloaders, BSPs, or board\-support software. * Experience with secure boot, firmware updates, cybersecurity, or embedded device security * Knowledge of FIPS\-140\-2, TPM, Bitlocker, STIG, and/or other security technologies * Scripting experience – bash, Zsh, Powershell, Python

jobs.title: Product Management Analyst
jobs.description: **(This position is based in Trepp's Dallas office which operates in a hybrid work schedule)** **The Role:** Trepp is a leading provider of innovative data and analytics solutions for CRE, CMBS, CLO, and Lending markets. We are seeking a curious, detail\-oriented Product Analyst to support our Lending product team. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with data, enjoys digging into the "why" behind user behavior, and is eager to build a foundation in product management within a fast\-moving, data\-rich industry. This individual will work closely with product managers, engineers, and client\-facing teams to help translate data and client feedback into product decisions. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Product Data Analysis:** Analyze usage patterns, client behavior, and performance metrics for our Lending products to surface trends and opportunities for improvement. * **Requirements Support:** Help product managers document clear requirements and user stories, and work with engineering to clarify details during execution. * **Market Research:** Support market and competitive research on lending, CRE, and fintech trends to help inform product decisions. * **Dashboards \& Reporting:** Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key product metrics such as adoption, retention, and engagement. * **Cross\-Functional Support:** Work with product, engineering, and client success teams to collect feedback, log feature requests, and track progress on the roadmap. * **Data Quality:** Assist with data validation and quality checks to help ensure the accuracy of the datasets underlying our lending products. * **Documentation:** Maintain product documentation, release notes, and internal resources to support the wider team. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field. * 1\-3 years of experience in a product, business, or data analyst role (SaaS, fintech, or financial data products a plus, not required). * Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data sets to draw out clear insights. * Proficiency in Excel; working knowledge of SQL, or willingness to build that skill quickly. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, able to work with both technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Exposure to commercial lending, CRE, CMBS, or CLO markets. * Experience with BI/visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker. * Familiarity with Agile/Scrum processes and tools like Jira or Confluence. * Interest in how AI and automation can be applied to data analysis or fintech workflows. **Benefits and Perks** * Base \+ target bonus compensation structure * Medical, Dental, Vision insurance * 401K (with employer match) * Student Debt Retirement Plan * Life insurance, long term disability, short term disability all covered by the company * Flexible paid time off (PTO) * Sixteen (16\) weeks paid primary caregiver leave (Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible) * Four (4\) weeks paid parental leave * Pet insurance * Laptop (company issued) \+ WFH equipment reimbursement * Career progression plan * Pre\-tax commuter benefit with company subsidy (For NYC\-office based employees only) * Involvement in Diversity and Inclusion programs * Fun company events and volunteering opportunities Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with Trepp (i.e., H1\-B visa, F\-1 visa (OPT), TN visa, or any other non\-immigrant status). **Workplace Policy** NYC, Dallas, and London office\-based positions: Trepp's offices follow a 3–2 hybrid\-working policy with the expectation of in\-office work on Tuesday–Thursday and the option to work from home on Monday and Friday. Trepp maintains a drug\-free workplace.

jobs.title: Front-End Application & Web Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** Tri\-State is seeking a practical, hands\-on Front\-End ApplicationWeb Platform Engineer to support both our public web presence and a growing internal application ecosystem. In this role, you will focus on taking functional, internally designed applications from approximately 85–90% complete to polished, production\-ready quality, as well as maintaining them post\-release. Additionally, you will take full ownership of rebuilding and modernizing the existing public websites as they migrate from legacy ASPX implementations to a modern, AWS\-hosted static architecture. This is a role focused on execution, user experience refinement, and front\-end reliability. You will collaborate directly with the Technical Lead, receiving existing source code, functional APIs, and established architecture, and independently driving software across the finish line. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Internal ApplicationsIntranet Platform** * **Application CompletionRefinement**: Complete and refine partially finished application front ends, connecting existing UI components to REST APIs and ensuring seamless client/server data flow. * **UI/UXWorkflow Enhancements**: Improve forms, tables, filters, tabs, modals, navigation, client\-side validation, and application workflows. * **StateError Handling**: Implement appropriate loading, success, warning, error, and empty states; improve client\-side validation and error handling. * **TroubleshootingBug Fixing**: Troubleshoot JavaScript and browser\-side behavior, diagnose layout and spacing issues, fix responsiveness, and resolve cross\-browser compatibility bugs reported by users. * **SecurityIntegration**: Work with authentication, sessions, JWT\-based APIs, CORS, and role\-based UI behavior. * **Component Standardization**: Refactor repeated interface patterns into reusable components and utilities to help establish consistent UI standards across internal applications. * **Backend AlignmentEscalation**: Make small supporting backend/API tweaks when appropriate while recognizing when changes impact underlying architecture or business logic, escalating those issues to the Technical Lead. * **TestingDeployment Maintenance**: Thoroughly test changes before production deployment and provide ongoing maintenance and improvements post\-release. **Public Website Platform Modernization** * **Platform Migration**: Rebuild legacy ASPX public websites using modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript within a static\-site architecture hosted on AWS. * **BrandingComponent Design**: Preserve existing branding, content, and functionality while building responsive, reusable page and content components. * **Dynamic Integration**: Integrate dynamic content delivered through APIs, S3, or other backend services to maintain site flexibility without relying on a traditional CMS for every update. * **PerformanceOptimization**: Optimize site performance, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, browser compatibility, and maintain analytics/tracking integrations. * **Technical SEO / AEO / GEO Implementation**: Execute technical discovery and search recommendations supplied by Marketing and analytics teams, including semantic HTML, page metadata, canonical URLs, structured data/schema markup, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, content hierarchy, and image optimization. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * **Relevant Experience**: Approximately 3–6 years of professional experience as a Front\-End Engineer, Web Application Developer, UI Engineer, or Full\-Stack Developer with a strong front\-end focus (demonstrated capability may be prioritized over formal degrees or rigid years of experience). * **Core Front\-End Proficiency**: Strong, practical mastery of HTML5, CSS, and modern JavaScript. * **Application Troubleshooting**: Proven ability to dive into existing source code, debug complex browser\-side issues, and resolve front\-end state/event handling bugs using browser developer tools. * **WebAPI Integration**: Solid working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, asynchronous requests, HTTP, CORS, authentication/authorization mechanisms (JWT), and client/server architecture. * **Responsive DesignVersion Contro**l: Demonstrated skill in building responsive layouts, cross\-browser compatibility, and source control using Git. * **Self\-DirectionExecution**: Strong independent problem\-solving skills with the ability to take a functional API and high\-level workflow description and independently determine what needs to be fixed or completed. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * **AWS Cloud Environment**: Experience with AWS cloud services (S3, CloudFront, Lambda, DynamoDB) and serverless web application patterns. * **Modern Tooling**: Proficiency with TypeScript and modern front\-end build tooling/workflows. * **Technical SEOSearch Infrastructure**: Familiarity with technical SEO standards, Schema.org structured data, Google Search Console, and web analytics tools. * **AccessibilityPerformance**: Understanding of Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) and Core Web Vitals performance optimization. * **DevOps Integration**: Exposure to CI/CD pipelines or automated deployment workflows ***Tri\-State is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color,*** ***religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.***

jobs.title: 12-Month Geospatial Intern
jobs.description: **The following job descriptions outline common geospatial internship openings for 12 month interns at Trimble. jobs.description: If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact. With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you. US Valve, an IDEX company is seeking a proactive and technically skilled Valves and Flow Control Applications Engineer to join our Engineering team. We manufacture high\-performance check valves assembled in our Linthicum, MD facility, serving critical applications across industrial, commercial, and specialty markets. The Valves and Flow Control Applications Engineer plays a key role in helping customers, sales teams, and internal engineering groups select and apply valves and fluid control products. The person in this role uses technical knowledge, strong communication skills, and practical engineering judgment to make sure customers receive solutions that fit their performance and compliance requirements. This work includes valve sizing, product selection, documentation, quotation support, and ongoing technical support. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Valve Selection, Sizing, and Application Support** 1\. Coordinate with sales team to size and select valves based on process conditions, material requirements, performance needs, and customer specifications. 2\. Review datasheets, P\&IDs, drawings, and engineering specifications to identify the right valve configuration for a given application. 3\. Recommend materials such as metals, seat materials, and elastomers that match the service conditions. 4\. Use internal tools, sizing calculators, ERP configurators, and engineering software to produce predict performance and highlight application concerns. 5\. Develop and improve sizing tools, application guides, and installation/operation manuals. 6\. Review regulatory requirements, including domestic content requirements, and provide guidance to the Sales team including sourcing requirements, cost, and execution requirements. **Customer and User Technical Support** 1\. Serve as a technical contact for customers and channel partners by gathering application details, answering questions, and recommending solutions. 2\. Prepare and deliver cut sheets, technical documentation, and product recommendations. 3\. Work through product and application issues by offering troubleshooting support and cost\-effective solutions. 4\. Provide clear and timely communication to ensure customers understand their options and the reasoning behind recommendations. 5\. Together with Product and Quality engineers, perform root cause analysis on customer field failures. Communicate the results of failure analysis professionally and clearly to external stakeholders. **Engineering Documentation and Quality System Support** 1\. Review special or complex incoming orders for accuracy and alignment with technical requirements. 2\. Create routings, item records, quality alerts, and work instructions to guide production during the manufacture of products for special or complex projects. 3\. Create or update Bills of Material and complete Engineering Change Requests and Engineering Change Notices. 4\. Support company quality initiatives by maintaining accurate information, compliant documentation, and tracking customer product complaint records. **Collaboration With Cross\-Functional Teams** 1\. Work closely with design engineering, operations, quality, supply chain, and project teams to support product development and order execution. 2\. Communicate customer needs to design engineers to support custom valve solutions when needed. 3\. Assist sales and marketing with technical content, demonstrations, and training materials. **QUALIFICATIONS:** *To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* 1\. Strong understanding of valve principles, flow characteristics, and Cv calculations 2\. Familiarity with industry standards such as ASME, API, NACE, and CE or PED requirements. 3\.\- Ability to read P\&IDs, interpret datasheets, and analyze mechanical and process information. 4\. Strong communication skills for working with customers, distributors, engineers, and internal teams. 5\. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently. 6\. Experience with 3D modeling software and ERP systems (preferred). **EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:** 1\. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. 2\. Three to seven years of experience in valves, fluid control equipment, instrumentation, or a similar industry. 3\. \- Experience with safety relief valves, control valves, or specialized flow\-control equipment is preferred. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** *The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Employee will occasionally lift up to 35 lbs. 3\. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. **WORK ENVIRONMENT:** *The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Noise level is minimal with intervals of spikes. 3\. Required to wear safety glasses and utilize safety equipment while present on the shop floor. 4\. Occasional travel to customer or distributor locations for support or training may be required. US Valve is committed to equal employment opportunity. jobs.description: **Opportunity:** Offerwall by Unity is a leading mobile advertising and monetization platform that empowers game developers to maximize revenue and engage users through rewarded experiences. This is an exciting opportunity to lead impactful initiatives, architect robust solutions, and directly contribute to the financial success of countless mobile app developers and the engagement of millions of users globally. You will also play a key role in designing backend technical solutions that focus on system performance, reliability, and delivering business value at scale. **What you'll be doing:** * Architect \& Design: Lead the technical design and architecture for Offer Delivery services, features, and critical strategic initiatives, collaborating closely with senior engineers and managers. * Develop \& Innovate: Build, test, and operate the Golang services that power real\-time bidding into video auctions (OpenRTB) and direct offer placement outside the auction flow. * Raise the Bar: Mentor engineers, set engineering standards, and foster a culture of technical excellence on the team. * Drive Cross\-team Delivery: Ensure seamless communication and collaboration with product, Ad Viewer, teams in a distributed environment. * Operate \& Maintain: Ensure the high availability and reliability of our production services, including participation in on\-call rotations and proactive system monitoring. **What we're looking for:** * Technical Leadership: track record of owning a significant backend system, setting direction, making the architectural calls, and getting it delivered through others as well as yourself. * High\-scale distributed systems: Demonstrated ability to design and ship large\-scale, highly available, latency\-sensitive distributed services with complex business logic. * Core Technologies: Strong proficiency in backend development using Go (or clear ability to become effective in it quickly). jobs.title: Concrete Laboratory Technician
jobs.description: Who We Are: *At UES, we’re a team of more than 4,000 engineers, scientists, geologists, inspectors, technicians, and drillers united by a shared purpose—to make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. As a national leader in geotechnical engineering, environmental consulting, and materials testing and inspection, we collaborate on transformative projects across transportation, energy, water, healthcare, and more. Learn more about the benefits of joining Team UES and our core values at* *careers.teamues.com**.* Position Overview: UES is seeking a dependable and motivated **Concrete Laboratory Technician** to join our Houston laboratory team. This entry\-level role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands\-on work and takes pride in accuracy, consistency, and safety. No previous laboratory experience is required—we provide the training needed to succeed. As a Concrete Laboratory Technician, you will support our Construction Materials Testing (CMT) operations by receiving, logging, labeling, curing, and testing concrete cylinders in accordance with ASTM standards, including compressive strength testing. You will play an important role in delivering accurate test results that help ensure the quality and safety of construction projects throughout the region. Responsibilities: * Perform routine laboratory testing on construction materials, including soil, concrete, and other construction materials following ASTM, AASHTO, and other applicable industry standards to ensure compliance with project specifications. * Ensure that project testing requirements are met and compliant with project specifications, requirements, and company policies and procedures. * Accurately document and report test results, maintaining detailed, organized, and error\-free records. * Assist with sample preparation, handling, and proper storage, ensuring sample integrity, traceability, and adherence to laboratory protocols. * Operate laboratory testing equipment. * Follow strict safety protocols and laboratory procedures, including proper handling of materials and use of personal protective equipment (PPE). * Communicate effectively with lab supervisors, engineers, and field personnel, providing timely updates on test results, sample status, and any technical issues. * Perform additional duties as assigned, supporting the laboratory team, field technicians, and project managers as needed. Job Responsibilities Note: *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. UES retains the right to add to or change the duties of the position at any time.*Qualifications: * High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or technical coursework in engineering, geology, construction science, or a related field preferred. * 0\-3 years of experience in construction materials testing, geotechnical laboratory work, or a related field (prior laboratory experience preferred but not required). * Commitment to workplace safety, following OSHA, company, and laboratory safety protocols, including the proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE). * Basic computer proficiency, with experience in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and Field Data Collection (FDC) software preferred. * Ability to read, write, and interpret procedures, manuals, technical documents, and reports related to construction materials testing and laboratory protocols. * Mathematical skills sufficient to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. * Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with colleagues, supervisors, field personnel, and clients to carry out instructions and report findings. * Strong organizational, time management, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently. * Detail\-oriented and quality\-focused, ensuring accuracy in sample preparation, testing procedures, and data documentation. * Ability to work independently within the limitations of experience, using initiative to solve routine lab challenges. * Ability to stand for extended periods of time and perform physically demanding tasks, including lifting and moving materials or equipment. * Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record; ability to travel to job sites as needed. Travel Requirements: * This position does not require regular travel as part of its primary responsibilities. However, occasional travel may be required, up to 10%, primarily for occasional off\-site meetings, training sessions, or company events. Travel, when necessary, will be communicated in advance and aligned with business needs. Physical Demands \& Work Environment: Work is sometimes conducted in a laboratory setting, but may also involve fieldwork and exposure to outdoor conditions, including:* Sites that may not be accessible by vehicle, requiring travel on foot through wetlands, swamps, grasslands, construction zones, and other uneven or rugged terrain with natural and man\-made obstacles such as sand, brush, and debris. * Moderate to loud noise levels due to lab equipment, field operations, and construction environments. * Exposure to dirt, dust, chemicals, sun, heat, humidity, and varying weather conditions as part of field sample collection and testing. Physical requirements include: * Ability to lift and carry between 35 and 75 lbs. over distances up to 75 feet, involving regular repetitive motion. * Ability to stand, walk, drive, and operate laboratory and field equipment for extended periods. * Frequent use of hands and arms for typing, handling samples, operating lab instruments, and performing testing procedures. * Ability to bend, twist, reach, stoop, pull, kneel, climb, balance, lift, carry, and push as required for laboratory and fieldwork. * Ability to communicate effectively through verbal and written means in a lab and field environment, often requiring the use of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment). * Ability to use your senses to see (including close, distant, and peripheral vison, depth vision, and ability to focus) and smell. EEO Statement: **UES is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to recruit the most qualified candidates. Please see our full EEO Statement at the bottom of the page** **here**

Founded in 1874 as Nevada’s original land\-grant university, the University serves more than 23,000 undergraduate and graduate students from all 50 states and 63 countries. Classified by the Carnegie® Classification of Institutions of Higher Education as an R1 (“Very High Research”) university, it is also recognized in the Carnegie® Community Engagement classification. The University is also ranked by U.S. News \& World Report among the “Best National Universities” and “Best National Public Universities.” It also ranks in the top tier of the WSJ/Times Higher Education World University Rankings and the New York Times’ “Top Colleges for Economic Diversity.” Since 2009, nearly $1 billion has been has invested in advanced labs, facilities, and residence halls on the main campus. The University is home to Nevada’s first medical school – the University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine and the Wayne L. Prim Campus at Lake Tahoe, where education, research, and creative work thrive in a stunning mountain setting. The University delivers on its original land\-grant mission with outreach across the state through the University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada Agricultural Experiment Station, Nevada Bureau of Mines and Geology, Nevada Small Business Development Center, the Nevada Seismological Laboratory, and Wolf Pack Athletics. The main campus is in Reno, Nevada, a burgeoning global technology hub with a vibrant midtown and downtown. Found where the high desert of the Great Basin meets the High Sierra and Lake Tahoe, the beautiful, 290\-acre main campus is also a Nevada State Arboretum. The University’s physical infrastructure is expanding with ongoing construction of the newly named John Tullock Business Building, set to open in fall 2025\. Groundbreaking is also planned for a new State Public Health Laboratory Building on campus, alongside the recent acquisition of 16 parcels near campus, known as “University Village,” to provide affordable housing for graduate students and early career faculty. Collaborating with world\-renowned organizations, the University fosters innovation through initiatives such as the Digital Wolf Pack partnership with Apple, which ensures equitable access to technology for students, providing new incoming freshman or transfer students with an iPad Air and accessories. Google’s TechWise initiate is an 18\-month program that fully supports undergraduate students in becoming entry\-level software engineers by graduation. In 2023, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Economic Development Administration (EDA) announced that Nevada – led by the University of Nevada, Reno – was named one of the inaugural 31 Regional Technology and Innovation Hubs (TechHubs). Nevada was selected from a competitive pool of 489 applicants from across the United States and its territories. Nevada’s Tech Hub will strengthen America’s lithium batteries, critical elements and other electric vehicle materials industry sectors within the state. Through its commitment to high\-impact education, world\-improving research and creative activity, and outreach that’s transforming Nevada’s communities and businesses, the University continues its 150\-year tradition of benefitting our state, nation and world. The University recognizes that diversity promotes excellence in education and research. The inclusive and engaged community on campus recognizes the added value that students, faculty, and staff from different backgrounds bring to the educational experience. Today, the University delivers on its original land\-grant mission of access to education and knowledge by investing in the academics, facilities, support, engagement and vibrant campus life that promote our diverse students’ cognitive growth and academic achievement – all while remaining one of the best values in American higher education. For more information, please visit the University’s website . **University of Nevada, Reno** ------------------------------

jobs.title: Release Manager
jobs.description: At VIDA, we’re passionate about driving positive change in lung and respiratory care through thoughtful, innovative technology. We’re committed to reshaping the way organizations and physicians approach pulmonary medicine with powerful artificial intelligence and image analysis. Our talented team works hard every day to design cutting\-edge solutions that truly improve patients’ lives around the world. We’re a small, fast\-growing company with big benefits and the kind of culture that makes you smile. All we’re missing is YOU! If you’re looking to make a difference and channel your expertise into meaningful work that’s changing the world for the better, we want to hear from you. **Role Overview** VIDA is seeking a technical, systems\-oriented **Release Manager** to lead and continuously improve how software changes move safely and efficiently from development into production across VIDA’s cloud\-based products and services. This role goes beyond scheduling releases or manually coordinating deployments. You own and improve the **release operating model**—the processes, automation, controls, telemetry, and cross\-functional practices that enable engineering teams to release independently while protecting product quality, customer data, production reliability, security, and VIDA’s regulatory and compliance obligations. Operating within a healthcare and life\-sciences SaaS environment, this role partners closely with Engineering, Architecture, Cloud Operations, Product Management, Data Science, Quality, Security, and Compliance to establish a modern, risk\-based software delivery model. You will also be VIDA's voice o**n AI\-enabled software delivery process**, making sure the added velocity from AI\-assisted engineering is supported by effective testing, review, traceability, security controls, observability, and production safeguards. **Key Responsibilities** **Release Strategy and Delivery Governance** * Define and continuously improve VIDA’s software release strategy, standards, governance model, and success measures. * Evolve VIDA toward a continuous, automated, and risk\-based delivery model that minimizes unnecessary manual coordination and approvals. * Establish release classifications based on clinical and customer impact, data sensitivity, reversibility, and blast radius. * Define proportionate controls for each level of release risk, including when changes can proceed automatically and when additional testing, review, progressive delivery, or approval is required. * Establish practical emergency\-change and exception processes that preserve accountability and traceability without slowing critical remediation. * Use production incidents, near misses, audit findings, and delivery friction to drive continuous improvement. **CI/CD, Progressive Delivery, and Production Safety** * Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and Cloud Operations on paved\-road CI/CD — trunk\-based development, small batch sizes, reusable workflows, and standard deployment patterns. * Agile processes that infuse automated quality, security, compliance, and operational checks into the software delivery lifecycle. * Ensure release evidence—including source traceability, peer review, testing, security validation, deployment history, approvals, and post\-release results—is reliable, searchable, and audit\-ready. * Align the release model to support decoupling of deployment from release using feature flags, canary and staged rollouts, and blue/green deployments, so teams ship continuously while customer exposure stays under separate control. * Establish measurable release\-health criteria and effective pause, rollback, forward\-fix, and feature\-disablement practices. * Work with engineering teams to ensure critical services have clear operational ownership, observability, rollback strategies, and incident\-response paths. * Strengthen software supply\-chain controls — dependency and secrets management, artifact integrity, SBOMs, and infrastructure\-as\-code validation. **AI\-Assisted Software Engineering** * Help define and operationalize VIDA’s standards and guardrails for responsible AI\-assisted software development. * Ensure AI\-assisted and AI\-generated code remains subject to appropriate human ownership, peer review, testing, security validation, architecture standards, traceability, and production\-readiness requirements through established processes. * Partner with Security, Privacy, Quality, and Compliance to establish processes that protect source code, credentials, PHI, PII, customer information, and other sensitive data when AI development tools are used. * Measure the impact of AI\-assisted engineering on development velocity, quality, security findings, change failure rates, rollback frequency, and production incidents. * Help VIDA increase engineering productivity through AI without weakening quality, security, regulatory compliance, or accountability. **Delivery Performance and Continuous Improvement** * Establish a h clear visibility into software delivery health, release risk, AI\-development adoption, and improvement opportunities. * Lead improvement initiatives that reduce release friction while increasing engineering autonomy and production reliability. **Cross\-Functional Leadership** * Partner with Engineering leaders and technical leads to establish clear service ownership and accountability for production changes. * Work with Product Management on feature rollout, customer communication, staged availability, and release readiness. * Collaborate with Quality Engineering to strengthen automated testing, risk\-based validation, and quality signals. * Ensure software\-delivery practices meet VIDA policies, customer obligations, and applicable regulatory requirements. * Support customer assessments and audits by maintaining defensible release and change\-management evidence. * Run the release capability as a platform product — treat engineering teams as your customers, measure adoption, and never become a centralized release bottleneck. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, release engineering, SRE, platform engineering, quality engineering, or a related technical delivery discipline. * 2\+ years leading or materially improving release management, CI/CD, DevOps, or production\-readiness practices in a SaaS or cloud environment. * Strong understanding of processes behind CI/CD, Test Driven Development, and infrastructure as code. * Experience with progressive delivery approaches including feature flags, staged rollouts, canary or blue/green deployment, health\-based promotion, and rollback. * Strong understanding of software delivery metrics, observability, incident response, and operational reliability. * Demonstrated ability to design risk\-based processes that improve engineering velocity while maintaining production safety. * Strong systems thinking and organizational\-change experience leveraging Agile delivery methodologies such as ScrumBan, Kanban, SAFe, etc. * Ability to engage credibly with engineers on technical details that impact process, releases, and messaging to internal/external stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in healthcare, life sciences, medical software, clinical trials, or another regulated SaaS environment. * Familiarity with frameworks or requirements such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP/GCP, NIST, or OWASP. * Experience with AWS, containerized or serverless systems, infrastructure as code, and modern DevOps tooling. * Experience building reusable CI/CD workflows, internal developer platforms, policy\-as\-code controls, or developer self\-service capabilities. * Familiarity with software supply\-chain security, vulnerability management, SBOMs, artifact integrity, and secrets management. * Experience using or governing AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, or similar technologies. * Experience supporting enterprise customer security assessments, compliance reviews, or external audits. **Reporting Relationship** This role reports to the **VP of Engineering** and works closely with Engineering, Architecture, Cloud Operations, Product Management, Data Science, Software Quality, Security, Privacy, Compliance, Customer Success, and Technical Support. Engineering teams and service owners retain accountability for the quality and operation of their services. The Release Manager provides the strategy, processes, standards, visibility, and oversight that enable those teams to deliver software safely and efficiently. All VIDA employees expected to be flexible and have an entrepreneurial mindset. Other duties may be assigned as needed. *VIDA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran’s status, age or disability.*

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Veedma is a telehealth practice for men's hormonal and sexual health. We treat low testosterone, erectile dysfunction, and the symptoms men actually feel: libido, erection, energy, strength, and mood, in men 18 and up, fully online. Most low testosterone is secondary and reversible, so we find the cause first and stimulate the body's own production before resorting to TRT. Enclomiphene is the foundation; Tadalafil is co\-prescribed when erectile or prostate symptoms coexist with low Free Testosterone. Testosterone replacement therapy is not a service we currently offer.** The platform is AI\-native by default. Both founders code in Claude Code every day. Production code calls OpenAI's API from Python for the in\-product features and content pipeline. Akute is the EHR, Stripe handles billing. About the founders You will work with both of us directly, every day. The CTO is the one reviewing your code. Vladimir Kotlov, MD \- Founder \& CEO. Urologist by training (MD, 2014\) with clinical experience in men's reproductive health. The clinical voice in every product call. (https://www.linkedin.com/in/vkotlov/) Victor Kuznetsov \- Founder \& CTO. 20\+ years in software engineering and AI/ML. Previously Co\-Founder \& CTO of Yva.ai (people analytics, acquired by Visier). Owns the Veedma platform end\-to\-end today and will review your code. (https://www.linkedin.com/in/wiltodelta/) If the people you would be reporting to matters to you (it should), open both profiles before you apply. You probably fit if When you see a bug, a slow query, a missing tool \- your hand is already on the keyboard. You don't wait for a ticket, a sprint, a spec review. You read the code, fix the thing, write the migration, and the PR is in flight before lunch. You're personally interested in men's health, hormone optimization, or longevity \- the engineers who do their best work here are the ones who would use the product themselves. You don't need to be a Veedma patient, but you should be the kind of person who would consider becoming one. What you will own \- Patient\-facing flows. Intake, lab upload, report delivery, messaging, payment. \- Internal tools for the clinical team. Whatever turns the platform into a clinic \- lists of who needs what next, draft\-and\-send workflows, the small admin screens that save the team a day a week. \- Integrations. Akute, Stripe, Postmark, Fillout, ShipStation, Slack. \- Spec to prod, end\-to\-end. Spec Monday, in production by midweek, watched in Sentry the same day. No handoffs. \- The AI layer, both sides of it. Inside the product and the content pipeline: OpenAI API calls from Python that power the features and automations that benefit from an LLM. Inside the team: Claude Code skills and sub\-agents the founders and clinician use to do their own work faster. You own and extend both. Stack \- Python (Flask) primary. Backend, async jobs, integrations, data pipelines, internal tools. \- PostgreSQL \- Celery \+ Redis for queues and scheduled jobs \- Tailwind CSS \+ Flowbite , server\-rendered from Flask templates. No SPA today. \- Akute (EHR), Stripe, Postmark, Fillout, ShipStation, Slack as the live integrations. \- OpenAI API called from Python for the in\-product features and content\-pipeline automations that benefit from an LLM. Choice of model is not religion either \- we will switch providers when the trade\-off changes. \- Claude Code, custom skills, and MCP integrations are how the team works day\-to\-day. This is the stack today, not a religion. We swap pieces when there is a real reason. We expect you to argue for changes, lead them, and own the cost of them. The wrong fit is "I only work with X" in either direction. What we are looking for \- 10\+ years building production web apps end\-to\-end. Senior, hands\-on. You have shipped features real customers used and paid for, and you have owned a system long enough to live with your own design decisions. \- Healthcare is in your background. Most of those years were spent shipping production code at a healthcare, telehealth, EHR, digital therapeutics, pharmacy, or medical\-device company. You know what PHI is. You have argued about HIPAA with a security team. You have hit an EHR API and lived to tell about it. \- You want to stay in healthcare. This is not your "let me try something different from fintech" tour. When you describe what you want to build over the next 5 years, healthcare is in the answer without prompting. \- Claude Code is your primary tool. Not Cursor, not Copilot autocompletes, not "I sometimes ask Claude". 6\+ months of daily use, 4\+ hours per day. You write skills, wire up MCP servers, compose sub\-agents, and have a real CLAUDE.md in every repo you own. If you cannot describe your Claude Code workflow in concrete detail, wrong seat. \- Strong Python. This is our primary language. Production Python at depth \- typed code, async, packaging, profiling, real test coverage on the parts that matter. Not "I picked it up for a side project." \- Ship across the stack daily. Frontend, backend, schema migrations, infra \- whichever the task needs. You don't wait for a teammate to do the other half. \- Real external integrations under your belt. At least one that mattered \- payments, EHR, messaging, identity. You know what good error handling looks like, and what 3am pager pain teaches you. \- You have shipped LLM features to real users, not demos. Production prompt engineering, evals on real data, retrieval, structured outputs, cost\-and\-latency budgeting \- you know what each of these is and why each one bites. "I have used ChatGPT" does not count. "I built a cool demo" does not count. \- Tooling is part of your job. If the internal dashboard you need doesn't exist, you build it. If the deploy is painful, you fix it. If the test suite is slow, you make it fast. You don't file tickets against yourself. \- Tests on the parts that need them, not everywhere. Nice to have \- Direct experience with EHR systems (Akute, Healthie). \- Worked at Hims, Ro, Hone, Maximus, or similar DTC telehealth. \- Stripe billing experience beyond a basic checkout. \- Flask, Peewee, or Celery in production. \- Comfortable shipping server\-rendered HTML (Jinja templates, Tailwind) when that's what the task needs \- and equally comfortable arguing for a SPA, a different framework, or a different language when it earns its keep. How we operate \- AI\-native, not AI\-curious. Both founders code in Claude Code every day. The bar for "should this be a tool" is hours, not weeks. In\-product LLM features (OpenAI API in Python) and team\-side AI tooling (Claude Code skills) are both real, both maintained, and both yours to extend. \- No queues, no tickets pointed at yourself. If you see it broken, you fix it. If a script would save you four hours a week, you build it Friday. We don't wait. \- Never idle. Always something being tested, a signal we're chasing, a part of the product getting tighter. A week without something new shipped to patients or providers is a broken week. \- Signals over opinions. What patients message us, what support tickets say, where the funnel breaks, what the error logs scream \- that sets the backlog. Participate in on\-call rotation. * Shipping continuous evaluation and DevSecOps. Implement continuous evaluation pipelines: automated benchmarking, simulation harnesses, and RLAIF feedback loops. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. facilitate deeper analysis and reporting * Review and analyze moderately complex business, operational or technical challenges that require an in\-depth evaluation of variable factors * Oversee the data integration work, including developing a data model, maintaining a data warehouse and analytics environment, and writing scripts for data integration and analysis * Resolve moderately complex issues and lead teams to meet data engineering deliverables while leveraging solid understanding of data information policies, procedures and compliance requirements * Collaborate and consult with colleagues and managers to resolve data engineering issues and achieve strategic goals **Required Qualifications:** * 4\+ years of Data Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one
